AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >
  Creates a serverless workflow using Step Functions that sends custom events to a
  custom EventBridge event bus, with a rule that forwards all events to CloudWatch Logs.

Resources:
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # 1. Custom EventBridge Event Bus
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  CustomEventBus:
    Type: AWS::Events::EventBus
    Properties:
      Name: CustomWorkflowBus

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # 2. CloudWatch Logs Log Group for debugging / testing
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  DebugLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: /aws/events/custom-workflow-bus
      RetentionInDays: 7

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # 3. IAM role that EventBridge Rule assumes to write into the Log Group
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  EventBridgeLogsRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: events.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: WriteToCloudWatchLogs
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                Resource: !GetAtt DebugLogGroup.Arn

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # 4. EventBridge Rule – forwards ALL events from the custom bus to CloudWatch
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  DebugRule:
    Type: AWS::Events::Rule
    DependsOn:
      - DebugLogGroup
      - EventBridgeLogsRole
    Properties:
      EventBusName: !Ref CustomEventBus
      State: ENABLED
      EventPattern: {}
      Targets:
        - Arn: !GetAtt DebugLogGroup.Arn
          Id: CloudWatchLogsTarget
          RoleArn: !GetAtt EventBridgeLogsRole.Arn

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # 5. IAM role for Step Functions to call events:PutEvents on the custom bus
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  StepFunctionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: states.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: PutEventsOnCustomBus
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action: events:PutEvents
                Resource: !GetAtt CustomEventBus.Arn

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # 6. Step Functions State Machine (the serverless workflow)
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  WorkflowStateMachine:
    Type: AWS::StepFunctions::StateMachine
    DependsOn:
      - StepFunctionRole
      - CustomEventBus
    Properties:
      StateMachineName: ServerlessWorkflow
      StateMachineType: STANDARD
      RoleArn: !GetAtt StepFunctionRole.Arn
      DefinitionString:
        Fn::Sub:
          - |-
            {
              "Comment": "Serverless workflow that sends a custom event to the EventBridge bus",
              "StartAt": "SendCustomEvent",
              "States": {
                "SendCustomEvent": {
                  "Type": "Task",
                  "Resource": "arn:aws:states:::events:putEvents",
                  "Parameters": {
                    "Entries": [
                      {
                        "EventBusName": "${EventBusArn}",
                        "Source": "com.myapp.workflow",
                        "DetailType": "WorkflowEvent",
                        "Detail": {
                          "message": "Hello from Step Functions workflow",
                          "workflowId.$": "$$.Execution.Id"
                        }
                      }
                    ]
                  },
                  "End": true
                }
              }
            }
          - EventBusArn: !GetAtt CustomEventBus.Arn

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: 'AWS Cloud WAN global network with centralized outbound traffic inspection - Production (isolated, no acceptance) and Development segments with inspection VPCs'

Resources:
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------
  # Cloud WAN Global Network
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------
  GlobalNetwork:
    Type: AWS::NetworkManager::GlobalNetwork
    Properties:
      Description: Global network for centralized outbound traffic inspection across multiple regions
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: GlobalNetwork-Inspection

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------
  # Cloud WAN Core Network with embedded policy document
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------
  CoreNetwork:
    Type: AWS::NetworkManager::CoreNetwork
    Properties:
      GlobalNetworkId: !Ref GlobalNetwork
      Description: Core network with edge locations in us-east-1, eu-west-1, ap-southeast-1
      PolicyDocument:
        {
          "core-network-configuration": {
            "edge-locations": [
              {"location": "us-east-1"},
              {"location": "eu-west-1"},
              {"location": "ap-southeast-1"}
            ]
          },
          "segments": [
            {
              "name": "production",
              "isolate-attachments": true,
              "require-acceptance": false
            },
            {
              "name": "development"
            },
            {
              "name": "inspection"
            }
          ],
          "segment-actions": [
            {
              "action": "send-via",
              "mode": "single-hop",
              "segment": "production",
              "destination-cidr-blocks": ["0.0.0.0/0"],
              "send-via": {
                "network-function-groups": ["inspection-group"]
              }
            },
            {
              "action": "send-via",
              "mode": "single-hop",
              "segment": "development",
              "destination-cidr-blocks": ["0.0.0.0/0"],
              "send-via": {
                "network-function-groups": ["inspection-group"]
              }
            }
          ],
          "attachment-policies": [
            {
              "rule-number": 100,
              "action": {
                "association-method": "tag",
                "tag-value-of-key": "domain",
                "segment": "production"
              },
              "conditions": [
                {
                  "type": "tag-value",
                  "key": "environment",
                  "value": "production"
                }
              ]
            },
            {
              "rule-number": 200,
              "action": {
                "association-method": "tag",
                "tag-value-of-key": "domain",
                "segment": "development"
              },
              "conditions": [
                {
                  "type": "tag-value",
                  "key": "environment",
                  "value": "development"
                }
              ]
            },
            {
              "rule-number": 300,
              "action": {
                "association-method": "constant",
                "network-function-group": "inspection-group"
              },
              "conditions": [
                {
                  "type": "tag-value",
                  "key": "inspection",
                  "value": "true"
                }
              ]
            }
          ],
          "network-function-groups": [
            {
              "name": "inspection-group",
              "description": "Network function group for inspection VPCs"
            }
          ]
        }
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: CoreNetwork-Inspection

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------
  # Service-linked role for Network Manager (required for Core Network)
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------
  NetworkManagerSLR:
    Type: AWS::IAM::ServiceLinkedRole
    Properties:
      AWSServiceName: networkmanager.amazonaws.com
      Description: Service-linked role for AWS Network Manager to manage Cloud WAN resources

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------
  # Inspection VPC (tagged for network function group membership)
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------
  InspectionVPC:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: 10.0.0.0/16
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: InspectionVPC
        - Key: inspection
          Value: "true"

  InspectionSubnet:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref InspectionVPC
      CidrBlock: 10.0.1.0/24
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: InspectionSubnet

  InspectionVPCAttachment:
    Type: AWS::NetworkManager::VpcAttachment
    Properties:
      CoreNetworkId: !Ref CoreNetwork
      VpcArn: !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:ec2:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:vpc/${InspectionVPC}
      SubnetArns:
        - !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:ec2:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:subnet/${InspectionSubnet}
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: InspectionVPCAttachment
        - Key: inspection
          Value: "true"

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------
  # Production Workload VPC (tagged environment=production, domain=production)
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------
  ProductionVPC:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: 10.1.0.0/16
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: ProductionVPC
        - Key: environment
          Value: production
        - Key: domain
          Value: production

  ProductionSubnet:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref ProductionVPC
      CidrBlock: 10.1.1.0/24
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: ProductionSubnet

  ProductionVPCAttachment:
    Type: AWS::NetworkManager::VpcAttachment
    Properties:
      CoreNetworkId: !Ref CoreNetwork
      VpcArn: !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:ec2:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:vpc/${ProductionVPC}
      SubnetArns:
        - !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:ec2:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:subnet/${ProductionSubnet}
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: ProductionVPCAttachment
        - Key: environment
          Value: production
        - Key: domain
          Value: production

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------
  # Development Workload VPC (tagged environment=development, domain=development)
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------
  DevelopmentVPC:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: 10.2.0.0/16
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: DevelopmentVPC
        - Key: environment
          Value: development
        - Key: domain
          Value: development

  DevelopmentSubnet:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref DevelopmentVPC
      CidrBlock: 10.2.1.0/24
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: DevelopmentSubnet

  DevelopmentVPCAttachment:
    Type: AWS::NetworkManager::VpcAttachment
    Properties:
      CoreNetworkId: !Ref CoreNetwork
      VpcArn: !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:ec2:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:vpc/${DevelopmentVPC}
      SubnetArns:
        - !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:ec2:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:subnet/${DevelopmentSubnet}
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: DevelopmentVPCAttachment
        - Key: environment
          Value: development
        - Key: domain
          Value: development

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: 'Step Functions state machine with DynamoDB PutItem and GetItem'

Parameters:
  TableName:
    Type: String
    Default: my-table
    Description: Name of the DynamoDB table

Resources:
  DynamoDBTable:
    Type: AWS::DynamoDB::Table
    Properties:
      TableName: !Ref TableName
      AttributeDefinitions:
        - AttributeName: id
          AttributeType: S
      KeySchema:
        - AttributeName: id
          KeyType: HASH
      BillingMode: PAY_PER_REQUEST

  StateMachineRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: states.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: DynamoDBAccess
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - dynamodb:PutItem
                  - dynamodb:GetItem
                Resource: !GetAtt DynamoDBTable.Arn

  StateMachine:
    Type: AWS::StepFunctions::StateMachine
    Properties:
      StateMachineType: STANDARD
      RoleArn: !GetAtt StateMachineRole.Arn
      DefinitionString:
        Fn::Sub:
          - |-
            {
              "Comment": "Test workflow: PutItem then GetItem",
              "StartAt": "PutItem",
              "States": {
                "PutItem": {
                  "Type": "Task",
                  "Resource": "arn:aws:states:::dynamodb:putItem",
                  "Parameters": {
                    "TableName": "${TableName}",
                    "Item": {
                      "id": {
                        "S.$": "$.id"
                      },
                      "description": {
                        "S.$": "States.Format('Test item: {}', $.description)"
                      }
                    }
                  },
                  "ResultPath": "$.putItemResult",
                  "Next": "GetItem"
                },
                "GetItem": {
                  "Type": "Task",
                  "Resource": "arn:aws:states:::dynamodb:getItem",
                  "Parameters": {
                    "TableName": "${TableName}",
                    "Key": {
                      "id": {
                        "S.$": "$.id"
                      }
                    }
                  },
                  "ResultPath": "$.getItemResult",
                  "Next": "ReturnItem"
                },
                "ReturnItem": {
                  "Type": "Pass",
                  "InputPath": "$.getItemResult.Item",
                  "End": true
                }
              }
            }
          - TableName: !Ref TableName

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: 'Lambda-based CI/CD deployment environment with CodeDeploy blue-green canary traffic shifting'

Parameters:
  EnvironmentName:
    Type: String
    Default: production
    Description: Environment name for resource naming

Resources:
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # IAM Role for Lambda Execution (used by all Lambda functions)
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  LambdaExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: CodeDeployHookPermissions
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - codedeploy:PutLifecycleEventHookExecutionStatus
                Resource: '*'

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Main Lambda Function with an environment variable
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  MainLambdaFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      FunctionName: !Sub 'main-function-${EnvironmentName}'
      Handler: index.handler
      Role: !GetAtt LambdaExecutionRole.Arn
      Runtime: python3.12
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import json
          def handler(event, context):
              return {
                  'statusCode': 200,
                  'body': json.dumps('Hello from Main Lambda!')
              }
      Environment:
        Variables:
          ENVIRONMENT: !Ref EnvironmentName
      Description: Main Lambda function for the CI/CD deployment target

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Version of the Main Lambda
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  MainLambdaVersion:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Version
    Properties:
      FunctionName: !Ref MainLambdaFunction
      Description: !Sub 'Version 1 for ${EnvironmentName}'

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Alias for the Main Lambda (target of CodeDeploy deployments)
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  MainLambdaAlias:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Alias
    Properties:
      FunctionName: !Ref MainLambdaFunction
      FunctionVersion: !GetAtt MainLambdaVersion.Version
      Name: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-alias'
      Description: !Sub '${EnvironmentName} alias for blue-green deployments'

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # BeforeAllowTraffic Validation Hook Lambda
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  BeforeAllowTrafficHook:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      FunctionName: !Sub 'before-allow-traffic-hook-${EnvironmentName}'
      Handler: index.handler
      Role: !GetAtt LambdaExecutionRole.Arn
      Runtime: python3.12
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import json

Resources:

    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub 'pciautomationassumerole${AWS::Region}'

              - 'sts:AssumeRole'
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: pci-automation-policy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - 'ec2:ReleaseAddress'
                  - 'ec2:DescribeAddresses'
                  - 'ec2:DescribeSecurityGroups'
                  - 'ec2:DeleteSecurityGroup'
                  - 'ec2:RevokeSecurityGroupIngress'
                  - 'ec2:RevokeSecurityGroupEgress'
                Resource: '*'
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - 'autoscaling:UpdateAutoScalingGroup'
                  - 'autoscaling:DescribeAutoScalingGroups'
                Resource: '*'

  SSMDocumentCreatorFunctionRole:
    Type: 'AWS::IAM::Role'
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service:
                - 'lambda.amazonaws.com'
            Action:
              - 'sts:AssumeRole'
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - 'arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole'
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: ssm-document-creator-policy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - 'ssm:CreateDocument'
                  - 'ssm:DeleteDocument'
                  - 'ssm:UpdateDocument'
                  - 'ssm:ListDocuments'
                  - 'ssm:DescribeDocument'
                Resource: '*'

  SSMDocumentCreatorFunction:
    Type: 'AWS::Lambda::Function'
    Properties:
      Runtime: 'python3.14'
      Handler: 'index.handler'
      Role: !GetAtt SSMDocumentCreatorFunctionRole.Arn
      Timeout: 60
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import boto3
          import cfnresponse
          import json

          ssm = boto3.client('ssm')

          def handler(event, context):
              request_type = event['RequestType']
              props = event['ResourceProperties']
              doc_name = props['DocumentName']
              doc_content = props['DocumentContent']
              doc_type = props['DocumentType']

              try:
                  if request_type == 'Create' or request_type == 'Update':
                      if request_type == 'Update':
                          try:
                              ssm.delete_document(Name=doc_name)
                          except ssm.exceptions.from_code('InvalidDocument'):
                              pass
                      ssm.create_document(
                          Name=doc_name,
                          Content=doc_content,
                          DocumentType=doc_type
                      )
                  elif request_type == 'Delete':
                      try:
                          ssm.delete_document(Name=doc_name)
                      except ssm.exceptions.from_code('InvalidDocument'):
                          pass
                  cfnresponse.send(event, context, cfnresponse.SUCCESS, {'DocumentName': doc_name})
              except Exception as e:
                  cfnresponse.send(event, context, cfnresponse.FAILED, {'Error': str(e)})

  RevokeDefaultSgRulesCustomResource:
    Type: 'AWS::CloudFormation::CustomResource'
    Properties:
      ServiceToken: !GetAtt SSMDocumentCreatorFunction.Arn
      DocumentName: 'PCI-RestrictDefaultSgRules'
      DocumentType: 'Automation'
      DocumentContent:
        Fn::Sub:
          - |-
            {
              "schemaVersion": "0.3",
              "description": "Restrict VPC default security group traffic by revoking all ingress and egress rules",
              "assumeRole": "${RoleArn}",
              "parameters": {
                "VpcId": {
                  "type": "String",
                  "description": "(Required) The ID of the VPC whose default security group will be restricted"
                },
                "AutomationAssumeRole": {
                  "type": "String",
                  "description": "(Required) The ARN of the role that allows Automation to perform the actions on your behalf",
                  "default": "${RoleArn}"
                }
              },
              "mainSteps": [
                {
                  "name": "GetDefaultSecurityGroup",
                  "action": "aws:executeAwsApi",
                  "timeoutSeconds": 30,
                  "inputs": {
                    "Service": "ec2",
                    "Api": "DescribeSecurityGroups",
                    "Filters": [
                      {"Name": "vpc-id", "Values": ["{{ VpcId }}"]},
                      {"Name": "group-name", "Values": ["default"]}
                    ]
                  },
                  "outputs": [
                    {"Name": "GroupId", "Selector": "$.SecurityGroups[0].GroupId", "Type": "String"}
                  ]
                },
                {
                  "name": "RevokeAllIngressAndEgressRules",
                  "action": "aws:executeScript",
                  "timeoutSeconds": 120,
                  "inputs": {
                    "Service": "ec2",
                    "Runtime": "python3.9",
                    "Handler": "revoke_rules",
                    "Script": "import boto3\ndef revoke_rules(events, context):\n    ec2 = boto3.client('ec2', region_name=events['Region'])\n    group_id = events['GroupId']\n    response = ec2.describe_security_groups(GroupIds=[group_id])\n    sg = response['SecurityGroups'][0]\n    ingress = sg.get('IpPermissions', [])\n    egress = sg.get('IpPermissionsEgress', [])\n    if ingress:\n        ec2.revoke_security_group_ingress(GroupId=group_id, IpPermissions=ingress)\n    if egress:\n        ec2.revoke_security_group_egress(GroupId=group_id, IpPermissions=egress)\n    return {'IngressRulesRevoked': len(ingress), 'EgressRulesRevoked': len(egress)}",
                    "InputPayload": {
                      "GroupId": "{{ GetDefaultSecurityGroup.GroupId }}",
                      "Region": "{{ global:REGION }}"
                    }
                  },
                  "outputs": [
                    {"Name": "Output", "Selector": "$.Payload", "Type": "StringMap"}
                  ]
                }
              ]
            }
          - RoleArn: !GetAtt PCIAutomationRole.Arn

  DeleteUnusedSgCustomResource:
    Type: 'AWS::CloudFormation::CustomResource'
    Properties:
      ServiceToken: !GetAtt SSMDocumentCreatorFunction.Arn
      DocumentName: 'PCI-DeleteUnusedSecurityGroup'
      DocumentType: 'Automation'
      DocumentContent:
        Fn::Sub:
          - |-
            {
              "schemaVersion": "0.3",
              "description": "Delete an unused security group",
              "assumeRole": "${RoleArn}",
              "parameters": {
                "SecurityGroupId": {
                  "type": "String",
                  "description": "(Required) The ID of the security group to delete"

                  "type": "String",
                  "description": "(Required) The ARN of the role that allows Automation to perform the actions on your behalf",

                }

                }
              },
              "mainSteps": [
                {

                  "inputs": {
                    "Service": "ec2",
                    "Runtime": "python3.9",

  GoogleSiteVerificationToken:
    Type: String
    Default: placeholder-google-site-verification
    Description: Google site verification TXT record value (the full string e.g. google-site-verification=...)
  ZoomVerificationToken:
    Type: String
    Default: placeholder-zoom-verification
    Description: Zoom verification TXT record value
  ATProtoDID:
    Type: String
    Default: did=plc:placeholder-atproto
    Description: ATProto DID value for Bluesky/Fediverse domain verification
  DMARCEmail:
    Type: String
    Default: dmarc@earhustlesq.com
    Description: Email address for DMARC aggregate report receipts (rua)
  ZenDeskVerificationToken:
    Type: String
    Default: placeholder-zendesk-verify
    Description: ZenDesk subdomain verification TXT record value
  ZenDeskDomainValidationToken:
    Type: String
    Default: placeholder-zendesk-domain
    Description: ZenDesk domain validation TXT record value (at root domain)
  ZenDeskDKIMValue:
    Type: String
    Default: placeholder-zendesk-dkim
    Description: ZenDesk DKIM TXT record value for zendesk1._domainkey
  ZenDeskCNAMETarget:
    Type: String
    Default: placeholder.zendesk.com
    Description: ZenDesk domain validation CNAME target (FQDN without trailing dot)
  CampaignMonitorDKIMValue:
    Type: String
    Default: placeholder-cm-dkim
    Description: Campaign Monitor DKIM TXT record value for cm1._domainkey
  CampaignMonitorSPFInclude:
    Type: String
    Default: campaigns.cm
    Description: Campaign Monitor SPF include domain (added to main SPF record)
  CampaignMonitorMXTarget:
    Type: String
    Default: mx.campaigns.cm
    Description: Campaign Monitor MX target (FQDN without trailing dot)
  CampaignMonitorMXSubdomain:
    Type: String
    Default: cm
    Description: Subdomain label for Campaign Monitor MX record
  GoogleWorkspaceDKIMValue:
    Type: String

  SupercastDKIMSelector:

  SupercastDKIMValue:

    Default: bounces

  SupercastReturnPathCNAMETarget:
    Type: String
    Default: bounces.supercast.com
    Description: Target for Supercast return-path CNAME (FQDN without trailing dot)
  SquarespaceVerificationCNAMEHost:
    Type: String
    Default: placeholder-sq-verify
    Description: Host label for Squarespace domain verification CNAME (before the domain)
  FeedsCNAMETarget:
    Type: String

Conditions:
  OldSubdomainIsDifferent:
    Fn::Not:
      - Fn::Equals:
          - !Ref OldSubdomain
          - !Ref DomainName

Resources:
  # ============================================================
  # Route53 Hosted Zone
  # ============================================================
  HostedZone:
    Type: AWS::Route53::HostedZone
    Properties:
      Name: !Ref DomainName
      HostedZoneTags:
        - Key: prx:ops:environment
          Value: Production
        - Key: prx:dev:application
          Value: Ear Hustle

  # ============================================================
  # Root Domain TXT Records (combined into a single RecordSet
  # to avoid conflicts between multiple TXT records at the same name)
  # ============================================================
  RootTXTRecords:
    Type: AWS::Route53::RecordSet
    Properties:
      HostedZoneId: !Ref HostedZone
      Name: !Ref DomainName
      Type: TXT
      TTL: 300
      ResourceRecords:
        - !Sub '"v=spf1 include:_spf.google.com include:spf.mandrillapp.com include:spf.protection.outlook.com include:${CampaignMonitorSPFInclude} ~all"'
        - !Sub '"${GoogleSiteVerificationToken}"'
        - !Sub '"${ZoomVerificationToken}"'
        - !Sub '"${ZenDeskDomainValidationToken}"'

  # ============================================================
  # DMARC TXT Record
  # ============================================================
  DMARCRecord:
    Type: AWS::Route53::RecordSet
    Properties:
      HostedZoneId: !Ref HostedZone
      Name: !Sub '_dmarc.${DomainName}'
      Type: TXT
      TTL: 300
      ResourceRecords:
        - !Sub '"v=DMARC1; p=quarantine; pct=100; rua=mailto:${DMARCEmail}"'

  # ============================================================
  # ATProto TXT Record (Bluesky / Fediverse verification)
  # ============================================================
  ATProtoRecord:
    Type: AWS::Route53::RecordSet
    Properties:
      HostedZoneId: !Ref HostedZone
      Name: !Sub '_atproto.${DomainName}'
      Type: TXT
      TTL: 300
      ResourceRecords:
        - !Sub '"${ATProtoDID}"'

  # ============================================================
  # MX Records – G Suite (Primary Domain)
  # ============================================================
  GSuiteMXRecord:
    Type: AWS::Route53::RecordSet
    Properties:
      HostedZoneId: !Ref HostedZone
      Name: !Ref DomainName
      Type: MX
      SetIdentifier: PrimaryDomainMX
      TTL: 300
      ResourceRecords:
        - '1 ASPMX.L.GOOGLE.COM.'
        - '5 ALT1.ASPMX.L.GOOGLE.COM.'
        - '5 ALT2.ASPMX.L.GOOGLE.COM.'
        - '10 ALT3.ASPMX.L.GOOGLE.COM.'
        - '10 ALT4.ASPMX.L.GOOGLE.COM.'

  # ============================================================
  # MX Records – G Suite (Old Subdomain)
  # ============================================================
  OldSubdomainMXRecord:
    Type: AWS::Route53::RecordSet
    Properties:
      HostedZoneId: !Ref HostedZone
      Name: !Ref OldSubdomain
      Type: MX
      SetIdentifier: OldSubdomainMX
      TTL: 300
      ResourceRecords:
        - '1 ASPMX.L.GOOGLE.COM.'
        - '5 ALT1.ASPMX.L.GOOGLE.COM.'
        - '5 ALT2.ASPMX.L.GOOGLE.COM.'
        - '10 ALT3.ASPMX.L.GOOGLE.COM.'
        - '10 ALT4.ASPMX.L.GOOGLE.COM.'

  # ============================================================
  # A Records – Squarespace (Root Domain)
  # ============================================================
  SquarespaceARecords:
    Type: AWS::Route53::RecordSet
    Properties:
      HostedZoneId: !Ref HostedZone
      Name: !Ref DomainName
      Type: A
      TTL: 300
      ResourceRecords:
        - '198.185.159.144'
        - '198.49.23.144'
        - '198.49.23.145'
        - '199.14.31.192'

  # ============================================================
  # CNAME – www
  # ============================================================
  WWWCNAMERecord:
    Type: AWS::Route53::RecordSet
    Properties:
      HostedZoneId: !Ref HostedZone
      Name: !Sub 'www.${DomainName}'
      Type: CNAME
      TTL: 300
      ResourceRecords:
        - 'ext-sq.squarespace.com.'

  # ============================================================
  # CNAME – Podcast Feeds
  # ============================================================
  FeedsCNAMERecord:
    Type: AWS::Route53::RecordSet
    Properties:
      HostedZoneId: !Ref HostedZone
      Name: !Sub 'feeds.${DomainName}'
      Type: CNAME
      TTL: 300
      ResourceRecords:
        - !Sub '${FeedsCNAMETarget}.'

  # ============================================================
  # CNAME – Squarespace Domain Verification
  # ============================================================
  SquarespaceVerificationCNAME:
    Type: AWS::Route53::RecordSet
    Properties:
      HostedZoneId: !Ref HostedZone
      Name: !Sub '${SquarespaceVerificationCNAMEHost}.${DomainName}'
      Type: CNAME
      TTL: 300
      ResourceRecords:
        - 'verify.squarespace.com.'

  # ============================================================
  # TXT – ZenDesk Subdomain Verification
  # ============================================================
  ZenDeskVerificationRecord:
    Type: AWS::Route53::RecordSet
    Properties:
      HostedZoneId: !Ref HostedZone
      Name: !Sub '_zendesk.${DomainName}'
      Type: TXT
      TTL: 300
      ResourceRecords:
        - !Sub '"${ZenDeskVerificationToken}"'

  # ============================================================
  # TXT – ZenDesk DKIM
  # ============================================================
  ZenDeskDKIMRecord:
    Type: AWS::Route53::RecordSet
    Properties:
      HostedZoneId: !Ref HostedZone
      Name: !Sub 'zendesk1._domainkey.${DomainName}'
      Type: TXT
      TTL: 300
      ResourceRecords:
        - !Sub '"${ZenDeskDKIMValue}"'

  # ============================================================
  # CNAME – ZenDesk Domain Validation
  # ============================================================
  ZenDeskValidationCNAME:
    Type: AWS::Route53::RecordSet
    Properties:
      HostedZoneId: !Ref HostedZone
      Name: !Sub '${ZenDeskVerificationToken}.${DomainName}'
      Type: CNAME
      TTL: 300
      ResourceRecords:
        - !Sub '${ZenDeskCNAMETarget}.'

  # ============================================================
  # TXT – Campaign Monitor DKIM
  # ============================================================
  CampaignMonitorDKIMRecord:
    Type: AWS::Route53::RecordSet
    Properties:
      HostedZoneId: !Ref HostedZone
      Name: !Sub 'cm1._domainkey.${DomainName}'
      Type: TXT
      TTL: 300
      ResourceRecords:
        - !Sub '"${CampaignMonitorDKIMValue}"'

  # ============================================================
  # MX – Campaign Monitor
  # ============================================================
  CampaignMonitorMXRecord:
    Type: AWS::Route53::RecordSet
    Properties:
      HostedZoneId: !Ref HostedZone
      Name: !Sub '${CampaignMonitorMXSubdomain}.${DomainName}'
      Type: MX
      SetIdentifier: CampaignMonitorMX
      TTL: 300
      ResourceRecords:
        - !Sub '10 ${CampaignMonitorMXTarget}.'

  # ============================================================
  # TXT – Google Workspace DKIM
  # ============================================================
  GoogleWorkspaceDKIMRecord:
    Type: AWS::Route53::RecordSet
    Properties:
      HostedZoneId: !Ref HostedZone
      Name: !Sub 'google._domainkey.${DomainName}'
      Type: TXT
      TTL: 300
      ResourceRecords:
        - !Sub '"${GoogleWorkspaceDKIMValue}"'

  # ============================================================
  # TXT – Supercast DKIM
  # ============================================================
  SupercastDKIMRecord:
    Type: AWS::Route53::RecordSet
    Properties:
      HostedZoneId: !Ref HostedZone
      Name: !Sub '${SupercastDKIMSelector}._domainkey.${DomainName}'
      Type: TXT
      TTL: 300
      ResourceRecords:
        - !Sub '"${SupercastDKIMValue}"'

  # ============================================================
  # CNAME – Supercast Return-Path
  # ============================================================
  SupercastReturnPathCNAME:
    Type: AWS::Route53::RecordSet
    Properties:
      HostedZoneId: !Ref HostedZone
      Name: !Sub '${SupercastReturnPathHost}.${DomainName}'
      Type: CNAME
      TTL: 300
      ResourceRecords:
        - !Sub '${SupercastReturnPathCNAMETarget}.'

  # ============================================================
  # ACM Certificate – feeds subdomain (DNS validation)
  # CloudFormation automatically creates the validation CNAME
  # records in the hosted zone when HostedZoneId is specified.
  # ============================================================
  FeedsCertificate:
    Type: AWS::CertificateManager::Certificate
    Properties:
      DomainName: !Sub 'feeds.${DomainName}'
      ValidationMethod: DNS
      DomainValidationOptions:
        - DomainName: !Sub 'feeds.${DomainName}'
          HostedZoneId: !Ref HostedZone
      Tags:
        - Key: prx:ops:environment
          Value: Production
        - Key: prx:dev:application
          Value: Ear Hustle

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: "2010-09-09"
Description: >-
  CIS AWS Foundations Benchmark - VPC Flow Logs Automation with Reject Traffic
  Capture. Creates a CloudWatch Log Group with long retention, an IAM role for
  VPC Flow Logs delivery, a broad automation execution role, and two SSM
  Automation documents: a direct flow-log enabler and a Change Manager
  (change-approval) flow-log enabler.

Parameters:
  LogGroupRetentionDays:
    Type: Number
    Default: 3653
    Description: "Retention period in days for the CloudWatch Log Group (default 10 years for CIS compliance)"
  LogGroupName:
    Type: String
    Default: "/aws/vpc-flow-logs/cis-benchmark"
    Description: "Name of the CloudWatch Log Group that receives VPC Flow Log data"

Resources:
  # CloudWatch Log Group that receives the VPC Flow Log data
  FlowLogsLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Ref LogGroupName
      RetentionInDays: !Ref LogGroupRetentionDays
      Tags:
        - Key: Purpose
          Value: CIS-VPC-Flow-Logs

  # IAM role that VPC Flow Logs can assume to deliver logs to CloudWatch
  FlowLogsRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: vpc-flow-logs.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: VPCFlowLogsDeliveryPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: "2012-10-17"
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogGroup
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                  - logs:DescribeLogGroups
                  - logs:DescribeLogStreams
                Resource: !GetAtt FlowLogsLogGroup.Arn

  # Broad IAM role that SSM Automation assumes to run the automation steps
  AutomationExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: ssm.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: AutomationExecutionPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: "2012-10-17"
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ec2:CreateFlowLogs
                  - ec2:DescribeFlowLogs
                  - ec2:DeleteFlowLogs
                  - ec2:DescribeVpcs
                Resource: "*"
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - iam:PassRole
                Resource: !GetAtt FlowLogsRole.Arn
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogGroup
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                Resource: !GetAtt FlowLogsLogGroup.Arn
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:DescribeLogGroups
                  - logs:DescribeLogStreams
                Resource: "*"

  # SSM Automation document 1: directly enables VPC Flow Logs (REJECT traffic only)
  DirectFlowLogEnabler:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Document
    Properties:
      DocumentType: Automation
      DocumentFormat: YAML
      Content:
        schemaVersion: "2.2"
        description: "Enable VPC Flow Logs capturing REJECTED traffic on the target VPC"
        parameters:
          VpcId:
            type: String
            description: "(Required) The VPC ID to enable flow logs on"
          LogGroupName:
            type: String
            default: !Ref FlowLogsLogGroup
            description: "CloudWatch Log Group receiving the flow log data"
          RoleArn:
            type: String
            default: !GetAtt FlowLogsRole.Arn
            description: "IAM Role ARN with permissions to deliver flow logs to the Log Group"
        mainSteps:
          - name: EnableVpcFlowLogs
            action: aws:executeScript
            inputs:
              Runtime: python3.8
              Handler: handler
              Script: |
                import boto3
                def handler(event, context):
                    ec2client = boto3.client('ec2')
                    ec2client.create_flow_logs(
                        ResourceIds=[event['VpcId']],
                        ResourceType='VPC',
                        TrafficType='REJECT',
                        LogGroupName=event['LogGroupName'],
                        DeliverLogsPermissionArn=event['RoleArn']
                    )
                    return {'Success': True}
            InputPayload:
              VpcId: '{{ VpcId }}'
              LogGroupName: '{{ LogGroupName }}'
              RoleArn: '{{ RoleArn }}'
      Tags:
        - Key: Purpose
          Value: CIS-VPC-Flow-Logs-Direct

  # SSM Automation document 2: routes through Change Manager (approval gate) then enables flow logs
  ChangeManagerFlowLogEnabler:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Document
    Properties:
      DocumentType: Automation
      DocumentFormat: YAML
      Content:
        schemaVersion: "2.2"
        description: >-
          Request Change Manager approval then enable VPC Flow Logs capturing
          REJECTED traffic on the target VPC.
        parameters:
          VpcId:
            type: String
            description: "(Required) The VPC ID to enable flow logs on"
          LogGroupName:
            type: String
            default: !Ref FlowLogsLogGroup
            description: "CloudWatch Log Group receiving the flow log data"
          RoleArn:
            type: String
            default: !GetAtt FlowLogsRole.Arn
            description: "IAM Role ARN with permissions to deliver flow logs to the Log Group"
        mainSteps:
          - name: RequestApproval
            action: aws:approve
            inputs:
              ApprovalType: ChangeRequest
              Message: "Formal change request to enable VPC Flow Logs (REJECT traffic) on VPC {{ VpcId }}"
              MinRequiredApprovals: 1
          - name: EnableVpcFlowLogs
            action: aws:executeScript
            inputs:
              Runtime: python3.8
              Handler: handler
              Script: |
                import boto3

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >
  Scheduled workflow to close AWS Organization accounts tagged with
  "organizations:account-closure" = "REQUESTED". Runs hourly via EventBridge,
  invokes an EXPRESS Step Functions state machine that paginates through
  accounts, checks tags, describes active accounts, closes them, and tags
  with "ACKNOWLEDGED".

Parameters:
  CloseAccountTagKey:
    Type: String
    Default: "organizations:account-closure"
    Description: Tag key that flags an account for closure.
  CloseAccountTagValue:
    Type: String
    Default: "REQUESTED"
    Description: Tag value that marks an account for closure.
  AcknowledgedTagKey:
    Type: String
    Default: "ACKNOWLEDGED"
    Description: Tag key applied after an account is closed.

Resources:

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # CloudWatch Log Group – 365-day retention
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  StateMachineLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: /aws/vendedlogs/states/organization-account-closure-workflow
      RetentionInDays: 365

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # IAM role for Step Functions
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  StateMachineRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: states.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Path: /
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: OrganizationsActions
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - organizations:ListAccounts
                  - organizations:ListTagsForResource
                  - organizations:DescribeAccount
                  - organizations:CloseAccount
                  - organizations:TagResource
                Resource: "*"
        - PolicyName: CloudWatchLogsDelivery
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogDelivery
                  - logs:GetLogDelivery
                  - logs:UpdateLogDelivery
                  - logs:DeleteLogDelivery
                  - logs:ListLogDeliveries
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                  - logs:DescribeLogGroups
                Resource: "*"

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # EXPRESS Step Functions state machine
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  AccountClosureStateMachine:
    Type: AWS::StepFunctions::StateMachine
    Properties:
      StateMachineType: EXPRESS
      LoggingConfiguration:
        Destinations:
          - CloudWatchLogsLogGroup:
              LogGroupArn: !GetAtt StateMachineLogGroup.Arn
        IncludeExecutionData: true
        Level: ALL
      RoleArn: !GetAtt StateMachineRole.Arn
      DefinitionString: |
        {
          "Comment": "Close AWS Organization accounts tagged for closure. Paginates through accounts, checks tags, describes active accounts, closes them, and acknowledges.",
          "StartAt": "InitializePagination",
          "States": {
            "InitializePagination": {
              "Type": "Pass",
              "Result": {
                "nextToken": null
              },
              "ResultPath": "$.pagination",
              "Next": "ListAccountsPage"
            },
            "ListAccountsPage": {
              "Type": "Task",
              "Resource": "arn:aws:states:::aws-sdk:organizations:listAccounts",
              "Parameters": {
                "NextToken.$": "$.pagination.nextToken"
              },
              "ResultPath": "$.pageResult",
              "Next": "ProcessAccountsPage",
              "Retry": [
                {
                  "ErrorEquals": ["Organizations.AWSOrganizationsNotInUseException", "Organizations.TooManyRequestsException", "States.Timeout"],
                  "IntervalSeconds": 2,
                  "MaxAttempts": 5,
                  "BackoffRate": 2
                }
              ],
              "Catch": [
                {
                  "ErrorEquals": ["States.ALL"],
                  "ResultPath": "$.error",
                  "Next": "PaginationFailure"
                }
              ]
            },
            "ProcessAccountsPage": {
              "Type": "Map",
              "ItemsPath": "$.pageResult.Accounts",
              "MaxConcurrency": 10,
              "Iterator": {
                "StartAt": "GetAccountTags",
                "States": {
                  "GetAccountTags": {
                    "Type": "Task",
                    "Resource": "arn:aws:states:::aws-sdk:organizations:listTagsForResource",
                    "Parameters": {
                      "ResourceId.$": "$.Id"
                    },
                    "ResultPath": "$.tagsResult",
                    "Next": "CheckClosureTag",
                    "Retry": [
                      {
                        "ErrorEquals": ["Organizations.TooManyRequestsException", "Organizations.AWSOrganizationsNotInUseException"],
                        "IntervalSeconds": 1,
                        "MaxAttempts": 5,
                        "BackoffRate": 2
                      }
                    ],
                    "Catch": [
                      {
                        "ErrorEquals": ["States.ALL"],
                        "ResultPath": "$.error",
                        "Next": "AccountSkipped"
                      }
                    ]
                  },
                  "CheckClosureTag": {
                    "Type": "Pass",
                    "Parameters": {
                      "id.$": "$.Id",
                      "status.$": "$.Status",
                      "tagsStr.$": "States.JsonToString($.tagsResult.Tags)"
                    },
                    "ResultPath": "$.processed",
                    "Next": "IsTaggedForClosure"
                  },
                  "IsTaggedForClosure": {
                    "Type": "Choice",
                    "Choices": [
                      {
                        "Variable": "$.processed.tagsStr",
                        "StringMatches": "*-account-closure*REQUESTED*",
                        "Next": "DescribeAccount"
                      }
                    ],
                    "Default": "AccountSkipped"
                  },
                  "DescribeAccount": {
                    "Type": "Task",
                    "Resource": "arn:aws:states:::aws-sdk:organizations:describeAccount",
                    "Parameters": {
                      "AccountId.$": "$.processed.id"
                    },
                    "ResultPath": "$.descResult",
                    "Next": "IsAccountActive",
                    "Retry": [
                      {
                        "ErrorEquals": ["Organizations.TooManyRequestsException", "Organizations.AWSOrganizationsNotInUseException"],
                        "IntervalSeconds": 1,
                        "MaxAttempts": 5,
                        "BackoffRate": 2
                      }
                    ],
                    "Catch": [
                      {
                        "ErrorEquals": ["States.ALL"],
                        "ResultPath": "$.error",
                        "Next": "AccountSkipped"
                      }
                    ]
                  },
                  "IsAccountActive": {
                    "Type": "Choice",
                    "Choices": [
                      {
                        "Variable": "$.descResult.Account.Status",
                        "StringEquals": "ACTIVE",
                        "Next": "CloseAccount"
                      }
                    ],
                    "Default": "AccountSkipped"
                  },
                  "CloseAccount": {
                    "Type": "Task",
                    "Resource": "arn:aws:states:::aws-sdk:organizations:closeAccount",
                    "Parameters": {
                      "AccountId.$": "$.processed.id"
                    },
                    "ResultPath": "$.closeResult",
                    "Next": "TagAcknowledged",
                    "Retry": [
                      {
                        "ErrorEquals": ["Organizations.TooManyRequestsException"],
                        "IntervalSeconds": 2,
                        "MaxAttempts": 5,
                        "BackoffRate": 2
                      },
                      {
                        "ErrorEquals": ["Organizations.ConcurrentModificationException", "Organizations.AccountAlreadyClosedException", "Organizations.AccountNotFoundException"],
                        "IntervalSeconds": 5,
                        "MaxAttempts": 3,
                        "BackoffRate": 2
                      }
                    ],
                    "Catch": [
                      {
                        "ErrorEquals": ["States.ALL"],
                        "ResultPath": "$.error",
                        "Next": "AccountSkipped"
                      }
                    ]
                  },
                  "TagAcknowledged": {
                    "Type": "Task",
                    "Resource": "arn:aws:states:::aws-sdk:organizations:tagResource",
                    "Parameters": {
                      "ResourceId.$": "$.processed.id",
                      "Tags": [
                        {
                          "Key": "ACKNOWLEDGED",
                          "Value": "true"
                        }
                      ]
                    },
                    "Next": "AccountProcessed",
                    "Retry": [
                      {
                        "ErrorEquals": ["Organizations.TooManyRequestsException"],
                        "IntervalSeconds": 1,
                        "MaxAttempts": 5,
                        "BackoffRate": 2
                      },
                      {
                        "ErrorEquals": ["Organizations.AWSOrganizationsNotInUseException", "Organizations.ConcurrentModificationException"],
                        "IntervalSeconds": 2,
                        "MaxAttempts": 3,
                        "BackoffRate": 2
                      }
                    ],
                    "Catch": [
                      {
                        "ErrorEquals": ["States.ALL"],
                        "ResultPath": "$.error",
                        "Next": "AccountSkipped"
                      }
                    ]
                  },
                  "AccountProcessed": {
                    "Type": "Succeed"
                  },
                  "AccountSkipped": {
                    "Type": "Succeed"
                  }
                }
              },
              "Next": "HasMorePages"
            },
            "HasMorePages": {
              "Type": "Pass",
              "Parameters": {
                "nextToken.$": "$.pageResult.NextToken"
              },
              "ResultPath": "$.pagination",
              "Next": "CheckNextToken"
            },
            "CheckNextToken": {
              "Type": "Choice",
              "Choices": [
                {
                  "Variable": "$.pagination.nextToken",
                  "IsPresent": true,
                  "Next": "ListAccountsPage"
                }
              ],
              "Default": "ExecutionComplete"
            },
            "ExecutionComplete": {
              "Type": "Succeed"
            },
            "PaginationFailure": {
              "Type": "Fail",
              "Cause": "Failed to paginate through organization accounts after all retries."
            }
          }
        }

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # IAM role for EventBridge to start the state machine
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  EventBridgeRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: events.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Path: /
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: StartStateMachine
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action: states:StartExecution
                Resource: !Ref AccountClosureStateMachine

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # EventBridge scheduled rule – every hour
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  HourlyClosureRule:
    Type: AWS::Events::Rule
    Properties:
      Description: Triggers the account closure state machine every hour.
      ScheduleExpression: rate(1 hour)
      State: ENABLED
      Targets:
        - Arn: !Ref AccountClosureStateMachine
          Id: AccountClosureSfnTarget
          RoleArn: !GetAtt EventBridgeRole.Arn

      Tags:
        Name: cis-hardened-al2023-arm-distribution

  InfrastructureConfiguration:

    Properties:

      Tags:
        Name: cis-hardened-al2023-arm-pipeline

  # --------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Lifecycle policy – delete images after 6 months

            TagMap:

          Filter:
            Type: AGE
            Value: 180
            Unit: DAYS
      ResourceSelection:
        TagMap:

      Tags:
        Name: cis-hardened-al2023-arm-lifecycle

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: 'Serverless Maths MCP Server with Cognito authentication'

Parameters:
  DeploymentStage:
    Type: String
    Default: dev
    Description: Deployment stage name for the API Gateway
  UserPoolName:
    Type: String
    Default: maths-mcp-users
    Description: Name for the Cognito User Pool
  AppClientName:
    Type: String
    Default: maths-mcp-client
    Description: Name for the Cognito App Client

Resources:
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Lambda Function & IAM Role
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  LambdaExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole

  MathsMCPFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      FunctionName: !Ref AWS::StackName
      Runtime: python3.12
      Handler: index.handler
      Timeout: 30
      MemorySize: 512
      Role: !GetAtt LambdaExecutionRole.Arn
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import json

          def handler(event, context):
              resource_path = event.get('requestContext', {}).get('resourcePath', '')
              http_method = event.get('requestContext', {}).get('httpMethod', '')

              if resource_path == '/' and http_method == 'GET':
                  return {
                      'statusCode': 200,
                      'body': json.dumps({'status': 'healthy', 'service': 'maths-mcp'}),
                      'headers': {
                          'Content-Type': 'application/json',
                          'Access-Control-Allow-Origin': '*'
                      }
                  }

              return {
                  'statusCode': 200,
                  'body': json.dumps({
                      'message': 'MCP endpoint - placeholder',
                      'method': http_method,
                      'path': resource_path
                  }),
                  'headers': {
                      'Content-Type': 'application/json',
                      'Access-Control-Allow-Origin': '*'
                  }
              }

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Cognito User Pool & App Client
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  MathsMCPUserPool:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPool
    Properties:
      UserPoolName: !Ref UserPoolName
      Policies:
        PasswordPolicy:
          MinimumLength: 8
          RequireUppercase: true
          RequireLowercase: true
          RequireNumbers: true
          RequireSymbols: false
      AutoVerifiedAttributes:
        - email
      UsernameAttributes:
        - email
      Schema:
        - Name: email
          Required: true
          AttributeDataType: String
          Mutable: true

  MathsMCPUserPoolClient:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolClient
    Properties:
      ClientName: !Ref AppClientName
      UserPoolId: !Ref MathsMCPUserPool
      ExplicitAuthFlows:
        - ALLOW_USER_PASSWORD_AUTH
        - ALLOW_REFRESH_TOKEN_AUTH
      TokenValidityUnits:
        AccessToken: hours
        IdToken: hours
        RefreshToken: days
      AccessTokenValidity: 1
      IdTokenValidity: 1
      RefreshTokenValidity: 30
      GenerateSecret: false

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # API Gateway REST API (Regional)
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  MathsMCPApi:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::RestApi
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-api"
      Description: Maths MCP API Server
      EndpointConfiguration:
        Types:
          - REGIONAL

  MathsMCPAuthorizer:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Authorizer
    Properties:
      Name: CognitoAuthorizer
      Type: COGNITO_USER_POOLS
      RestApiId: !Ref MathsMCPApi
      IdentitySource: method.request.header.Authorization
      ProviderARNs:
        - !GetAtt MathsMCPUserPool.Arn

  # --- Root path "/" ---
  # GET / – public health check
  RootMethodGet:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Method
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref MathsMCPApi
      ResourceId: !GetAtt MathsMCPApi.RootResourceId
      HttpMethod: GET
      AuthorizationType: NONE
      Integration:
        Type: AWS_PROXY
        IntegrationHttpMethod: POST
        Uri: !Sub "arn:aws:apigateway:${AWS::Region}:lambda:path/2015-03-31/functions/${MathsMCPFunction.Arn}/invocations"

  # --- /mcp resource ---
  McpResource:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Resource
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref MathsMCPApi
      ParentId: !GetAtt MathsMCPApi.RootResourceId
      PathPart: mcp

  # POST /mcp – protected by Cognito authorizer
  McpPostMethod:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Method
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref MathsMCPApi
      ResourceId: !Ref McpResource
      HttpMethod: POST
      AuthorizationType: COGNITO_USER_POOLS
      AuthorizerId: !Ref MathsMCPAuthorizer
      Integration:
        Type: AWS_PROXY
        IntegrationHttpMethod: POST
        Uri: !Sub "arn:aws:apigateway:${AWS::Region}:lambda:path/2015-03-31/functions/${MathsMCPFunction.Arn}/invocations"

  # OPTIONS /mcp – CORS preflight (public)
  McpOptionsMethod:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Method
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref MathsMCPApi
      ResourceId: !Ref McpResource
      HttpMethod: OPTIONS
      AuthorizationType: NONE
      Integration:
        Type: MOCK
        RequestTemplates:
          application/json: '{"statusCode": 200}'
        IntegrationResponses:
          - StatusCode: 200
            ResponseParameters:
              method.response.header.Access-Control-Allow-Headers: "'Content-Type,X-Amz-Date,Authorization,X-Api-Key,X-Amz-Security-Token'"
              method.response.header.Access-Control-Allow-Methods: "'POST,OPTIONS'"
              method.response.header.Access-Control-Allow-Origin: "'*'"
      MethodResponses:
        - StatusCode: 200
          ResponseParameters:
            method.response.header.Access-Control-Allow-Headers: true
            method.response.header.Access-Control-Allow-Methods: true
            method.response.header.Access-Control-Allow-Origin: true

  # --- Lambda invocation permission for API Gateway ---
  LambdaApiPermission:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Permission
    Properties:
      FunctionName: !Ref MathsMCPFunction
      Action: lambda:InvokeFunction
      Principal: apigateway.amazonaws.com
      SourceArn: !Sub "arn:aws:execute-api:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:${MathsMCPApi}/*"

  # --- Deployment ---
  ApiDeployment:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Deployment
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref MathsMCPApi
      StageName: !Ref DeploymentStage
    DependsOn:
      - RootMethodGet
      - McpPostMethod
      - McpOptionsMethod

Outputs:
  ApiUrl:
    Description: API Gateway endpoint URL
    Value: !Sub "https://${MathsMCPApi}.execute-api.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com/${DeploymentStage}"
  UserPoolId:
    Description: Cognito User Pool ID
    Value: !Ref MathsMCPUserPool
  AppClientId:
    Description: Cognito App Client ID
    Value: !Ref MathsMCPUserPoolClient
  LambdaFunctionName:
    Description: Lambda function name
    Value: !Ref MathsMCPFunction

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: 'Amazon Verified Permissions policy store for Bookstore application with Cedar schema and static policies'

Resources:

  BookstorePolicyStore:
    Type: AWS::VerifiedPermissions::PolicyStore
    Properties:
      ValidationSettings:
        Mode: STRICT
      Schema:
        CedarJson: |
          {
            "Bookstore": {
              "entityTypes": {
                "Role": {},
                "User": {
                  "shape": {
                    "type": "Record",
                    "attributes": {
                      "yearsAsMember": {
                        "type": "Long",
                        "required": false
                      }
                    }
                  }
                },
                "Book": {
                  "shape": {
                    "type": "Record",
                    "attributes": {
                      "owner": {
                        "type": "Entity",
                        "name": "User",
                        "required": true
                      }
                    }
                  }
                }
              },
              "actions": {
                "View": {
                  "appliesTo": {
                    "principalTypes": ["User", "Role"],
                    "resourceTypes": ["Book"],
                    "context": {
                      "region": {
                        "type": "String",
                        "required": true
                      }
                    }
                  }
                },
                "ViewWithPremiumOffers": {
                  "appliesTo": {
                    "principalTypes": ["User", "Role"],
                    "resourceTypes": ["Book"],
                    "context": {
                      "region": {
                        "type": "String",
                        "required": true
                      }
                    }
                  }
                }
              }
            }
          }

  AdminViewAllBooksPolicy:
    Type: AWS::VerifiedPermissions::Policy
    DependsOn: BookstorePolicyStore
    Properties:
      PolicyStoreId: !Ref BookstorePolicyStore
      Definition:
        Static:
          Description: Permit Admin role members to view any book
          Statement: 'permit (principal is User in Role::"Admin", action == Bookstore::Action::"View", resource is Book);'

  ForbidAdminBobViewPolicy:
    Type: AWS::VerifiedPermissions::Policy
    DependsOn: BookstorePolicyStore
    Properties:
      PolicyStoreId: !Ref BookstorePolicyStore
      Definition:
        Static:
          Description: Forbid admin-bob from viewing books
          Statement: 'forbid (principal == User::"admin-bob", action == Bookstore::Action::"View", resource is Book);'

  PublisherViewOwnBooksPolicy:
    Type: AWS::VerifiedPermissions::Policy
    DependsOn: BookstorePolicyStore
    Properties:
      PolicyStoreId: !Ref BookstorePolicyStore
      Definition:
        Static:
          Description: Permit Publisher role members to view only books they own
          Statement: 'permit (principal is User in Role::"Publisher", action == Bookstore::Action::"View", resource is Book) when { resource.owner == principal };'

  SpecificUserViewSpecificBookPolicy:
    Type: AWS::VerifiedPermissions::Policy
    DependsOn: BookstorePolicyStore
    Properties:
      PolicyStoreId: !Ref BookstorePolicyStore
      Definition:
        Static:
          Description: Permit specific user to view a specific book
          Statement: 'permit (principal == User::"specific-user", action == Bookstore::Action::"View", resource == Book::"specific-book");'

  CustomerViewPremiumOffersPolicy:
    Type: AWS::VerifiedPermissions::Policy
    DependsOn: BookstorePolicyStore
    Properties:
      PolicyStoreId: !Ref BookstorePolicyStore
      Definition:
        Static:
          Description: Permit Customer role members with 2+ years membership to view premium offers
          Statement: 'permit (principal is User in Role::"Customer", action == Bookstore::Action::"ViewWithPremiumOffers", resource is Book) when { principal.yearsAsMember >= 2 };'

  ForbidCustomerNoPremiumPolicy:
    Type: AWS::VerifiedPermissions::Policy
    DependsOn: BookstorePolicyStore
    Properties:
      PolicyStoreId: !Ref BookstorePolicyStore
      Definition:
        Static:
          Description: Forbid Customer role members with less than 2 years membership from viewing premium offers
          Statement: 'forbid (principal is User in Role::"Customer", action == Bookstore::Action::"ViewWithPremiumOffers", resource is Book) when { principal.yearsAsMember < 2 };'

  ForbidNonUSRegionPolicy:
    Type: AWS::VerifiedPermissions::Policy
    DependsOn: BookstorePolicyStore
    Properties:
      PolicyStoreId: !Ref BookstorePolicyStore
      Definition:
        Static:
          Description: Forbid View and ViewWithPremiumOffers when request region is not US
          Statement: 'forbid (principal, action in [Bookstore::Action::"View", Bookstore::Action::"ViewWithPremiumOffers"], resource) when { context.region != "US" };'

  PolicyStoreIdParameter:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter
    Properties:
      Name: /bookstore/policy-store-id
      Type: String
      Value: !Ref BookstorePolicyStore
      Description: Policy Store ID for the Bookstore application

Outputs:
  PolicyStoreId:
    Description: Policy Store ID
    Value: !Ref BookstorePolicyStore
  PolicyStoreArn:
    Description: Policy Store ARN
    Value: !GetAtt BookstorePolicyStore.Arn

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: 'CloudFormation template for RAPIDS AI SageMaker notebook instance'

Resources:
  SageMakerRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: sagemaker.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AmazonSageMakerFullAccess
      Path: /

  RapidAILifecycleConfig:
    Type: AWS::SageMaker::NotebookInstanceLifecycleConfig
    Properties:
      NotebookInstanceLifecycleConfigName: rapidsai-lifecycle-config
      OnCreate:
        - Content:
            Fn::Base64: !Sub |
              #!/bin/bash
              set -e

              # Determine which conda installation is present
              CONDA_BASE=""
              if [ -d "/home/ec2-user/anaconda3" ]; then
                  CONDA_BASE="/home/ec2-user/anaconda3"
              elif [ -d "/home/ec2-user/miniconda3" ]; then
                  CONDA_BASE="/home/ec2-user/miniconda3"
              else
                  # Install Miniconda if no conda is found
                  wget -q https://repo.anaconda.com/miniconda/Miniconda3-latest-Linux-x86_64.sh -O /home/ec2-user/miniconda.sh
                  bash /home/ec2-user/miniconda.sh -b -p /home/ec2-user/miniconda3
                  rm /home/ec2-user/miniconda.sh
                  CONDA_BASE="/home/ec2-user/miniconda3"
              fi

              # Initialize conda for bash
              source "$CONDA_BASE/etc/profile.d/conda.sh"
              conda config --set channel_priority strict

              # Create RAPIDS conda environment
              conda create -n rapids-ai -c rapidsai -c conda-forge -c defaults \
                  python=3.10 rapids=24.12 ipykernel jupyter -y

              # Register the RAPIDS kernel with Jupyter
              "$CONDA_BASE/envs/rapids-ai/bin/python" -m ipykernel install \
                  --name rapids-ai \
                  --display-name "RAPIDS AI (Python 3.10)" \
                  --user

              # Clean conda cache to save space
              conda clean -y --all
      OnStart:
        - Content:
            Fn::Base64: !Sub |
              #!/bin/bash
              set -e

              # Re-register the RAPIDS kernel on start
              CONDA_BASE=""
              if [ -d "/home/ec2-user/anaconda3" ]; then
                  CONDA_BASE="/home/ec2-user/anaconda3"
              elif [ -d "/home/ec2-user/miniconda3" ]; then
                  CONDA_BASE="/home/ec2-user/miniconda3"
              fi

              if [ -n "$CONDA_BASE" ] && [ -d "$CONDA_BASE/envs/rapids-ai" ]; then
                  "$CONDA_BASE/envs/rapids-ai/bin/python" -m ipykernel install \
                      --name rapids-ai \
                      --display-name "RAPIDS AI (Python 3.10)" \
                      --user
              fi

  RapidAINotebook:
    Type: AWS::SageMaker::NotebookInstance
    Properties:
      NotebookInstanceName: rapidsai
      InstanceType: ml.t3.medium
      RoleArn: !GetAtt SageMakerRole.Arn
      VolumeSizeInGB: 50
      LifecycleConfigName: !Ref RapidAILifecycleConfig
      DefaultCodeRepository: https://github.com/rapidsai/notebooks
      DirectInternetAccess: Enabled
      RootAccess: Enabled
