AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >
  Self-contained ECS Fargate microservice with Cloud Map service discovery,
  application auto scaling, and a custom VPC.

Parameters:
  EnvironmentName:
    Type: String
    Description: Name of the environment (e.g. dev, staging, prod).
    Default: dev
  ServiceName:
    Type: String
    Description: Name of the microservice.
    Default: myservice
  ContainerImage:
    Type: String
    Description: Container image URI (e.g. nginx:latest).
    Default: nginx:latest
  ContainerPort:
    Type: Number
    Description: Port the container listens on.
    Default: 80
  Cpu:
    Type: String
    Description: CPU units for the Fargate task (256, 512, 1024, 2048, 4096).
    Default: '256'
    AllowedValues:
      - '256'
      - '512'
      - '1024'
      - '2048'
      - '4096'
  Memory:
    Type: String
    Description: Memory in MiB for the Fargate task (512, 1024, 2048, 3072, 4096, 8192).
    Default: '512'
    AllowedValues:
      - '512'
      - '1024'
      - '2048'
      - '3072'
      - '4096'
      - '8192'
  DesiredTaskCount:
    Type: Number
    Description: Desired number of running tasks.
    Default: 2
    MinValue: 1
    MaxValue: 10
  CustomTaskRoleArn:
    Type: String
    Description: >
      Optional ARN of an IAM role the container can assume.
      Leave blank to use the task execution role only.
    Default: ''

Conditions:
  HasCustomTaskRole: !Not [!Equals [!Ref CustomTaskRoleArn, '']]

Resources:
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # VPC
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  VPC:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: 10.0.0.0/16
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${EnvironmentName}-vpc

  InternetGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::InternetGateway
    Properties:
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${EnvironmentName}-igw

  VPCGatewayAttachment:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      InternetGatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  # Public subnet
  PublicSubnet:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: 10.0.0.0/24
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${EnvironmentName}-public-subnet

  # Private subnets (two AZs)
  PrivateSubnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: 10.0.1.0/24
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${EnvironmentName}-private-subnet-1

  PrivateSubnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: 10.0.2.0/24
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [1, !GetAZs '']
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${EnvironmentName}-private-subnet-2

  # Elastic IP for NAT Gateway
  NatGatewayEIP:
    Type: AWS::EC2::EIP
    Properties:
      Domain: vpc

  # NAT Gateway in the public subnet
  NatGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NatGateway
    Properties:
      AllocationId: !GetAtt NatGatewayEIP.AllocationId
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${EnvironmentName}-natgw

  # Route tables
  PublicRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${EnvironmentName}-public-rt

  PublicRoute:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    DependsOn: VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      GatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  PublicSubnetRouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable

  PrivateRouteTable1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${EnvironmentName}-private-rt-1

  PrivateRoute1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable1
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      NatGatewayId: !Ref NatGateway

  PrivateSubnet1RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet1
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable1

  PrivateRouteTable2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${EnvironmentName}-private-rt-2

  PrivateRoute2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable2
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      NatGatewayId: !Ref NatGateway

  PrivateSubnet2RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet2
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable2

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # CloudWatch Log Group
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  EcsLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Sub /ecs/${EnvironmentName}/${ServiceName}
      RetentionInDays: 30

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # IAM Roles
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  EcsTaskExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: ecs-tasks.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AmazonECSTaskExecutionRolePolicy
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${EnvironmentName}-${ServiceName}-exec-role

  EcsTaskRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Condition: HasCustomTaskRole
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: ecs-tasks.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${EnvironmentName}-${ServiceName}-task-role

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Cloud Map Service Discovery
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  ServiceDiscoveryNamespace:
    Type: AWS::ServiceDiscovery::PrivateDnsNamespace
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub ${EnvironmentName}.internal
      Vpc: !Ref VPC
      Description: !Sub Private DNS namespace for ${EnvironmentName} services

  ServiceDiscoveryService:
    Type: AWS::ServiceDiscovery::Service
    Properties:
      Name: !Ref ServiceName
      DnsConfig:
        NamespaceId: !Ref ServiceDiscoveryNamespace
        DnsRecords:
          - Type: SRV
            TTL: 60
      HealthCheckCustomConfig:
        FailureThreshold: 1
      NamespaceId: !Ref ServiceDiscoveryNamespace

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Security Group
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  EcsSecurityGroup:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup
    Properties:
      GroupDescription: Security group for ECS tasks allowing ingress from VPC CIDR
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      SecurityGroupIngress:
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: !Ref ContainerPort
          ToPort: !Ref ContainerPort
          CidrIp: 10.0.0.0/16
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 0
          ToPort: 65535
          CidrIp: 10.0.0.0/16
        - IpProtocol: udp
          FromPort: 0
          ToPort: 65535
          CidrIp: 10.0.0.0/16
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${EnvironmentName}-${ServiceName}-sg

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # ECS Cluster
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  EcsCluster:
    Type: AWS::ECS::Cluster
    Properties:
      ClusterName: !Sub ${EnvironmentName}-cluster
      ClusterSettings:
        - Name: containerInsights
          Value: enabled

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # ECS Task Definition
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  EcsTaskDefinition:
    Type: AWS::ECS::TaskDefinition
    Properties:
      Family: !Sub ${EnvironmentName}-${ServiceName}
      Cpu: !Ref Cpu
      Memory: !Ref Memory
      NetworkMode: awsvpc
      RequiresCompatibilities:
        - FARGATE
      ExecutionRoleArn: !GetAtt EcsTaskExecutionRole.Arn
      TaskRoleArn: !If [HasCustomTaskRole, !Ref CustomTaskRoleArn, !Ref EcsTaskRole]
      ContainerDefinitions:
        - Name: !Ref ServiceName
          Image: !Ref ContainerImage
          PortMappings:
            - ContainerPort: !Ref ContainerPort
              Protocol: tcp
          LogConfiguration:
            LogDriver: awslogs
            Options:
              awslogs-group: !Ref EcsLogGroup
              awslogs-region: !Ref AWS::Region
              awslogs-stream-prefix: !Ref ServiceName
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${EnvironmentName}-${ServiceName}-taskdef

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # ECS Service
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  EcsService:
    Type: AWS::ECS::Service
    DependsOn:
      - ServiceDiscoveryService
    Properties:
      ServiceName: !Ref ServiceName
      Cluster: !Ref EcsCluster
      TaskDefinition: !Ref EcsTaskDefinition
      DesiredCount: !Ref DesiredTaskCount
      LaunchType: FARGATE
      NetworkConfiguration:
        AwsvpcConfiguration:
          AssignPublicIp: DISABLED
          Subnets:
            - !Ref PrivateSubnet1
            - !Ref PrivateSubnet2
          SecurityGroups:
            - !GetAtt EcsSecurityGroup.GroupId
      ServiceRegistries:
        - RegistryArn: !GetAtt ServiceDiscoveryService.Arn
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${EnvironmentName}-${ServiceName}-service

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Application Auto Scaling
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  EcsServiceScalableTarget:
    Type: AWS::ApplicationAutoScaling::ScalableTarget
    Properties:
      ServiceNamespace: ecs
      ScalableDimension: ecs:service:DesiredCount
      ResourceId: !Sub service/${EcsCluster}/${EcsService}
      MinCapacity: 2
      MaxCapacity: 10
      RoleARN: !GetAtt EcsAutoScalingRole.Arn

  EcsAutoScalingRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: application-autoscaling.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AmazonEC2ContainerServiceAutoscaleRole
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${EnvironmentName}-${ServiceName}-asg-role

  # Scale-out policy (target value 70)
  ScaleOutPolicy:
    Type: AWS::ApplicationAutoScaling::ScalingPolicy
    Properties:
      PolicyName: !Sub ${EnvironmentName}-${ServiceName}-scale-out
      PolicyType: StepScaling
      ScalingTargetId: !Ref EcsServiceScalableTarget
      StepScalingPolicyConfiguration:
        AdjustmentType: ChangeInCapacity
        Cooldown: 60
        MetricAggregationType: Average
        StepAdjustments:
          - MetricIntervalLowerBound: 0
            ScalingAdjustment: 2

  # Scale-in policy (target value 20)
  ScaleInPolicy:
    Type: AWS::ApplicationAutoScaling::ScalingPolicy
    Properties:
      PolicyName: !Sub ${EnvironmentName}-${ServiceName}-scale-in
      PolicyType: StepScaling
      ScalingTargetId: !Ref EcsServiceScalableTarget
      StepScalingPolicyConfiguration:
        AdjustmentType: ChangeInCapacity
        Cooldown: 60
        MetricAggregationType: Average
        StepAdjustments:
          - MetricIntervalLowerBound: 0
            ScalingAdjustment: -1

  # CloudWatch alarm for scale-out (CPU >= 70)
  CpuHighAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub ${EnvironmentName}-${ServiceName}-cpu-high
      AlarmDescription: !Sub Alarm when CPU >= 70% for ${ServiceName}
      MetricName: CPUUtilization
      Namespace: AWS/ECS
      Dimensions:
        - Name: ClusterName
          Value: !Ref EcsCluster
        - Name: ServiceName
          Value: !Ref EcsService
      Statistic: Average
      Period: 60
      EvaluationPeriods: 2
      Threshold: 70
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold
      TreatMissingData: missing
      AlarmActions:
        - !Ref ScaleOutPolicy

  # CloudWatch alarm for scale-in (CPU <= 20)
  CpuLowAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub ${EnvironmentName}-${ServiceName}-cpu-low
      AlarmDescription: !Sub Alarm when CPU <= 20% for ${ServiceName}
      MetricName: CPUUtilization
      Namespace: AWS/ECS
      Dimensions:
        - Name: ClusterName
          Value: !Ref EcsCluster
        - Name: ServiceName
          Value: !Ref EcsService
      Statistic: Average
      Period: 60
      EvaluationPeriods: 2
      Threshold: 20
      ComparisonOperator: LessThanOrEqualToThreshold
      TreatMissingData: missing
      AlarmActions:
        - !Ref ScaleInPolicy

Outputs:
  VpcId:
    Description: VPC ID
    Value: !Ref VPC
  EcsClusterName:
    Description: ECS Cluster name
    Value: !Ref EcsCluster
  EcsServiceName:
    Description: ECS Service name
    Value: !Ref EcsService
  ServiceDiscoveryNamespaceId:
    Description: Cloud Map namespace ID
    Value: !Ref ServiceDiscoveryNamespace
  ServiceDiscoveryServiceId:
    Description: Cloud Map service ID
    Value: !Ref ServiceDiscoveryService
  LogGroupName:
    Description: CloudWatch Log Group
    Value: !Ref EcsLogGroup

final_template:
AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: 'Hybrid interconnect network backbone for OCI demonstration with Transit Gateway, VPN, and encrypted VPC Flow Logs'

Parameters:
  VPCCIDR:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.94.0.0/16
    Description: CIDR block for the VPC
  SubnetCIDR:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.94.10.0/24
    Description: CIDR block for the private subnet
  InternalCIDR:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.94.0.0/16
    Description: Internal CIDR range allowed for HTTPS inbound to the security group (e.g. 10.94.0.0/16)
  OCIBackboneCIDR:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.0.0/8
    Description: OCI backbone CIDR range for HTTPS outbound and Transit Gateway route (e.g. 10.0.0.0/8)
  CreateVPNResources:
    Type: String
    Default: 'false'
    AllowedValues:
      - 'true'
      - 'false'
    Description: Whether to create VPN resources (Customer Gateway and VPN Connection) to OCI
  OCIBgpAsn:
    Type: Number
    Default: 65000
    Description: BGP ASN for the OCI Customer Gateway (required even for static routes)
  OCIExternalPublicIP:
    Type: String
    Default: '203.0.113.1'
    Description: Public IP address of the OCI Customer Gateway

Conditions:
  CreateVPN: !Equals [!Ref CreateVPNResources, 'true']

Resources:
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # KMS Key for VPC Flow Log encryption (customer-managed, rotation enabled)
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  FlowLogKMSKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    Properties:
      Description: Customer-managed KMS key for VPC Flow Log encryption
      KeyUsage: ENCRYPT_DECRYPT
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: Enable IAM User Permissions
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root
            Action: kms:*
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: Allow VPC Flow Logs to use the key
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: !Sub vpc-flow-logs.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - kms:Encrypt
              - kms:Decrypt
              - kms:ReEncrypt*
              - kms:GenerateDataKey*
              - kms:DescribeKey
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: Allow CloudWatch Logs to use the key
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: !Sub logs.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - kms:Encrypt
              - kms:Decrypt
              - kms:ReEncrypt*
              - kms:GenerateDataKey*
              - kms:DescribeKey
            Resource: '*'
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      PendingWindowInDays: 30

  FlowLogKMSKeyAlias:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Alias
    Properties:
      AliasName: alias/hybrid-backbone-flow-log-key
      TargetKeyId: !Ref FlowLogKMSKey

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # VPC and core networking
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  VPC:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: !Ref VPCCIDR
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: HybridBackboneVPC

  InternetGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::InternetGateway
    Properties:
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: HybridBackboneIGW

  VPCGatewayAttachment:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      InternetGatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  # Private subnet in the first available Availability Zone
  Subnet:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !Ref SubnetCIDR
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: HybridBackboneSubnet

  RouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: HybridBackboneRouteTable

  DefaultRoute:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    DependsOn: VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref RouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      GatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  SubnetRouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref RouteTable
      SubnetId: !Ref Subnet

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Transit Gateway
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  TransitGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::TransitGateway
    Properties:
      Description: Transit Gateway for hybrid interconnect with OCI
      AmazonSideAsn: 64512
      AutoAcceptSharedAttachments: disable
      DefaultRouteTableAssociation: enable
      DefaultRouteTablePropagation: enable
      DnsSupport: enable
      VpnEcmpSupport: enable
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: HybridBackboneTGW

  TransitGatewayVPCAttachment:
    Type: AWS::EC2::TransitGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref Subnet
      TransitGatewayId: !Ref TransitGateway
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: HybridBackboneTGWVPCAttachment

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Security Group
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  SecurityGroup:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup
    Properties:
      GroupDescription: Security group for hybrid interconnect workload
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: HybridBackboneSG

  SecurityGroupInboundHTTPS:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroupIngress
    Properties:
      GroupId: !Ref SecurityGroup
      IpProtocol: tcp
      FromPort: 443
      ToPort: 443
      CidrIp: !Ref InternalCIDR

  SecurityGroupOutboundHTTPS:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroupEgress
    Properties:
      GroupId: !Ref SecurityGroup
      IpProtocol: tcp
      FromPort: 443
      ToPort: 443
      CidrIp: !Ref OCIBackboneCIDR

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # VPC Flow Logs (CloudWatch destination, 30-day retention, KMS encrypted)
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  FlowLogRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: !Sub vpc-flow-logs.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: FlowLogPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: "2010-09-09"
Description: >
  SQS audit queue with KMS encryption, key rotation, optional dead letter queue,
  CloudWatch alarms for old messages and DLQ activity, and SNS alert notifications.
  DLQ is created only for non-dev environments.

Parameters:
  Environment:
    Type: String
    AllowedValues:
      - dev
      - staging
      - prod
    Default: dev
    Description: Deployment environment. DLQ is created only in non-dev environments.

  MessageRetentionPeriod:
    Type: Number
    Default: 345600
    Description: Message retention period in seconds (default 4 days = 345600).

  VisibilityTimeout:
    Type: Number
    Default: 30
    Description: Visibility timeout in seconds (default 30).

  AlarmEmail:
    Type: String
    Default: admin@example.com
    Description: Email address that receives SNS alarm notifications.

  OldMessageThreshold:
    Type: Number
    Default: 300
    Description: >
      Threshold in seconds for the ApproximateAgeOfOldestMessage alarm
      on the main audit queue (default 300 = 5 minutes).

  DlqMaxReceiveCount:
    Type: Number
    Default: 3
    Description: >
      Maximum number of times a message can be received before it is sent
      to the dead letter queue. Only applies when DLQ is enabled.

Conditions:
  IsNonDev: !Not [!Equals [!Ref Environment, "dev"]]

Resources:
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # KMS key for SQS queue encryption – key rotation enabled
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  AuditKMSKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    Properties:
      Description: !Sub "KMS key for SQS audit queue encryption in ${Environment}"
      KeyUsage: ENCRYPT_DECRYPT
      KeySpec: SYMMETRIC_DEFAULT
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      PendingWindowInDays: 7
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Id: sqs-audit-kms-key-policy
        Statement:
          - Sid: Enable IAM User Permissions
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub "arn:aws:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root"
            Action: kms:*
            Resource: "*"
          - Sid: Allow SQS to use the key
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: sqs.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - kms:Decrypt
              - kms:GenerateDataKey
            Resource: "*"
          - Sid: Allow SNS to use the key
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: sns.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - kms:Decrypt
              - kms:GenerateDataKey
            Resource: "*"

  AuditKMSAlias:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Alias
    Properties:
      AliasName: !Sub "alias/audit-sqs-${Environment}"
      TargetKeyId: !Ref AuditKMSKey

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Dead letter queue – created only for non-dev environments
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  DeadLetterQueue:
    Condition: IsNonDev
    Type: AWS::SQS::Queue
    Properties:
      QueueName: !Sub "audit-dlq-${Environment}"
      MessageRetentionPeriod: 1209600
      VisibilityTimeout: 30
      KmsMasterKeyId: !Ref AuditKMSKey
      KmsDataKeyReusePeriodSeconds: 300

  DeadLetterQueuePolicy:
    Condition: IsNonDev
    Type: AWS::SQS::QueuePolicy
    Properties:
      Queues:
        - !Ref DeadLetterQueue
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: sqs.amazonaws.com
            Action: sqs:SendMessage
            Resource: !GetAtt DeadLetterQueue.Arn
            Condition:
              ArnEquals:
                aws:SourceArn: !GetAtt AuditQueue.Arn

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Main audit queue – KMS encrypted, optional redrive to DLQ
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  AuditQueue:
    Type: AWS::SQS::Queue
    Properties:
      QueueName: !Sub "audit-queue-${Environment}"
      KmsMasterKeyId: !Ref AuditKMSKey
      KmsDataKeyReusePeriodSeconds: 300
      MessageRetentionPeriod: !Ref MessageRetentionPeriod
      VisibilityTimeout: !Ref VisibilityTimeout
      RedrivePolicy:
        Fn::If:
          - IsNonDev
          -
            deadLetterTargetArn: !GetAtt DeadLetterQueue.Arn
            maxReceiveCount: !Ref DlqMaxReceiveCount
          - !Ref AWS::NoValue

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # SNS topic and subscription for alarm notifications
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  AlarmSNSTopic:
    Type: AWS::SNS::Topic
    Properties:
      TopicName: !Sub "audit-alarms-${Environment}"
      DisplayName: !Sub "Audit Queue Alarms - ${Environment}"
      KmsMasterKeyId: !Ref AuditKMSKey

  AlarmSNSSubscription:
    Type: AWS::SNS::Subscription
    Properties:
      TopicArn: !Ref AlarmSNSTopic
      Protocol: email
      Endpoint: !Ref AlarmEmail

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # CloudWatch alarm – old messages on the main audit queue
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  OldMessagesAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub "audit-queue-old-messages-${Environment}"
      AlarmDescription: !Sub
        - "Alarm when the oldest message on the audit queue exceeds ${Threshold} seconds in ${Env}"
        - Threshold: !Ref OldMessageThreshold
          Env: !Ref Environment
      Namespace: AWS/SQS
      MetricName: ApproximateAgeOfOldestMessage
      Dimensions:
        - Name: QueueName
          Value: !GetAtt AuditQueue.QueueName
      Statistic: Maximum
      Period: 300
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      Threshold: !Ref OldMessageThreshold
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanThreshold
      TreatMissingData: notBreaching
      AlarmActions:
        - !Ref AlarmSNSTopic
      InsufficientDataActions:
        - !Ref AlarmSNSTopic
      OKActions:
        - !Ref AlarmSNSTopic

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # CloudWatch alarm – DLQ activity (only for non-dev)
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  DLQMessagesAlarm:
    Condition: IsNonDev
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub "audit-dlq-activity-${Environment}"
      AlarmDescription: !Sub
        - "Alarm when messages appear in the dead letter queue in ${Env}"
        - Env: !Ref Environment
      Namespace: AWS/SQS
      MetricName: ApproximateNumberOfMessagesVisible
      Dimensions:
        - Name: QueueName
          Value: !GetAtt DeadLetterQueue.QueueName
      Statistic: Sum
      Period: 300
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      Threshold: 0
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanThreshold
      TreatMissingData: notBreaching
      AlarmActions:
        - !Ref AlarmSNSTopic
      InsufficientDataActions:
        - !Ref AlarmSNSTopic
      OKActions:
        - !Ref AlarmSNSTopic

Resources:

  APIDataTable:

    Properties:
      TableName: APIDataTable
      AttributeDefinitions:
        - AttributeName: hk

        - AttributeName: sk
          AttributeType: S

        - AttributeName: hk

  # ============================================================================

  # ============================================================================

    Type: AWS::AppSync::ApiKey

  # ============================================================================

  # ============================================================================
  GraphQLSchema:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::GraphQLSchema
    Properties:
      ApiId: !GetAtt CryptoTickerAPI.ApiId
      Definition: |
        type Query {
          ticker(ticker: String!): TickerInfo
        }

        type TickerInfo {
          ticker: String
          price: Float
          timestamp: AWSDateTime
          priceHistory(limit: Int, nextToken: String): TickerConnection
        }

        type TickerPriceRecord {
          ticker: String
          price: Float
          timestamp: AWSDateTime
        }

        type TickerConnection {
          items: [TickerPriceRecord]
          nextToken: String
        }

  # ============================================================================

    Type: AWS::IAM::Role

        - PolicyName: AppSyncDynamoDBAccess

        Endpoint: https://api.coingecko.com
      ServiceRoleArn: !GetAtt AppSyncServiceRole.Arn

  DynamoDBDataSource:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::DataSource
    Properties:
      ApiId: !GetAtt CryptoTickerAPI.ApiId

            "query": {

      ResponseMappingTemplate: |
        #if($ctx.result.statusCode == 200)
          #set($body = $util.parseJson($ctx.result.body))
          $util.qr($ctx.stash.put("ticker", $ctx.args.ticker))
          $util.qr($ctx.stash.put("price", $body.get($ctx.args.ticker).usd))
          $util.qr($ctx.stash.put("timestamp", $util.time.nowISO8601()))
          {}
        #else

        #end

  StorePriceFunction:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::FunctionConfiguration
    Properties:
      ApiId: !GetAtt CryptoTickerAPI.ApiId
      Name: storePriceRecord
      DataSourceName: !GetAtt DynamoDBDataSource.Name
      FunctionVersion: 2018-05-29
      RequestMappingTemplate: |
        {
          "version": "2018-05-29",
          "operation": "PutItem",
          "key": {
            "hk": $util.dynamodb.toDynamoDBJson($ctx.stash.ticker),
            "sk": $util.dynamodb.toDynamoDBJson("PRICE#$ctx.stash.timestamp")

          "attributeValues": $util.dynamodb.toMapJson({
            "ticker": $ctx.stash.ticker,

        })

  # ============================================================================
  # Resolvers
  # ============================================================================
  TickerResolver:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::Resolver
    Properties:
      ApiId: !GetAtt CryptoTickerAPI.ApiId
      TypeName: Query

      PipelineConfig:
        Functions:

      RequestMappingTemplate: "{}"
      ResponseMappingTemplate: |
        $util.toJson({
          "ticker": $ctx.stash.ticker,
          "price": $ctx.stash.price,

        })

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: MediaPackage Live Streaming channel with HLS and DASH origin endpoints,
  optional VOD packaging workflows (PackagingGroup, PackagingConfigurations) and IAM
  role for S3 access.

Parameters:
  ArchiveBucket:
    Type: String
    Default: ''
    Description: S3 bucket name for live-to-VOD archive storage. When provided,
      origin endpoint origination is set to DENY to support live-to-VOD workflows.
  VodSourceBucket:
    Type: String
    Default: ''
    Description: S3 bucket name for VOD source content. Required along with
      ArchiveBucket to enable VOD packaging workflows (PackagingGroup,
      PackagingConfigurations).
  OutputType:
    Type: String
    Default: APPLE_HLS
    AllowedValues:
      - APPLE_HLS
      - ISO_DASH
      - ALL
    Description: Output type for VOD packaging configurations (APPLE_HLS, ISO_DASH,
      or ALL).
  ManifestName:
    Type: String
    Default: index
    Description: Manifest name used for origin endpoints and VOD packaging manifests.
  HlsSegmentDurationSeconds:
    Type: Number
    Default: 6
    Description: Segment duration in seconds for HLS origin endpoint and HLS VOD packaging.
    MinValue: 1
    MaxValue: 60
  StartoverWindowSeconds:
    Type: Number
    Default: 86400
    Description: Startover window in seconds for origin endpoints.
    MinValue: 0
  LogicalNamePrefix:
    Type: String
    Default: LiveStream
    Description: Prefix applied to resource names (Channel, Endpoint, PackagingGroup,
      etc.).
  EnvironmentTag:
    Type: String
    Default: production
    Description: Value for the Environment tag applied to all resources.
  CustomTagKey1:
    Type: String
    Default: ''
    Description: Optional custom tag key 1.
  CustomTagValue1:
    Type: String
    Default: ''
    Description: Optional custom tag value 1.
  CustomTagKey2:
    Type: String
    Default: ''
    Description: Optional custom tag key 2.
  CustomTagValue2:
    Type: String
    Default: ''
    Description: Optional custom tag value 2.

Conditions:
  HasArchiveBucket: !Not [!Equals [!Ref ArchiveBucket, '']]
  HasVodSourceBucket: !Not [!Equals [!Ref VodSourceBucket, '']]
  NeedsIamRole: !Or [!Condition HasArchiveBucket, !Condition HasVodSourceBucket]
  HasVodWorkflow: !And [!Condition HasArchiveBucket, !Condition HasVodSourceBucket]
  HasCustomTag1: !Not [!Equals [!Ref CustomTagKey1, '']]
  HasCustomTag2: !Not [!Equals [!Ref CustomTagKey2, '']]
  # VOD packaging type selectors
  OutputTypeHls: !Or
    - !Equals [!Ref OutputType, APPLE_HLS]
    - !Equals [!Ref OutputType, ALL]
  OutputTypeDash: !Or
    - !Equals [!Ref OutputType, ISO_DASH]
    - !Equals [!Ref OutputType, ALL]
  CreateHlsVodPackaging: !And [!Condition HasVodWorkflow, !Condition OutputTypeHls]
  CreateDashVodPackaging: !And [!Condition HasVodWorkflow, !Condition OutputTypeDash]

Resources:
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------
  # IAM Role for MediaPackage to access S3 buckets
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------
  MediaPackageS3Role:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Condition: NeedsIamRole
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${LogicalNamePrefix}-MediaPackageS3Role'
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: mediapackage.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: MediaPackageS3Access
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - !If
                - HasArchiveBucket
                - Effect: Allow
                  Action:
                    - s3:GetObject
                    - s3:ListBucket
                    - s3:PutObject
                  Resource:
                    - !Sub 'arn:aws:s3:::${ArchiveBucket}'
                    - !Sub 'arn:aws:s3:::${ArchiveBucket}/*'
                - !Ref 'AWS::NoValue'
              - !If
                - HasVodSourceBucket
                - Effect: Allow
                  Action:
                    - s3:GetObject
                    - s3:ListBucket
                  Resource:
                    - !Sub 'arn:aws:s3:::${VodSourceBucket}'
                    - !Sub 'arn:aws:s3:::${VodSourceBucket}/*'
                - !Ref 'AWS::NoValue'
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentTag
        - !If
          - HasCustomTag1
          - Key: !Ref CustomTagKey1
            Value: !Ref CustomTagValue1
          - !Ref 'AWS::NoValue'
        - !If
          - HasCustomTag2
          - Key: !Ref CustomTagKey2
            Value: !Ref CustomTagValue2
          - !Ref 'AWS::NoValue'

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------
  # Live Streaming Channel
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------
  MediaPackageChannel:
    Type: AWS::MediaPackage::Channel
    Properties:
      Id: !Sub '${LogicalNamePrefix}-channel'
      Description: Live streaming channel for HLS and DASH delivery
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentTag
        - !If
          - HasCustomTag1
          - Key: !Ref CustomTagKey1
            Value: !Ref CustomTagValue1
          - !Ref 'AWS::NoValue'
        - !If
          - HasCustomTag2
          - Key: !Ref CustomTagKey2
            Value: !Ref CustomTagValue2
          - !Ref 'AWS::NoValue'

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------
  # HLS Origin Endpoint
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------
  HlsOriginEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::MediaPackage::OriginEndpoint
    Properties:
      Id: !Sub '${LogicalNamePrefix}-hls-endpoint'
      ChannelId: !Ref MediaPackageChannel
      Description: HLS origin endpoint for live streaming
      ManifestName: !Ref ManifestName
      StartoverWindowSeconds: !Ref StartoverWindowSeconds
      Origination: !If
        - HasArchiveBucket
        - DENY
        - ALLOW
      HlsPackage:
        SegmentDurationSeconds: !Ref HlsSegmentDurationSeconds
        AdMarkers: NONE
        IncludeIframeOnlyStream: false
        PlaylistType: EVENT
        PlaylistWindowSeconds: 120
        ProgramDateTimeIntervalSeconds: 60
        UseAudioRenditionGroup: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentTag
        - !If
          - HasCustomTag1
          - Key: !Ref CustomTagKey1
            Value: !Ref CustomTagValue1
          - !Ref 'AWS::NoValue'
        - !If
          - HasCustomTag2
          - Key: !Ref CustomTagKey2
            Value: !Ref CustomTagValue2
          - !Ref 'AWS::NoValue'

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------
  # DASH Origin Endpoint (hardcoded 2-second segment duration)
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------
  DashOriginEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::MediaPackage::OriginEndpoint
    Properties:
      Id: !Sub '${LogicalNamePrefix}-dash-endpoint'
      ChannelId: !Ref MediaPackageChannel
      Description: DASH origin endpoint for live streaming
      ManifestName: !Ref ManifestName
      StartoverWindowSeconds: !Ref StartoverWindowSeconds
      Origination: !If
        - HasArchiveBucket
        - DENY
        - ALLOW
      DashPackage:
        SegmentDurationSeconds: 2
        AdTriggers:
          - SPLICE_INSERT
          - BREAK
        AdsOnDeliveryRestrictions: NONE
        IncludeIframeOnlyStream: false
        ManifestLayout: FULL
        MinBufferTimeSeconds: 30
        MinUpdatePeriodSeconds: 15
        PeriodTriggers:
          - ADS
        Profile: NONE
        SuggestedPresentationDelaySeconds: 25
        UtcTiming: NONE
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentTag
        - !If
          - HasCustomTag1
          - Key: !Ref CustomTagKey1
            Value: !Ref CustomTagValue1
          - !Ref 'AWS::NoValue'
        - !If
          - HasCustomTag2
          - Key: !Ref CustomTagKey2
            Value: !Ref CustomTagValue2
          - !Ref 'AWS::NoValue'

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------
  # VOD Packaging Group (required for VOD workflows)
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------
  VodPackagingGroup:
    Type: AWS::MediaPackage::PackagingGroup
    Condition: HasVodWorkflow
    Properties:
      Id: !Sub '${LogicalNamePrefix}-vod-packaging-group'
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentTag
        - !If
          - HasCustomTag1
          - Key: !Ref CustomTagKey1
            Value: !Ref CustomTagValue1
          - !Ref 'AWS::NoValue'
        - !If
          - HasCustomTag2
          - Key: !Ref CustomTagKey2
            Value: !Ref CustomTagValue2
          - !Ref 'AWS::NoValue'

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------
  # HLS VOD Packaging Configuration
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------
  HlsVodPackagingConfig:
    Type: AWS::MediaPackage::PackagingConfiguration
    Condition: CreateHlsVodPackaging
    Properties:
      Id: !Sub '${LogicalNamePrefix}-hls-vod-config'
      PackagingGroupId: !Ref VodPackagingGroup
      HlsPackage:
        SegmentDurationSeconds: !Ref HlsSegmentDurationSeconds
        HlsManifests:
          - ManifestName: !Sub '${ManifestName}-hls'
            AdMarkers: NONE
            IncludeIframeOnlyStream: false
        UseAudioRenditionGroup: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentTag
        - !If
          - HasCustomTag1
          - Key: !Ref CustomTagKey1
            Value: !Ref CustomTagValue1
          - !Ref 'AWS::NoValue'
        - !If
          - HasCustomTag2
          - Key: !Ref CustomTagKey2
            Value: !Ref CustomTagValue2
          - !Ref 'AWS::NoValue'

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------
  # DASH VOD Packaging Configuration (hardcoded 2-second segment)
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------
  DashVodPackagingConfig:
    Type: AWS::MediaPackage::PackagingConfiguration
    Condition: CreateDashVodPackaging
    Properties:
      Id: !Sub '${LogicalNamePrefix}-dash-vod-config'
      PackagingGroupId: !Ref VodPackagingGroup
      DashPackage:
        SegmentDurationSeconds: 2
        PeriodTriggers:
          - ADS
        SegmentTemplateFormat: NUMBER_WITH_TIMELINE
        DashManifests:
          - ManifestName: !Sub '${ManifestName}-dash'
            ManifestLayout: FULL
            MinBufferTimeSeconds: 30
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentTag
        - !If
          - HasCustomTag1
          - Key: !Ref CustomTagKey1
            Value: !Ref CustomTagValue1
          - !Ref 'AWS::NoValue'
        - !If
          - HasCustomTag2
          - Key: !Ref CustomTagKey2
            Value: !Ref CustomTagValue2
          - !Ref 'AWS::NoValue'

Outputs:
  MediaPackageChannelId:
    Description: MediaPackage Channel ID
    Value: !Ref MediaPackageChannel
  MediaPackageChannelArn:
    Description: MediaPackage Channel ARN
    Value: !GetAtt MediaPackageChannel.Arn
  HlsOriginEndpointId:
    Description: HLS Origin Endpoint ID
    Value: !Ref HlsOriginEndpoint
  HlsOriginEndpointUrl:
    Description: HLS Origin Endpoint URL
    Value: !GetAtt HlsOriginEndpoint.Url
  DashOriginEndpointId:
    Description: DASH Origin Endpoint ID
    Value: !Ref DashOriginEndpoint
  DashOriginEndpointUrl:
    Description: DASH Origin Endpoint URL
    Value: !GetAtt DashOriginEndpoint.Url
  MediaPackageS3RoleArn:
    Condition: NeedsIamRole
    Description: IAM Role ARN for MediaPackage S3 access
    Value: !GetAtt MediaPackageS3Role.Arn
  VodPackagingGroupId:
    Condition: HasVodWorkflow
    Description: VOD Packaging Group ID

final_template:
AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: EC2 Image Builder pipeline for Amazon Linux 2023 AMIs with Docker, Docker Compose, Python packages, and SSM sudo access

Parameters:
  ImageVersion:
    Type: String
    Default: '1.0.0'
    Description: Version of the image recipe (semver format)
    AllowedPattern: ^[0-9]+\.[0-9]+\.[0-9]+$
  RootVolumeSize:
    Type: Number
    Default: 32
    Description: Root volume size in GB for the AMI
    MinValue: 8
    MaxValue: 500
  OrganizationId:
    Type: String
    Description: AWS Organization ID for AMI sharing (e.g., o-xxxxxxxxxxx)
    Default: o-exampleorgid

Resources:

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # VPC and networking (required for EC2 Image Builder infrastructure)
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  VPC:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: 10.0.0.0/16
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-vpc"

  InternetGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::InternetGateway
    Properties:
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-igw"

  VPCGatewayAttachment:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      InternetGatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  PublicSubnet:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: 10.0.1.0/24
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs ""]
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-public-subnet"

  PrivateSubnet:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: 10.0.2.0/24
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs ""]
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-private-subnet"

  PublicRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-public-rt"

  InternetRoute:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    DependsOn: VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      GatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable

  PublicSubnetRouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable

  NATElasticIP:
    Type: AWS::EC2::EIP
    Properties:
      Domain: vpc

  NATGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NatGateway
    Properties:
      AllocationId: !GetAtt NATElasticIP.AllocationId
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-nat"

  PrivateRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-private-rt"

  PrivateNatRoute:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Properties:
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      NatGatewayId: !Ref NATGateway
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable

  PrivateSubnetRouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable

  SecurityGroup:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup
    Properties:
      GroupDescription: Security group for EC2 Image Builder instances
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      SecurityGroupEgress:
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 80
          ToPort: 80
          DestinationPrefixListId: !Ref InternetEgressPrefixList
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 443
          ToPort: 443
          DestinationPrefixListId: !Ref InternetEgressPrefixList
        - IpProtocol: udp
          FromPort: 53
          ToPort: 53
          DestinationPrefixListId: !Ref InternetEgressPrefixList
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-sg"

  # Prefix list for internet egress (used by security group rules)
  InternetEgressPrefixList:
    Type: AWS::EC2::PrefixList
    Properties:
      PrefixListName: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-internet-egress"
      AddressFamily: IPv4
      MaxEntries: 10
      Entries:
        - Cidr: 0.0.0.0/0
          Description: General internet egress for package downloads

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # IAM Role and Instance Profile for EC2 Image Builder
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  ImageBuilderRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: ec2.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AmazonSSMManagedInstanceCore
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/EC2InstanceProfileForImageBuilder
      Tags:
        - Key: StackName
          Value: !Ref "AWS::StackName"

  ImageBuilderInstanceProfile:
    Type: AWS::IAM::InstanceProfile
    Properties:
      Roles:
        - !Ref ImageBuilderRole

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Image Builder Component – software installation + test phase
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  SoftwareComponent:
    Type: AWS::ImageBuilder::Component
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-software-install"
      Platform: Linux
      Version: !Ref ImageVersion
      Description: Installs Docker, Docker Compose, Python packages, enables SSM sudo
      Data: |
        schemaVersion: 1.0
        phases:
          - name: build
            steps:
              - name: InstallDocker
                action: ExecuteBash
                inputs:
                  commands:
                    - dnf install -y docker
                    - systemctl enable docker
                    - systemctl start docker
              - name: InstallDockerComposePlugin
                action: ExecuteBash
                inputs:
                  commands:
                    - dnf install -y docker-compose-plugin
              - name: InstallPythonPackages
                action: ExecuteBash
                inputs:
                  commands:
                    - dnf install -y python3-pip
                    - pip3 install synapseclient pandas pysftp
              - name: EnableSSMUserSudo
                action: ExecuteBash
                inputs:
                  commands:
                    - echo 'ssm-user ALL=(ALL) NOPASSWD:ALL' > /etc/sudoers.d/ssm-user
                    - chmod 440 /etc/sudoers.d/ssm-user
          - name: validate
            steps:
              - name: TestDockerCompose
                action: ExecuteBash
                inputs:
                  commands:
                    - docker compose version
              - name: TestPythonImports
                action: ExecuteBash
                inputs:
                  commands:
                    - python3 -c "import synapseclient; import pandas; import pysftp; print('All imports successful')"
      Tags:
        StackName: !Ref "AWS::StackName"

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Image Recipe – x86_64
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  AL2023x86Recipe:
    Type: AWS::ImageBuilder::ImageRecipe
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-al2023-x86"
      Version: !Ref ImageVersion
      ParentImage: /aws/service/ami-amazon-linux-latest/al2023-ami-kernel-default-x86_64
      Components:
        - ComponentArn: !Ref SoftwareComponent
      BlockDeviceMappings:
        - DeviceName: /dev/xvda
          Ebs:
            VolumeSize: !Ref RootVolumeSize
            VolumeType: gp3
      Tags:
        StackName: !Ref "AWS::StackName"

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Image Recipe – arm64
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  AL2023arm64Recipe:
    Type: AWS::ImageBuilder::ImageRecipe
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-al2023-arm64"
      Version: !Ref ImageVersion
      ParentImage: /aws/service/ami-amazon-linux-latest/al2023-ami-kernel-default-arm64
      Components:
        - ComponentArn: !Ref SoftwareComponent
      BlockDeviceMappings:
        - DeviceName: /dev/xvda
          Ebs:
            VolumeSize: !Ref RootVolumeSize
            VolumeType: gp3
      Tags:
        StackName: !Ref "AWS::StackName"

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Infrastructure Configuration (shared between both pipelines)
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  InfraConfig:
    Type: AWS::ImageBuilder::InfrastructureConfiguration
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-infra-config"
      Description: Shared infrastructure configuration for Image Builder
      InstanceProfileName: !Ref ImageBuilderInstanceProfile
      InstanceTypes:
        - t3.medium
        - t3.large
        - t4g.medium
        - t4g.large
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !Ref SecurityGroup
      Tags:
        StackName: !Ref "AWS::StackName"

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Distribution Configuration (single, shared between both pipelines)
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  DistConfig:
    Type: AWS::ImageBuilder::DistributionConfiguration
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-dist-config"
      Description: Distribution with public launch permissions and organization-level sharing
      Distributions:
        - Region: !Ref "AWS::Region"
          AmiDistributionConfiguration:
            Name: !Sub "al2023-docker-${ImageVersion}-{{ imagebuilder:buildDate }}"
            Description: !Sub "Amazon Linux 2023 with Docker, Python packages - version ${ImageVersion}"
            AmiTags:
              StackName: !Ref "AWS::StackName"
            LaunchPermissionConfiguration:
              UserGroups:
                - all
              OrganizationArns:
                - !Sub "arn:aws:organizations::${AWS::AccountId}:organization/${OrganizationId}"
      Tags:
        StackName: !Ref "AWS::StackName"

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Image Pipeline – x86_64
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  PipelineX86:
    Type: AWS::ImageBuilder::ImagePipeline
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-pipeline-x86"
      ImageRecipeArn: !Ref AL2023x86Recipe
      InfrastructureConfigurationArn: !Ref InfraConfig
      DistributionConfigurationArn: !Ref DistConfig
      ImageTestsConfiguration:
        ImageTestsEnabled: true
      Status: ENABLED
      Tags:
        StackName: !Ref "AWS::StackName"

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Image Pipeline – arm64
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  PipelineARM64:
    Type: AWS::ImageBuilder::ImagePipeline
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-pipeline-arm64"
      ImageRecipeArn: !Ref AL2023arm64Recipe
      InfrastructureConfigurationArn: !Ref InfraConfig
      DistributionConfigurationArn: !Ref DistConfig
      ImageTestsConfiguration:
        ImageTestsEnabled: true
      Status: ENABLED
      Tags:
        StackName: !Ref "AWS::StackName"

Outputs:
  PipelineX86:
    Description: ARN of the x86 Image Builder pipeline
    Value: !Ref PipelineX86
  PipelineARM64:
    Description: ARN of the arm64 Image Builder pipeline
    Value: !Ref PipelineARM64
  SoftwareComponent:
    Description: ARN of the software installation component
    Value: !Ref SoftwareComponent
  InfraConfig:
    Description: ARN of the infrastructure configuration
    Value: !Ref InfraConfig
  DistConfig:
    Description: ARN of the distribution configuration
    Value: !Ref DistConfig

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: "2010-09-09"
Description: >
  AnyCompany Hotel Cognito User Pool – guest and staff authentication system
  with PLUS-tier security, email-as-username, admin-only user creation, custom
  attributes, SPA client, admin client, M2M OAuth2 client, resource server,
  groups, and a custom domain.

Parameters:
  Environment:
    Type: String
    Default: dev
    AllowedValues:
      - dev
      - staging
      - prod
    Description: Deployment environment label used in the Cognito domain.

Resources:

  # --------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Cognito User Pool – PLUS tier, advanced security enforced
  # --------------------------------------------------------------------------
  UserPool:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPool
    Properties:
      UserPoolName: !Sub "anycompany-hotel-userpool-${Environment}"
      AccountRecoverySetting:
        RecoveryMechanisms:
          - Name: verified_email
            Priority: 1
      AdminCreateUserConfig:
        AllowAdminCreateUserOnly: true
        UnusedAccountValidityDays: 7
      AutoVerifiedAttributes:
        - email
      EmailConfiguration:
        EmailSendingAccount: COGNITO_DEFAULT
      Policies:
        PasswordPolicy:
          MinimumLength: 8
          RequireLowercase: true
          RequireNumbers: true
          RequireSymbols: true
          RequireUppercase: true
          TemporaryPasswordValidityDays: 7
      Schema:
        - Name: guest_id
          AttributeDataType: String
          Mutable: true
          Required: false
        - Name: property_id
          AttributeDataType: String
          Mutable: true
          Required: false
        - Name: region
          AttributeDataType: String
          Mutable: true
          Required: false
      UsernameAttributes:
        - email
      UsernameConfiguration:
        CaseSensitive: false
      UserPoolAddOns:
        AdvancedSecurityMode: ENFORCED
      VerificationMessageTemplate:
        DefaultEmailOption: CONFIRM_WITH_CODE
      

  # --------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Public SPA Client – SRP auth, no secret
  # --------------------------------------------------------------------------
  SPAClient:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolClient
    Properties:
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool
      ClientName: !Sub "anycompany-hotel-spa-client-${Environment}"
      GenerateSecret: false
      ExplicitAuthFlows:
        - ALLOW_USER_SRP_AUTH
        - ALLOW_REFRESH_TOKEN_AUTH
      TokenValidityUnits:
        AccessToken: hours
        IdToken: hours
        RefreshToken: days
      AccessTokenValidity: 1
      IdTokenValidity: 1
      RefreshTokenValidity: 30
      PreventUserExistenceErrors: ENABLED

  # --------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Admin Auth Client – ADMIN_USER_PASSWORD_AUTH for server-side test harnesses
  # --------------------------------------------------------------------------
  AdminClient:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolClient
    Properties:
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool
      ClientName: !Sub "anycompany-hotel-admin-client-${Environment}"
      ExplicitAuthFlows:
        - ALLOW_ADMIN_USER_PASSWORD_AUTH
        - ALLOW_REFRESH_TOKEN_AUTH
      TokenValidityUnits:
        AccessToken: hours
        IdToken: hours
        RefreshToken: days
      AccessTokenValidity: 1
      IdTokenValidity: 1
      RefreshTokenValidity: 30
      PreventUserExistenceErrors: ENABLED

  # --------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Resource Server – defines OAuth2 scopes for the M2M client
  # --------------------------------------------------------------------------
  ResourceServer:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolResourceServer
    Properties:
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool
      Identifier: !Sub "anycompany-hotel-api-${Environment}"
      Name: !Sub "AnyCompany Hotel API (${Environment})"
      Scopes:
        - ScopeName: read
          ScopeDescription: Read access to AnyCompany Hotel resources
        - ScopeName: write
          ScopeDescription: Write access to AnyCompany Hotel resources
        - ScopeName: admin
          ScopeDescription: Admin access to AnyCompany Hotel resources

  # --------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # M2M OAuth2 Client – client_credentials flow, with secret
  # --------------------------------------------------------------------------
  M2MClient:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolClient
    Properties:
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool
      ClientName: !Sub "anycompany-hotel-m2m-client-${Environment}"
      GenerateSecret: true
      ExplicitAuthFlows:
        - ALLOW_REFRESH_TOKEN_AUTH
      AllowedOAuthFlowsUserPoolClient: true
      AllowedOAuthFlows:
        - client_credentials
      AllowedOAuthScopes:
        - !Sub "${ResourceServer}/read"
        - !Sub "${ResourceServer}/write"
        - !Sub "${ResourceServer}/admin"
      SupportedIdentityProviders:
        - COGNITO
      TokenValidityUnits:
        AccessToken: hours
        IdToken: hours
        RefreshToken: days
      AccessTokenValidity: 1
      IdTokenValidity: 1
      RefreshTokenValidity: 30
      PreventUserExistenceErrors: ENABLED

  # --------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Cognito Groups – staff roles
  # --------------------------------------------------------------------------
  AdminGroup:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolGroup
    Properties:
      GroupName: Admin
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool
      Description: System administrators with full access

  ManagerGroup:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolGroup
    Properties:
      GroupName: Manager
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool
      Description: Hotel general managers

  RegionalManagerGroup:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolGroup
    Properties:

  RevenueManagerGroup:

  FrontDeskGroup:

    Properties:

Description: 'Cognito User Pool for Hospitality Insights application - prod environment'

Parameters:
  SSOLoginURL:
    Type: String
    Default: ''
    Description: 'SSO provider login URL for federated identity provider (leave empty to disable SSO)'
  SSOProviderName:
    Type: String
    Default: ''
    Description: 'SSO provider name for federated identity provider (leave empty to disable SSO)'

Conditions:
  EnableSSO:
    Fn::And:
      - !Not [!Equals [!Ref SSOLoginURL, '']]
      - !Not [!Equals [!Ref SSOProviderName, '']]

Resources:
  # IAM Role for Lambda execution
  PostAuthLambdaExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: CognitoUpdateUserAttributes
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action: cognito-idp:AdminUpdateUserAttributes
                Resource:
                  Fn::Sub: arn:aws:cognito-idp:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:userpool/*

  # Python Lambda function for post-authentication trigger
  PostAuthLambda:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    DependsOn: PostAuthLambdaExecutionRole
    Properties:
      FunctionName: hospitality-insights-post-auth
      Handler: index.lambda_handler
      Runtime: python3.12
      Role: !GetAtt PostAuthLambdaExecutionRole.Arn
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import json
          import boto3
          from datetime import datetime, timezone

          def lambda_handler(event, context):
              client = boto3.client('cognito-idp')
              user_pool_id = event['userPoolId']
              username = event['userName']

              current_time = datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat()

              try:
                  client.admin_update_user_attributes(
                      UserPoolId=user_pool_id,
                      Username=username,
                      UserAttributes=[
                          {
                              'Name': 'custom:last_login',
                              'Value': current_time
                          }
                      ]
                  )
              except Exception as e:
                  print(f'Error updating custom:last_login for user {username}: {str(e)}')

              return event
      Timeout: 30
      MemorySize: 128

  # Permission for Cognito to invoke the Lambda function
  PostAuthLambdaInvokePermission:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Permission
    Properties:
      FunctionName: !Ref PostAuthLambda
      Action: lambda:InvokeFunction
      Principal: cognito-idp.amazonaws.com
      SourceArn:
        Fn::Sub: arn:aws:cognito-idp:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:userpool/${HospitalityUserPool}

  # Cognito User Pool
  HospitalityUserPool:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPool
    DependsOn: PostAuthLambda
    Properties:
      UserPoolName: hospitality-insights-prod
      Schema:
        - Name: custom:last_login
          AttributeDataType: String
          Mutable: true
          DeveloperOnlyAttribute: false
          Required: false
      LambdaConfig:
        PostAuthentication:
          Fn::Sub: arn:aws:lambda:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:function:${PostAuthLambda}
      Policies:
        PasswordPolicy:
          MinimumLength: 8
          RequireLowercase: true
          RequireNumbers: true
          RequireSymbols: true
          RequireUppercase: true
      AutoVerifiedAttributes:
        - email
      UsernameAttributes:
        - email
      AccountRecoverySetting:
        RecoveryMechanisms:
          - Name: verified_email
            Priority: 1
      AdminCreateUserConfig:
        AllowAdminCreateUserOnly: false

  # User Pool Client with 24-hour session timeout
  HospitalityUserPoolClient:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolClient
    Properties:
      ClientName: hospitality-insights-prod-client
      UserPoolId: !Ref HospitalityUserPool
      ExplicitAuthFlows:
        - ALLOW_USER_PASSWORD_AUTH
        - ALLOW_REFRESH_TOKEN_AUTH
      TokenValidityUnits:
        AccessToken: hours
        IdToken: hours
        RefreshToken: hours
      AccessTokenValidity: 24
      IdTokenValidity: 24
      RefreshTokenValidity: 24
      GenerateSecret: false
      SupportedIdentityProviders:
        - COGNITO

  # Custom Domain for Hosted UI
  HospitalityUserPoolDomain:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolDomain
    Properties:
      Domain: hospitality-insights-prod
      UserPoolId: !Ref HospitalityUserPool

  # User Groups
  AdminGroup:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolGroup
    Properties:
      GroupName: Admin
      Precedence: 1
      UserPoolId: !Ref HospitalityUserPool

  RegularUserGroup:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolGroup
    Properties:
      GroupName: RegularUser
      Precedence: 2
      UserPoolId: !Ref HospitalityUserPool

  PowerUserGroup:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolGroup
    Properties:
      GroupName: PowerUser
      Precedence: 3
      UserPoolId: !Ref HospitalityUserPool

  # Optional SSO Integration via OIDC federated identity provider
  SSOIdentityProvider:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolIdentityProvider
    Condition: EnableSSO
    Properties:
      ProviderName: !Ref SSOProviderName
      ProviderType: OIDC
      UserPoolId: !Ref HospitalityUserPool
      AttributeMapping:
        email: email
      ProviderDetails:
        client_id: placeholder-client-id
        client_secret: placeholder-client-secret
        authorize_scope: openid email profile
        attributes_request_method: GET
        oidc_issuer: !Ref SSOLoginURL
        authorize_url: !Ref SSOLoginURL
        token_url:
          Fn::Sub: ${SSOLoginURL}/token
        attributes_url:
          Fn::Sub: ${SSOLoginURL}/userinfo
        jwks_uri:
          Fn::Sub: ${SSOLoginURL}/certs
      IdpIdentifiers:
        - !Ref SSOProviderName

Outputs:
  UserPoolId:
    Value: !Ref HospitalityUserPool
    Description: 'Cognito User Pool ID'
  UserPoolArn:
    Value: !GetAtt HospitalityUserPool.Arn
    Description: 'Cognito User Pool ARN'
  UserPoolClientId:
    Value: !Ref HospitalityUserPoolClient
    Description: 'Cognito User Pool Client ID'
  UserPoolDomainName:
    Value: !Ref HospitalityUserPoolDomain
    Description: 'Cognito User Pool custom domain'

Description: AWS FIS experiment template for chaos engineering - blocks network traffic to a target region and pauses cross-region replication

Parameters:
  TargetRegion:
    Type: String
    Description: The target AWS region to block application network traffic to
    AllowedPattern: ^[a-z]{2}-[a-z]+-[0-9]+$
    Default: eu-west-1
  PauseDurationMinutes:
    Type: Number
    Description: Duration in minutes for pausing cross-region replication
    Default: 20
    MinValue: 1
    MaxValue: 1440

Resources:
  FISLogKMSKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    Properties:
      Description: KMS key for encrypting FIS experiment CloudWatch Logs
      Enabled: true
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: EnableRootAccess
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub arn:aws:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root
            Action: kms:*
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: AllowCloudWatchLogs
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: !Sub logs.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - kms:Encrypt*
              - kms:Decrypt*
              - kms:ReEncrypt*
              - kms:GenerateDataKey*
              - kms:DescribeKey
            Resource: '*'

  FISLogKMSKeyAlias:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Alias
    Properties:
      AliasName: alias/fis-experiment-log-key
      TargetKeyId: !Ref FISLogKMSKey

  FISExperimentLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: /aws/fis/chaos-engineering-experiment
      RetentionInDays: 30
      KmsKeyId: !GetAtt FISLogKMSKey.Arn

  FISExperimentRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: fis.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: FISExperimentPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: TransitGatewayActions
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ec2:CreateTransitGatewayRoute
                  - ec2:DeleteTransitGatewayRoute
                  - ec2:DisableTransitGatewayRouteTablePropagation
                  - ec2:EnableTransitGatewayRouteTablePropagation
                  - ec2:SearchTransitGatewayRoutes
                  - ec2:DescribeTransitGateways
                  - ec2:DescribeTransitGatewayRouteTables
                  - ec2:DescribeTransitGatewayAttachments
                Resource: '*'
              - Sid: RouteTableActions
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ec2:CreateRoute
                  - ec2:DeleteRoute
                  - ec2:ReplaceRoute
                  - ec2:DescribeRouteTables
                  - ec2:DescribeSubnets
                Resource: '*'
              - Sid: S3ReplicationActions
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:GetReplicationConfiguration
                  - s3:PutReplicationConfiguration
                Resource: '*'
              - Sid: DynamoDBReplicationActions
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - dynamodb:DescribeGlobalTable
                  - dynamodb:UpdateGlobalTable
                  - dynamodb:DescribeContinuousBackups
                  - dynamodb:DescribeTableReplicaAutoScaling
                  - dynamodb:UpdateTableReplicaAutoScaling
                Resource: '*'
              - Sid: CloudWatchLogsActions
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogDelivery
                  - logs:GetLogDelivery
                  - logs:UpdateLogDelivery
                  - logs:DeleteLogDelivery
                  - logs:ListLogDeliveries
                  - logs:DescribeResourcePolicies
                Resource: '*'
              - Sid: KMSActions
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - kms:Decrypt
                  - kms:GenerateDataKey
                Resource: !GetAtt FISLogKMSKey.Arn
      

  FISExperimentTemplate:
    Type: AWS::FIS::ExperimentTemplate
    Properties:
      Description: Chaos engineering experiment - blocks network traffic to target region and pauses cross-region replication
      RoleArn: !GetAtt FISExperimentRole.Arn
      StopConditions:
        - Source: none
      Tags:
        Name: ChaosEngineeringExperiment
        TargetRegion: !Ref TargetRegion
      LogConfiguration:
        LogSchemaVersion: 1
      Targets:
        TransitGatewayTarget:
          ResourceType: aws:ec2:transit-gateway
          ResourceTags:
            ChaosAllowed: 'true'
          SelectionMode: ALL
        SubnetTarget:
          ResourceType: aws:ec2:subnet
          ResourceTags:
            ChaosAllowed: 'true'
          SelectionMode: ALL
        S3BucketTarget:
          ResourceType: aws:s3:bucket
