AWSTemplateFormatVersion: "2010-09-09"
Description: "Landing Zone Hub VPC with Transit Gateway for Multi-Account Spoke Attachment"

Parameters:
  EnvironmentName:
    Type: String
    Default: landing-zone
    Description: Environment name prefix for resource naming

  VPCCIDR:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.0.0/16
    Description: CIDR block for the hub VPC

  PublicSubnet1CIDR:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.1.0/24
    Description: CIDR for public subnet in AZ1

  PublicSubnet2CIDR:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.2.0/24
    Description: CIDR for public subnet in AZ2

  PrivateSubnet1CIDR:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.10.0/24
    Description: CIDR for private subnet in AZ1

  PrivateSubnet2CIDR:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.11.0/24
    Description: CIDR for private subnet in AZ2

  TransitGatewayASN:
    Type: Number
    Default: 64512
    Description: Private ASN for the Transit Gateway

Resources:
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # VPC
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  VPC:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: !Ref VPCCIDR
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-vpc"
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Internet Gateway
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  InternetGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::InternetGateway
    Properties:
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-igw"
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation

  VPCGatewayAttachment:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      InternetGatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Public Subnets (AZ1 and AZ2)
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  PublicSubnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !Ref PublicSubnet1CIDR
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs ""]
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-public-subnet-az1"
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
        - Key: Type
          Value: Public
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation

  PublicSubnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !Ref PublicSubnet2CIDR
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [1, !GetAZs ""]
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-public-subnet-az2"
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
        - Key: Type
          Value: Public
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Private Subnets (AZ1 and AZ2)
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  PrivateSubnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !Ref PrivateSubnet1CIDR
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs ""]
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-private-subnet-az1"
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
        - Key: Type
          Value: Private
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation

  PrivateSubnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !Ref PrivateSubnet2CIDR
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [1, !GetAZs ""]
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-private-subnet-az2"
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
        - Key: Type
          Value: Private
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Elastic IPs for NAT Gateways
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  NatGateway1EIP:
    Type: AWS::EC2::EIP
    Properties:
      Domain: vpc
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-nat-eip-az1"
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation

  NatGateway2EIP:
    Type: AWS::EC2::EIP
    Properties:
      Domain: vpc
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-nat-eip-az2"
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # NAT Gateways (one per public subnet / AZ)
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  NatGateway1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NatGateway
    Properties:
      AllocationId: !GetAtt NatGateway1EIP.AllocationId
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet1
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-nat-gw-az1"
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation

  NatGateway2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NatGateway
    Properties:
      AllocationId: !GetAtt NatGateway2EIP.AllocationId
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet2
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-nat-gw-az2"
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Public Route Table
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  PublicRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-public-rt"
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation

  PublicRouteDefault:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    DependsOn: VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      GatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  PublicSubnet1RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet1
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable

  PublicSubnet2RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet2
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Private Route Tables (one per AZ)
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  PrivateRouteTable1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-private-rt-az1"
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation

  PrivateRouteTable2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-private-rt-az2"
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation

  PrivateSubnet1RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet1
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable1

  PrivateSubnet2RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet2
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable2

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Transit Gateway
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  TransitGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::TransitGateway
    Properties:
      AmazonSideAsn: !Ref TransitGatewayASN
      AutoAcceptSharedAttachments: disable
      DefaultRouteTableAssociation: enable
      DefaultRouteTablePropagation: enable
      DnsSupport: enable
      VpnEcmpSupport: enable
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-tgw"
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Private Routes to Transit Gateway (for spoke connectivity via 10.0.0.0/8)
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  PrivateRoute1ToTGW:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable1
      DestinationCidrBlock: 10.0.0.0/8
      TransitGatewayId: !Ref TransitGateway

  PrivateRoute2ToTGW:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable2
      DestinationCidrBlock: 10.0.0.0/8
      TransitGatewayId: !Ref TransitGateway

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Private Routes to NAT Gateway (outbound internet)
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  PrivateRoute1ToNAT:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable1
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      NatGatewayId: !Ref NatGateway1

  PrivateRoute2ToNAT:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable2
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      NatGatewayId: !Ref NatGateway2

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # VPC Flow Logs (CloudWatch Logs destination)
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  FlowLogRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: vpc-flow-logs.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: vpc-flow-logs-policy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: "2012-10-17"
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogGroup
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                  - logs:DescribeLogGroups
                  - logs:DescribeLogStreams
                Resource: "*"
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-flow-log-role"
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation

  FlowLogLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Sub "/aws/vpc/flow-logs/${EnvironmentName}"
      RetentionInDays: 365
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-flow-log-group"
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation

  FlowLog:
    Type: AWS::EC2::FlowLog
    Properties:
      DeliverLogsPermissionArn: !GetAtt FlowLogRole.Arn
      LogDestinationType: cloud-watch-logs
      LogDestination: !GetAtt FlowLogLogGroup.Arn
      ResourceId: !Ref VPC
      ResourceType: VPC
      TrafficType: ALL
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-flow-log"
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # VPC Endpoints Security Group
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  VPCEndpointSecurityGroup:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup
    Properties:
      GroupDescription: Security group for VPC interface endpoints
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      SecurityGroupIngress:
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 443
          ToPort: 443
          CidrIp: !Ref VPCCIDR
          Description: Allow HTTPS traffic from the VPC CIDR
      SecurityGroupEgress:
        - IpProtocol: -1
          CidrIp: !Ref VPCCIDR
          Description: Allow all outbound traffic within the VPC CIDR
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-vpc-endpoint-sg"
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Gateway Endpoint for Amazon S3 (private subnets have routes via prefix list)
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  S3GatewayEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      ServiceName: !Sub "com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.s3"
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      VpcEndpointType: Gateway
      RouteTableIds:
        - !Ref PrivateRouteTable1
        - !Ref PrivateRouteTable2
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-s3-endpoint"
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Interface Endpoints (SSM, EC2 Messages, SSM Messages, CloudWatch Logs)
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  SSMEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      ServiceName: !Sub "com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.ssm"
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      VpcEndpointType: Interface
      PrivateDnsEnabled: true
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet1
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet2
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !Ref VPCEndpointSecurityGroup
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-ssm-endpoint"
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation

  EC2MessagesEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      ServiceName: !Sub "com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.ec2messages"
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      VpcEndpointType: Interface
      PrivateDnsEnabled: true
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet1
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet2
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !Ref VPCEndpointSecurityGroup
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-ec2messages-endpoint"
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation

  SSMMessagesEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      ServiceName: !Sub "com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.ssmmessages"
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      VpcEndpointType: Interface
      PrivateDnsEnabled: true
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet1
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet2
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !Ref VPCEndpointSecurityGroup
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-ssmmessages-endpoint"
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation

  LogsEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      ServiceName: !Sub "com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.logs"
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      VpcEndpointType: Interface
      PrivateDnsEnabled: true
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet1
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet2
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !Ref VPCEndpointSecurityGroup
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-logs-endpoint"
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation

Outputs:
  VpcId:
    Description: Hub VPC ID
    Value: !Ref VPC
    Export:
      Name: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-vpc-id"

  VpcCIDR:
    Description: Hub VPC CIDR block
    Value: !Ref VPCCIDR
    Export:
      Name: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-vpc-cidr"

  PublicSubnet1Id:
    Description: Public subnet 1 ID
    Value: !Ref PublicSubnet1
    Export:
      Name: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-public-subnet-1-id"

  PublicSubnet2Id:
    Description: Public subnet 2 ID
    Value: !Ref PublicSubnet2
    Export:
      Name: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-public-subnet-2-id"

  PrivateSubnet1Id:
    Description: Private subnet 1 ID
    Value: !Ref PrivateSubnet1
    Export:
      Name: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-private-subnet-1-id"

  PrivateSubnet2Id:
    Description: Private subnet 2 ID
    Value: !Ref PrivateSubnet2
    Export:
      Name: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-private-subnet-2-id"

  TransitGatewayId:
    Description: Transit Gateway ID
    Value: !Ref TransitGateway
    Export:
      Name: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-tgw-id"

  PrivateRouteTable1Id:
    Description: Private route table 1 ID
    Value: !Ref PrivateRouteTable1
    Export:
      Name: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-private-rt-1-id"

  PrivateRouteTable2Id:
    Description: Private route table 2 ID
    Value: !Ref PrivateRouteTable2
    Export:
      Name: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-private-rt-2-id"

  FlowLogGroupArn:
    Description: Flow logs CloudWatch Log Group ARN
    Value: !GetAtt FlowLogLogGroup.Arn
    Export:
      Name: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-flow-log-group-arn"

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: "2010-09-09"
Description: "CIS AWS Foundations Benchmark Section 3 - Monitoring Controls"
Parameters:
  TrailName:
    Type: String
    Default: "CIS-CloudTrail"
    Description: "Name of the CloudTrail trail"
  LogGroupName:
    Type: String
    Default: "CIS-CloudTrail-Logs"
    Description: "Name of the CloudWatch Logs log group"
  TopicName:
    Type: String
    Default: "CIS-Alarm-Topic"
    Description: "Name of the SNS topic for alarm notifications"
  AlarmEmail:
    Type: String
    Description: "Email address to receive alarm notifications"
Resources:
  # KMS key for encrypting CloudTrail logs and SNS topic
  CISKMSKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    Properties:
      Description: "KMS key for CIS monitoring infrastructure"
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Sid: "Enable IAM User Permissions"
            Effect: "Allow"
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub "arn:aws:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root"
            Action: "kms:*"
            Resource: "*"
          - Sid: "Allow CloudTrail to use key"
            Effect: "Allow"
            Principal:
              Service: "cloudtrail.amazonaws.com"
            Action:
              - "kms:Encrypt"
              - "kms:Decrypt"
              - "kms:ReEncrypt*"
              - "kms:GenerateDataKey*"
              - "kms:DescribeKey"
            Resource: "*"
          - Sid: "Allow SNS to use key"
            Effect: "Allow"
            Principal:
              Service: "sns.amazonaws.com"
            Action:
              - "kms:Decrypt"
              - "kms:GenerateDataKey*"
            Resource: "*"
          - Sid: "Allow CloudWatch Logs to use key"
            Effect: "Allow"
            Principal:
              Service: !Sub "logs.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com"
            Action:
              - "kms:Encrypt"

    Type: AWS::IAM::Role

        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: "Allow"
            Principal:
              Service: "cloudtrail.amazonaws.com"
            Action: "sts:AssumeRole"
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: "CIS-CloudTrail-Policy"
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: "2012-10-17"
            Statement:
              - Effect: "Allow"
                Action:
                  - "logs:CreateLogStream"
                  - "logs:PutLogEvents"

                  - "kms:Decrypt"

            Principal:

            Resource: !Sub "arn:aws:s3:::cis-cloudtrail-${AWS::AccountId}-${AWS::Region}/CIS/AWSLogs/${AWS::AccountId}/*"

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: Shared IAM roles and supporting resources for use across multiple EKS deployments

Parameters:
  EnvironmentAlias:
    Type: String
    Default: dev
    Description: Environment alias prefix used for naming all IAM roles
  Hash:
    Type: String
    Default: abcd
    Description: Optional hash suffix for naming consistency
  S3BucketName:
    Type: String
    Default: eks-shared-assets-bucket
    Description: S3 bucket name used to scope the bastion role's s3:GetObject access
  # Uncomment the PermissionsBoundary parameter below for environments that require it:
  # PermissionsBoundary:
  #   Type: String
  #   Default: ""
  #   Description: Optional ARN of an IAM permissions boundary to apply to all roles

Resources:
  # ============================================================================
  # GuardDuty – enables threat detection in the region
  # ============================================================================
  GuardDutyDetector:
    Type: AWS::GuardDuty::Detector
    Properties:
      Enable: true
      FindingPublishingFrequency: FIFTEEN_MINUTES

  # ============================================================================
  # CloudWatch Log Groups – used by CloudFormation registry type activations
  # ============================================================================
  KubernetesResourceLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: cloudformation/registry/awsqs-kubernetes-resource
      RetentionInDays: 7

  KubernetesHelmLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: awsqs-kubernetes-helm-logs
      RetentionInDays: 7

  EKSClusterLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: cloudformation/registry/awsqs-eks-cluster
      RetentionInDays: 7

  # ============================================================================
  # IAM Role 1 – Lambda execution with read-only access for resource discovery
  # ============================================================================
  LambdaReadOnlyRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub "${EnvironmentAlias}-${Hash}-lambda-readonly"
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/ReadOnlyAccess
      # PermissionsBoundary: !If [HasPermissionsBoundary, !Ref PermissionsBoundary, !Ref "AWS::NoValue"]

  # ============================================================================
  # IAM Role 2 – Lambda role for getting caller identity and accessing
  #              CloudFormation and CloudTrail logs
  # ============================================================================
  LambdaCallerIdentityRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub "${EnvironmentAlias}-${Hash}-lambda-caller-identity"
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: CallerIdentityAndAuditAccess
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action: sts:GetCallerIdentity
                Resource: "*"
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - cloudformation:DescribeStacks
                  - cloudformation:DescribeStackEvents
                  - cloudformation:DescribeStackResources
                  - cloudformation:GetTemplate
                  - cloudformation:ListStacks
                  - cloudformation:ListStackResources
                Resource: "*"
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - cloudtrail:LookupEvents
                  - cloudtrail:DescribeTrails
                  - cloudtrail:GetTrailStatus
                  - cloudtrail:GetEventSelectors
                Resource: "*"
      # PermissionsBoundary: !If [HasPermissionsBoundary, !Ref PermissionsBoundary, !Ref "AWS::NoValue"]

  # ============================================================================
  # IAM Role 3 – Role for describing EKS node groups
  # ============================================================================
  EKSNodeGroupRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub "${EnvironmentAlias}-${Hash}-eks-nodegroup"
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: ec2.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: EKSNodeGroupDescribe
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - eks:DescribeNodegroup
                  - eks:ListNodegroups
                  - eks:DescribeCluster
                  - eks:ListClusters
                  - ec2:DescribeInstances
                  - ec2:DescribeSecurityGroups
                  - ec2:DescribeSubnets
                  - ec2:DescribeVpcs
                  - ec2:DescribeInstanceTypes
                  - autoscaling:DescribeAutoScalingGroups
                  - autoscaling:DescribeAutoScalingInstances
                Resource: "*"
      # PermissionsBoundary: !If [HasPermissionsBoundary, !Ref PermissionsBoundary, !Ref "AWS::NoValue"]

  # ============================================================================
  # IAM Role 4 – CloudFormation execution role with max session duration 8400s
  #              Broad permissions: EKS, SecretsManager, KMS, S3, EC2, Lambda, logs
  # ============================================================================
  CloudFormationExecRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub "${EnvironmentAlias}-${Hash}-cfn-execution"
      MaxSessionDuration: 8400
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: cloudformation.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: CloudFormationExecution
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - eks:*
                  - secretsmanager:*
                  - kms:*
                  - s3:GetObject
                  - s3:PutObject
                  - s3:DeleteObject
                  - s3:GetObjectVersion
                  - s3:DeleteObjectVersion
                  - s3:ListBucket
                  - s3:GetBucketLocation
                  - s3:CreateBucket
                  - s3:DeleteBucket
                  - s3:GetBucketPolicy
                  - s3:PutBucketPolicy
                  - s3:DeleteBucketPolicy
                  - s3:GetBucketTagging
                  - s3:PutBucketTagging
                  - s3:ListAllMyBuckets
                  - ec2:*
                  - lambda:*
                  - logs:*
                  - cloudformation:*
                  - iam:PassRole
                  - iam:GetRole
                  - iam:CreateRole
                  - iam:DeleteRole
                  - iam:PutRolePolicy
                  - iam:DeleteRolePolicy
                  - iam:AttachRolePolicy
                  - iam:DetachRolePolicy
                Resource: "*"
      # PermissionsBoundary: !If [HasPermissionsBoundary, !Ref PermissionsBoundary, !Ref "AWS::NoValue"]

  # ============================================================================
  # IAM Role 5 – Logging delivery role for CloudFormation registry logs
  # ============================================================================
  LoggingDeliveryRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub "${EnvironmentAlias}-${Hash}-logging-delivery"
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: cloudformation.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: LoggingDelivery
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogDelivery
                  - logs:GetLogDelivery
                  - logs:UpdateLogDelivery
                  - logs:DeleteLogDelivery
                  - logs:ListLogDeliveries
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                  - logs:CreateLogGroup
                  - logs:DescribeLogGroups
                  - logs:DescribeLogStreams
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                Resource: "*"
      # PermissionsBoundary: !If [HasPermissionsBoundary, !Ref PermissionsBoundary, !Ref "AWS::NoValue"]

  # ============================================================================
  # IAM Role 6 – CodeBuild and EKS service integration
  #              Permissions: ECR, S3, EKS
  # ============================================================================
  CodeBuildEKSRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub "${EnvironmentAlias}-${Hash}-codebuild-eks"
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service:
                - codebuild.amazonaws.com
                - eks.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: CodeBuildEKSAccess
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ecr:GetAuthorizationToken
                  - ecr:BatchCheckLayerAvailability
                  - ecr:BatchGetImage
                  - ecr:GetDownloadUrlForLayer
                  - ecr:PutImage
                  - ecr:InitiateLayerUpload
                  - ecr:UploadLayerPart
                  - ecr:CompleteLayerUpload
                  - ecr:DescribeRepositories
                  - ecr:ListImages
                Resource: "*"
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:GetObject
                  - s3:PutObject
                  - s3:ListBucket
                  - s3:GetBucketLocation
                Resource: "*"
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - eks:DescribeCluster
                  - eks:ListClusters
                  - eks:AccessKubernetesApi
                Resource: "*"
      # PermissionsBoundary: !If [HasPermissionsBoundary, !Ref PermissionsBoundary, !Ref "AWS::NoValue"]

  # ============================================================================
  # IAM Role 7 – CloudFormation extension hooks
  #              Permissions: SecretsManager, KMS, EKS, S3, STS, IAM, EC2,
  #              Lambda, logs, CloudWatch, SSM
  # ============================================================================
  CloudFormationHookRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub "${EnvironmentAlias}-${Hash}-cfn-hook"
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: hooks.cloudformation.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: CloudFormationHookAccess
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - secretsmanager:*
                  - kms:*
                  - eks:*
                  - s3:GetObject
                  - s3:PutObject
                  - s3:DeleteObject
                  - s3:GetObjectVersion
                  - s3:DeleteObjectVersion
                  - s3:ListBucket
                  - s3:GetBucketLocation
                  - s3:CreateBucket
                  - s3:DeleteBucket
                  - s3:GetBucketPolicy
                  - s3:PutBucketPolicy
                  - s3:DeleteBucketPolicy
                  - s3:GetBucketTagging
                  - s3:PutBucketTagging
                  - s3:ListAllMyBuckets
                  - sts:*
                  - iam:*
                  - ec2:*
                  - lambda:*
                  - logs:*
                  - cloudwatch:*
                  - ssm:*
                Resource: "*"
      # PermissionsBoundary: !If [HasPermissionsBoundary, !Ref PermissionsBoundary, !Ref "AWS::NoValue"]

  # ============================================================================
  # IAM Role 8 – Bastion instance role
  #              Access: S3 (scoped bucket), ECR, EC2, EKS, CodeBuild,
  #              CodePipeline, CloudWatch logs
  # ============================================================================
  BastionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub "${EnvironmentAlias}-${Hash}-bastion"
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: ec2.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: BastionAccess
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action: s3:GetObject
                Resource: !Sub "arn:aws:s3:::${S3BucketName}/*"
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ecr:GetAuthorizationToken
                  - ecr:BatchCheckLayerAvailability
                  - ecr:BatchGetImage
                  - ecr:GetDownloadUrlForLayer
                  - ecr:DescribeRepositories
                  - ecr:ListImages
                Resource: "*"
              - Effect: Allow
                Action: ec2:Describe*
                Resource: "*"
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - eks:DescribeCluster
                  - eks:ListClusters
                  - eks:ListNodegroups
                  - eks:DescribeNodegroup
                  - eks:AccessKubernetesApi
                Resource: "*"
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - codebuild:StartBuild
                  - codebuild:BatchGetBuilds
                  - codebuild:ListBuilds
                  - codebuild:ListProjects
                  - codebuild:ListBuildsForProject
                Resource: "*"
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - codepipeline:StartPipelineExecution
                  - codepipeline:GetPipeline
                  - codepipeline:GetPipelineExecution
                  - codepipeline:ListPipelines
                  - codepipeline:GetPipelineState
                Resource: "*"
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogGroup
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                  - logs:DescribeLogGroups
                  - logs:DescribeLogStreams
                  - logs:GetLogEvents
                Resource: "*"
      # PermissionsBoundary: !If [HasPermissionsBoundary, !Ref PermissionsBoundary, !Ref "AWS::NoValue"]

  # ============================================================================
  # CloudFormation Registry Type Activations
  # ============================================================================
  KubernetesResourceTypeActivation:
    Type: AWS::CloudFormation::TypeActivation
    DependsOn:
      - KubernetesResourceLogGroup
    Properties:
      PublicTypeArn: !Sub "arn:aws:cloudformation:${AWS::Region}::type/resource/AWSQS-Kubernetes-Resource/1.0.0"
      ExecutionRoleArn: !GetAtt CloudFormationExecRole.Arn
      LoggingConfig:
        LogGroupName: cloudformation/registry/awsqs-kubernetes-resource
        LogRoleArn: !GetAtt LoggingDeliveryRole.Arn
      AutoUpdate: true

    Type: AWS::CloudFormation::TypeActivation
    DependsOn:
      - KubernetesHelmLogGroup
    Properties:
      PublicTypeArn: !Sub "arn:aws:cloudformation:${AWS::Region}::type/resource/AWSQS-Kubernetes-Helm/1.0.0"
      ExecutionRoleArn: !GetAtt CloudFormationExecRole.Arn
      LoggingConfig:

        LogRoleArn: !GetAtt LoggingDeliveryRole.Arn

  EKSClusterTypeActivation:

      ExecutionRoleArn: !GetAtt CloudFormationExecRole.Arn
      LoggingConfig:
        LogGroupName: cloudformation/registry/awsqs-eks-cluster
        LogRoleArn: !GetAtt LoggingDeliveryRole.Arn

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: "2010-09-09"
Description: Comprehensive SQS infrastructure with FIFO queues, standard queues, DLQs, KMS encryption, and CloudWatch alarms

Resources:

  # KMS Key for encrypting all queues
  QueueKMSKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    Properties:
      Description: KMS key for SQS queue encryption
      Enabled: true
      KeyUsage: ENCRYPT_DECRYPT
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Sid: Enable SQS service access
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: sqs.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - kms:GenerateDataKey
              - kms:Decrypt
            Resource: "*"
          - Sid: Enable root account full access
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub "arn:aws:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root"
            Action: kms:*
            Resource: "*"

  QueueKMSKeyAlias:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Alias
    Properties:
      AliasName: alias/sqs-queue-key
      TargetKeyId: !Ref QueueKMSKey

  # FIFO queue without a dead letter queue
  FIFOQueueNoDLQ:
    Type: AWS::SQS::Queue
    Properties:
      QueueName: TestFIFOQueueNoDLQ.fifo
      FifoQueue: true
      ContentBasedDeduplication: true
      KmsMasterKeyId: !GetAtt QueueKMSKey.Arn
      KmsDataKeyReusePeriodSeconds: 300
      VisibilityTimeout: 30

  # FIFO DLQ for the FIFO queue with DLQ
  FIFODLQForQueue:
    Type: AWS::SQS::Queue
    Properties:
      QueueName: TestFIFODLQForQueue.fifo
      FifoQueue: true
      ContentBasedDeduplication: true
      KmsMasterKeyId: !GetAtt QueueKMSKey.Arn
      KmsDataKeyReusePeriodSeconds: 300
      VisibilityTimeout: 30
      RedriveAllowPolicy:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: "*"
            Action: sqs:SendMessage
            Resource: "*"

  # FIFO queue with a dead letter queue
  FIFOQueueWithDLQ:
    Type: AWS::SQS::Queue
    Properties:
      QueueName: TestFIFOQueueWithDLQ.fifo
      FifoQueue: true
      ContentBasedDeduplication: true
      KmsMasterKeyId: !GetAtt QueueKMSKey.Arn
      KmsDataKeyReusePeriodSeconds: 300
      VisibilityTimeout: 30
      RedrivePolicy:
        deadLetterTargetArn: !GetAtt FIFODLQForQueue.Arn
        maxReceiveCount: 5

  # Standard DLQ for the standard queue
  StandardDLQ:
    Type: AWS::SQS::Queue
    Properties:
      QueueName: TestStandardDLQ
      KmsMasterKeyId: !GetAtt QueueKMSKey.Arn
      KmsDataKeyReusePeriodSeconds: 300
      VisibilityTimeout: 30
      RedriveAllowPolicy:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: "*"
            Action: sqs:SendMessage
            Resource: "*"

  # Standard queue with a DLQ using a redrive policy with maxReceiveCount 5
  StandardQueueWithDLQ:
    Type: AWS::SQS::Queue
    Properties:
      QueueName: TestStandardQueueWithDLQ
      KmsMasterKeyId: !GetAtt QueueKMSKey.Arn
      KmsDataKeyReusePeriodSeconds: 300
      VisibilityTimeout: 30
      RedrivePolicy:
        deadLetterTargetArn: !GetAtt StandardDLQ.Arn
        maxReceiveCount: 5

  # Separate FIFO DLQ
  SeparateFIFODLQ:
    Type: AWS::SQS::Queue
    Properties:
      QueueName: TestSeparateFIFODLQ.fifo
      FifoQueue: true
      ContentBasedDeduplication: true
      KmsMasterKeyId: !GetAtt QueueKMSKey.Arn
      KmsDataKeyReusePeriodSeconds: 300
      VisibilityTimeout: 30

  # Anomaly Detector for FIFO queue with DLQ (NumberOfMessagesSent, Average)
  FIFOQueueWithDLQAnomalyDetector:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::AnomalyDetector
    Properties:
      MetricName: NumberOfMessagesSent
      Namespace: AWS/SQS
      Stat: Average
      Dimensions:
        - Name: QueueName
          Value: !GetAtt FIFOQueueWithDLQ.QueueName

  # --------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # CloudWatch Alarms (all with actions disabled)
  # --------------------------------------------------------------------------

  # Alarm 1: Standard queue NumberOfMessagesSent Sum, threshold 1, breaching on missing data
  StandardQueueMessagesSentAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: StandardQueueWithDLQ-MessagesSent-Sum
      ActionsEnabled: false
      AlarmDescription: Alarm when number of messages sent to standard queue exceeds 1
      Namespace: AWS/SQS
      MetricName: NumberOfMessagesSent
      Statistic: Sum
      Dimensions:
        - Name: QueueName
          Value: !GetAtt StandardQueueWithDLQ.QueueName
      Period: 300
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      Threshold: 1
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanThreshold
      TreatMissingData: breaching

  # Alarm 2: FIFO queue with DLQ average NumberOfMessagesSent anomaly detection band
  FIFOQueueWithDLQAvgMessagesSentAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: FIFOQueueWithDLQ-AvgMessagesSent-Anomaly
      ActionsEnabled: false
      AlarmDescription: Anomaly detection alarm for average messages sent on FIFO queue with DLQ
      Metrics:
        - Id: m1
          MetricStat:
            Metric:
              Namespace: AWS/SQS
              MetricName: NumberOfMessagesSent
              Dimensions:
                - Name: QueueName
                  Value: !GetAtt FIFOQueueWithDLQ.QueueName
            Period: 300
            Stat: Average

final_template:
AWSTemplateFormatVersion: "2010-09-09"
Description: "PCI DSS Remediation Automation Documents and Prerequisite Resources"

Parameters:
  CloudTrailLogGroupName:
    Type: String
    Default: aws-cloudtrail-logs
    Description: Name of the CloudTrail CloudWatch Logs log group

Resources:
  # ============================================================
  # PREREQUISITE RESOURCES
  # ============================================================

  CloudTrailLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Ref CloudTrailLogGroupName
      RetentionInDays: 1827

  KmsKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    Properties:
      Description: KMS CMK for PCI DSS compliance
      Enabled: true
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Sid: EnableRootFullAccess
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub arn:aws:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root
            Action: kms:*
            Resource: "*"

  KmsKeyAlias:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Alias
    Properties:
      AliasName: alias/pci-dss-kms-key
      TargetKeyId: !Ref KmsKey

  SsmAutomationRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: ssm.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/IAMFullAccess
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AdministratorAccess
      RoleName: SSMAutomationRemediationRole

  CloudTrailCloudWatchRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: cloudtrail.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: CloudTrailCloudWatchPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: "2012-10-17"
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:DescribeLogGroups
                  - logs:DescribeLogStreams
                  - logs:PutRetentionPolicy
                  - logs:CreateLogGroup
                Resource: !GetAtt CloudTrailLogGroup.Arn
      RoleName: CloudTrailCloudWatchRole

  # ============================================================
  # SSM AUTOMATION DOCUMENTS
  # ============================================================

  # Document 1: Encrypt CloudTrail trail with KMS key and integrate with CloudWatch Logs
  EncryptCloudTrailDocument:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Document
    Properties:
      DocumentType: Automation
      Content:
        schemaVersion: "0.3"
        description: Encrypt a CloudTrail trail with a KMS key and integrate with CloudWatch Logs
        assumeRole: "{{ AutomationAssumeRole }}"
        parameters:
          TrailName:
            type: String
            description: The name of the CloudTrail trail
          KmsKeyId:
            type: String
            description: The KMS key ID or ARN
          CloudWatchLogsLogGroupArn:
            type: String
            description: The ARN of the CloudWatch Logs log group
          CloudWatchLogsRoleArn:
            type: String
            description: The ARN of the IAM role for CloudWatch Logs integration
          AutomationAssumeRole:
            type: String
            description: The ARN of the role that allows Automation to perform the actions
            default: ""
        mainSteps:
          - name: encryptAndIntegrateCloudTrail
            action: aws:executeAwsApi
            inputs:
              Service: cloudtrail
              Api: UpdateTrail
              Name: "{{ TrailName }}"
              KmsKeyId: "{{ KmsKeyId }}"
              CloudWatchLogsLogGroupArn: "{{ CloudWatchLogsLogGroupArn }}"
              CloudWatchLogsRoleArn: "{{ CloudWatchLogsRoleArn }}"
            outputs:
              - Name: TrailARN
                Selector: $.TrailARN
                Type: String
          - name: verifyEncryption
            action: aws:assertAwsResourceProperty
            inputs:
              Service: cloudtrail
              Api: GetTrail
              Name: "{{ TrailName }}"
              PropertySelector: $.Trail.KmsKeyId
              DesiredValues:
                - "{{ KmsKeyId }}"
      Name: PCI-DSS-EncryptCloudTrail
      Tags:
        - Key: Purpose
          Value: PCI-DSS-Remediation

  # Document 2: Enable key rotation for a KMS key
  EnableKeyRotationDocument:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Document
    Properties:
      DocumentType: Automation
      Content:
        schemaVersion: "0.3"
        description: Enable key rotation for a specified KMS key
        assumeRole: "{{ AutomationAssumeRole }}"
        parameters:
          KeyId:
            type: String
            description: The ID or ARN of the KMS key
          AutomationAssumeRole:
            type: String
            description: The ARN of the role that allows Automation to perform the actions
            default: ""
        mainSteps:
          - name: enableKeyRotation
            action: aws:executeAwsApi
            inputs:
              Service: kms
              Api: EnableKeyRotation
              KeyId: "{{ KeyId }}"
          - name: verifyKeyRotation
            action: aws:assertAwsResourceProperty
            inputs:
              Service: kms
              Api: GetKeyRotationStatus
              KeyId: "{{ KeyId }}"
              PropertySelector: $.KeyRotationEnabled
              DesiredValues:
                - true
      Name: PCI-DSS-EnableKeyRotation
      Tags:
        - Key: Purpose
          Value: PCI-DSS-Remediation

  # Document 3: Integrate a CloudTrail trail with CloudWatch Logs
  IntegrateCloudTrailCloudWatchDocument:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Document
    Properties:
      DocumentType: Automation
      Content:
        schemaVersion: "0.3"
        description: Integrate a CloudTrail trail with CloudWatch Logs
        assumeRole: "{{ AutomationAssumeRole }}"
        parameters:
          TrailName:
            type: String
            description: The name of the CloudTrail trail
          CloudWatchLogsLogGroupArn:
            type: String
            description: The ARN of the CloudWatch Logs log group
          CloudWatchLogsRoleArn:
            type: String
            description: The ARN of the IAM role for CloudWatch Logs integration
          AutomationAssumeRole:
            type: String
            description: The ARN of the role that allows Automation to perform the actions
            default: ""
        mainSteps:
          - name: integrateCloudTrailCloudWatch
            action: aws:executeAwsApi
            inputs:
              Service: cloudtrail
              Api: UpdateTrail
              Name: "{{ TrailName }}"
              CloudWatchLogsLogGroupArn: "{{ CloudWatchLogsLogGroupArn }}"
              CloudWatchLogsRoleArn: "{{ CloudWatchLogsRoleArn }}"
            outputs:
              - Name: TrailARN
                Selector: $.TrailARN
                Type: String
          - name: verifyIntegration
            action: aws:assertAwsResourceProperty
            inputs:
              Service: cloudtrail
              Api: GetTrail
              Name: "{{ TrailName }}"
              PropertySelector: $.Trail.CloudWatchLogsLogGroupArn
              DesiredValues:
                - "{{ CloudWatchLogsLogGroupArn }}"
      Name: PCI-DSS-IntegrateCloudTrailCloudWatch
      Tags:
        - Key: Purpose
          Value: PCI-DSS-Remediation

  # Document 4: Update IAM password policy
  UpdatePasswordPolicyDocument:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Document
    Properties:
      DocumentType: Automation
      Content:
        schemaVersion: "0.3"
        description: Update the account IAM password policy to enforce PCI DSS requirements
        assumeRole: "{{ AutomationAssumeRole }}"
        parameters:
          AutomationAssumeRole:
            type: String
            description: The ARN of the role that allows Automation to perform the actions
            default: ""
        mainSteps:
          - name: updatePasswordPolicy
            action: aws:executeAwsApi
            inputs:
              Service: iam
              Api: UpdateAccountPasswordPolicy
              MinimumPasswordLength: 14
              RequireUppercaseCharacters: true
              RequireLowercaseCharacters: true
              RequireNumbers: true
              RequireSymbols: true
              AllowUsersToChangePassword: true
              HardExpiry: true
              MaxPasswordAge: 90
              PasswordReusePrevention: 24
          - name: verifyPasswordPolicy
            action: aws:assertAwsResourceProperty
            inputs:
              Service: iam
              Api: GetAccountPasswordPolicy
              PropertySelector: $.PasswordPolicy.MinimumPasswordLength
              DesiredValues:
                - 14
      Name: PCI-DSS-UpdatePasswordPolicy
      Tags:
        - Key: Purpose
          Value: PCI-DSS-Remediation

  # Document 5: Enable log file validation for CloudTrail + multi-region + CloudWatch integration
  EnableLogFileValidationDocument:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Document
    Properties:
      DocumentType: Automation
      Content:
        schemaVersion: "0.3"
        description: Enable log file validation for a CloudTrail trail with multi-region and CloudWatch integration
        assumeRole: "{{ AutomationAssumeRole }}"
        parameters:
          TrailName:
            type: String
            description: The name of the CloudTrail trail
          CloudWatchLogsLogGroupArn:
            type: String
            description: The ARN of the CloudWatch Logs log group
          CloudWatchLogsRoleArn:
            type: String
            description: The ARN of the IAM role for CloudWatch Logs integration
          AutomationAssumeRole:
            type: String
            description: The ARN of the role that allows Automation to perform the actions
            default: ""
        mainSteps:
          - name: enableLogFileValidation
            action: aws:executeAwsApi
            inputs:
              Service: cloudtrail
              Api: UpdateTrail
              Name: "{{ TrailName }}"
              EnableLogFileValidation: true
              IsMultiRegionTrail: true
              CloudWatchLogsLogGroupArn: "{{ CloudWatchLogsLogGroupArn }}"
              CloudWatchLogsRoleArn: "{{ CloudWatchLogsRoleArn }}"
            outputs:
              - Name: TrailARN
                Selector: $.TrailARN
                Type: String
          - name: verifyValidation
            action: aws:assertAwsResourceProperty
            inputs:
              Service: cloudtrail
              Api: GetTrail
              Name: "{{ TrailName }}"
              PropertySelector: $.Trail.LogFileValidationEnabled
              DesiredValues:
                - true
      Name: PCI-DSS-EnableLogFileValidation
      Tags:
        - Key: Purpose
          Value: PCI-DSS-Remediation

  # Document 6: Revoke all inbound and outbound rules on a default security group
  RevokeDefaultSGRulesDocument:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Document
    Properties:
      DocumentType: Automation
      Content:
        schemaVersion: "0.3"
        description: Revoke all inbound and outbound rules on a given default security group
        assumeRole: "{{ AutomationAssumeRole }}"
        parameters:
          SecurityGroupId:
            type: String
            description: The ID of the default security group
          AutomationAssumeRole:
            type: String
            description: The ARN of the role that allows Automation to perform the actions
            default: ""
        mainSteps:
          - name: describeSecurityGroup
            action: aws:executeScript
            inputs:
              Runtime: python3.9
              Handler: revoke_security_group_rules
              InputPayload:
                SecurityGroupId: "{{ SecurityGroupId }}"
              Script: |
                import boto3
                import json

                def revoke_security_group_rules(event, context):
                    ec2 = boto3.client('ec2')
                    sg_id = event['SecurityGroupId']

                    sg = ec2.describe_security_groups(GroupIds=[sg_id])['SecurityGroups'][0]

                    revoked = {
                        'IngressRuleCount': 0,
                        'EgressRuleCount': 0
                    }

                    if sg['IpPermissions']:
                        ec2.revoke_security_group_ingress(
                            GroupId=sg_id,
                            IpPermissions=sg['IpPermissions']
                        )
                        revoked['IngressRuleCount'] = len(sg['IpPermissions'])

                    if sg['IpPermissionsEgress']:
                        ec2.revoke_security_group_egress(
                            GroupId=sg_id,
                            IpPermissionsEgress=sg['IpPermissionsEgress']
                        )
                        revoked['EgressRuleCount'] = len(sg['IpPermissionsEgress'])

                    return revoked
            outputs:
              - Name: RevokeResults
                Selector: $.Payload
                Type: StringMap
      Name: PCI-DSS-RevokeDefaultSGRules
      Tags:
        - Key: Purpose
          Value: PCI-DSS-Remediation

  # Document 7: Delete a specified security group
  DeleteSecurityGroupDocument:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Document
    Properties:
      DocumentType: Automation
      Content:
        schemaVersion: "0.3"
        description: Delete a specified security group
        assumeRole: "{{ AutomationAssumeRole }}"
        parameters:
          SecurityGroupId:
            type: String
            description: The ID of the security group to delete
          AutomationAssumeRole:
            type: String
            description: The ARN of the role that allows Automation to perform the actions
            default: ""
        mainSteps:
          - name: deleteSecurityGroup
            action: aws:executeAwsApi
            inputs:
              Service: ec2
              Api: DeleteSecurityGroup
              GroupId: "{{ SecurityGroupId }}"
          - name: verifyDeletion
            action: aws:assertAwsResourceProperty
            inputs:
              Service: ec2
              Api: DescribeSecurityGroups
              GroupIds:
                - "{{ SecurityGroupId }}"
              PropertySelector: $.SecurityGroups[0].GroupId
              DesiredValues: []
      Name: PCI-DSS-DeleteSecurityGroup
      Tags:
        - Key: Purpose
          Value: PCI-DSS-Remediation

  # Document 8: Release an unused Elastic IP address
  ReleaseElasticIPDocument:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Document
    Properties:
      DocumentType: Automation

        schemaVersion: "0.3"

            type: String
            description: The allocation ID of the Elastic IP address to release

            type: String
            description: The ARN of the role that allows Automation to perform the actions
            default: ""
        mainSteps:
          - name: releaseElasticIp
            action: aws:executeAwsApi
            inputs:
              Service: ec2
              Api: ReleaseAddress
              AllocationId: "{{ AllocationId }}"
      Name: PCI-DSS-ReleaseElasticIP
      Tags:
        - Key: Purpose
          Value: PCI-DSS-Remediation

  # Document 9: Update CodeBuild project to remove AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID and AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY environment variables
  UpdateCodeBuildProjectDocument:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Document
    Properties:
      DocumentType: Automation
      Content:
        schemaVersion: "0.3"
        description: Update a CodeBuild project to remove any environment variables named AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID or AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY
        assumeRole: "{{ AutomationAssumeRole }}"
        parameters:
          ProjectName:
            type: String
            description: The name of the CodeBuild project
          AutomationAssumeRole:
            type: String
            description: The ARN of the role that allows Automation to perform the actions
            default: ""
        mainSteps:
          - name: updateCodeBuildProject
            action: aws:executeScript
            inputs:
              Runtime: python3.9
              Handler: remove_sensitive_env_vars
              InputPayload:
                ProjectName: "{{ ProjectName }}"
              Script: |
                import boto3
                import json

                def remove_sensitive_env_vars(event, context):
                    codebuild = boto3.client('codebuild')
                    project_name = event['ProjectName']

                    response = codebuild.batch_get_projects(names=[project_name])
                    project = response['projects'][0]

                    env = project.get('environment', {})
                    env_vars = env.get('environmentVariables', [])

                    sensitive_keys = {'AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID', 'AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY'}
                    filtered_vars = [v for v in env_vars if v.get('name') not in sensitive_keys]

                    if len(env_vars) == len(filtered_vars):
                        return {
                            'Success': True,
                            'Message': 'No sensitive environment variables found',
                            'ProjectName': project_name
                        }

                    env['environmentVariables'] = filtered_vars

                    update_params = {
                        'name': project_name,
                        'description': project.get('description', ''),
                        'serviceRole': project.get('serviceRole', ''),
                        'artifacts': project.get('artifacts', {}),
                        'environment': env,
                        'source': project.get('source', {}),
                        'timeoutInMinutes': project.get('timeoutInMinutes', 60),
                    }

                    if 'queuedTimeoutInMinutes' in project:
                        update_params['queuedTimeoutInMinutes'] = project['queuedTimeoutInMinutes']
                    if 'encryptionKey' in project:
                        update_params['encryptionKey'] = project['encryptionKey']
                    if 'tags' in project:
                        update_params['tags'] = project['tags']

final_template:
AWSTemplateFormatVersion: "2010-09-09"
Description: "CDK Bootstrap Template - Self-contained environment for deploying AWS CDK applications"

Parameters:
  Qualifier:
    Description: A short string to uniquely identify stack components in the same account and region
    Type: String
    Default: cdk
    AllowedPattern: "[a-z0-9]{1,10}"
    ConstraintDescription: Must be 1-10 lowercase alphanumeric characters
    MaxLength: 10
    MinLength: 1

  BootstrapVersion:
    Description: Version of the CDK bootstrap template
    Type: String
    Default: "22"

  TrustedAccounts:
    Description: Comma-separated list of AWS account IDs that can assume lookup and deployment roles
    Type: CommaDelimitedList
    Default: ""

  FileAssetBucketName:
    Description: Optional custom name for the file assets S3 bucket. If empty, a name is auto-generated.
    Type: String
    Default: ""

  ExistingKmsKeyId:
    Description: ARN of an existing KMS key for S3 bucket encryption. If empty, a new key is created.
    Type: String
    Default: ""

  ManagedPolicyArns:
    Description: Comma-separated list of managed policy ARNs to attach to deployment roles
    Type: CommaDelimitedList
    Default: ""

Conditions:
  CreateKmsKey: !Not [!Condition UseExistingKmsKey]
  UseExistingKmsKey: !Not [!Eq [!Ref ExistingKmsKeyId, ""]]
  UseCustomBucketName: !Not [!Eq [!Ref FileAssetBucketName, ""]]
  HasTrustedAccounts: !Not [!Eq [!Join ["", !Ref TrustedAccounts], ""]]
  HasManagedPolicyArns: !Not [!Eq [!Join ["", !Ref ManagedPolicyArns], ""]]

Resources:
  # ----------------------------------------------------------------------
  # KMS Key for S3 bucket encryption
  # ----------------------------------------------------------------------
  FileAssetsBucketKey:
    Condition: CreateKmsKey
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    Properties:
      Description: !Sub "KMS key for CDK bootstrap file assets bucket (qualifier ${Qualifier})"
      KeyUsage: ENCRYPT_DECRYPT
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      PendingWindowInDays: 7
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "cdk-${Qualifier}-assets-key"
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Sid: Enable IAM User Permissions
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root"
            Action: "kms:*"
            Resource: "*"
          - Sid: Allow S3 to use the key for bucket encryption
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: s3.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - "kms:Decrypt"
              - "kms:GenerateDataKey"
              - "kms:Encrypt"
            Resource: "*"
            Condition:
              ArnLike:
                "kms:EncryptionContext:aws:s3:arn": !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:s3:::${FileAssetBucket}"

  FileAssetsBucketKeyAlias:
    Condition: CreateKmsKey
    Type: AWS::KMS::Alias
    Properties:
      AliasName: !Sub "alias/cdk-${Qualifier}-assets-key"
      TargetKeyId: !Ref FileAssetsBucketKey

  FileAssetsBucketKeyAliasCurrent:
    Condition: CreateKmsKey
    Type: AWS::KMS::Alias
    Properties:
      AliasName: !Sub "alias/cdk-${Qualifier}-assets-key/current"
      TargetKeyId: !Ref FileAssetsBucketKey

  # ----------------------------------------------------------------------
  # S3 Bucket for file assets
  # ----------------------------------------------------------------------
  FileAssetBucket:
    Type: AWS::S3::Bucket
    Properties:
      BucketName: !If
        - UseCustomBucketName
        - !Ref FileAssetBucketName
        - !Ref "AWS::NoValue"
      BucketEncryption:
        ServerSideEncryptionConfiguration:
          - ServerSideEncryptionByDefault:
              SSEAlgorithm: aws:kms
              KMSMasterKeyID: !If
                - UseExistingKmsKey
                - !Ref ExistingKmsKeyId
                - !Ref FileAssetsBucketKey
            BucketKeyEnabled: true
      VersioningConfiguration:
        Status: Enabled
      PublicAccessBlockConfiguration:
        BlockPublicAcls: true
        BlockPublicPolicy: true
        IgnorePublicAcls: true
        RestrictPublicBuckets: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "cdk-${Qualifier}-assets-bucket"
        - Key: aws-cdk:bootstrap-version
          Value: !Ref BootstrapVersion

  FileAssetBucketPolicy:
    Type: AWS::S3::BucketPolicy
    Properties:
      Bucket: !Ref FileAssetBucket
      PolicyDocument:
        Statement:
          - Sid: HttpsOnly
            Effect: Deny
            Principal: "*"
            Action: "s3:*"
            Resource:
              - !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:s3:::${FileAssetBucket}/*"
              - !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:s3:::${FileAssetBucket}"
            Condition:
              Bool:
                "aws:SecureTransport": false

  # ----------------------------------------------------------------------
  # ECR Repository for container assets
  # ----------------------------------------------------------------------
  ContainerAssetRepository:
    Type: AWS::ECR::Repository
    Properties:
      RepositoryName: !Sub "cdk-${Qualifier}-container-assets"
      ImageTagMutability: IMMUTABLE
      ImageScanningConfiguration:
        ScanOnPush: true
      EncryptionConfiguration:
        EncryptionType: AES256
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "cdk-${Qualifier}-container-repo"
        - Key: aws-cdk:bootstrap-version
          Value: !Ref BootstrapVersion

  # ----------------------------------------------------------------------
  # SSM Parameter to track bootstrap version
  # ----------------------------------------------------------------------
  BootstrapVersionParameter:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub "/cdk-bootstrap/${Qualifier}/version"
      Type: String
      Value: !Ref BootstrapVersion
      Description: !Sub "CDK bootstrap version for qualifier ${Qualifier}"
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "cdk-bootstrap-${Qualifier}-version"

  # ----------------------------------------------------------------------
  # IAM Roles
  # ----------------------------------------------------------------------

  # File Publishing Role
  FilePublishingRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub "cdk-${Qualifier}-file-publishing-role-${AWS::AccountId}-${AWS::Region}"
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Sid: AllowDeploymentAccountToAssume
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !If
                - HasTrustedAccounts
                - !Ref TrustedAccounts
                - !Ref "AWS::NoValue"
            Action: "sts:AssumeRole"
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                "aws:UserId": !Sub "${AWS::UserId}:*"
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/AdministratorAccess"
        - !If
          - HasManagedPolicyArns
          - !Ref ManagedPolicyArns
          - !Ref "AWS::NoValue"
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: "file-publishing-permissions"
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: "2012-10-17"
            Statement:
              - Sid: S3Access
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - "s3:AbortMultipartUpload"
                  - "s3:GetBucketLocation"
                  - "s3:GetObject"
                  - "s3:GetObjectAcl"
                  - "s3:GetObjectTagging"
                  - "s3:GetObjectVersion"
                  - "s3:ListBucket"
                  - "s3:ListBucketMultipartUploads"
                  - "s3:ListMultipartUploadParts"
                  - "s3:PutObject"
                  - "s3:PutObjectAcl"
                  - "s3:PutObjectTagging"
                  - "s3:RestoreObject"
                Resource:
                  - !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:s3:::${FileAssetBucket}"
                  - !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:s3:::${FileAssetBucket}/*"
              - Sid: KMSAccess
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - "kms:Decrypt"
                  - "kms:DescribeKey"
                  - "kms:Encrypt"
                  - "kms:GenerateDataKey"
                  - "kms:ReEncrypt*"
                Resource:
                  - !If
                    - UseExistingKmsKey
                    - !Ref ExistingKmsKeyId
                    - !GetAtt FileAssetsBucketKey.Arn
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "cdk-${Qualifier}-file-publishing-role"
        - Key: aws-cdk:bootstrap-version
          Value: !Ref BootstrapVersion

  # Image Publishing Role
  ImagePublishingRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub "cdk-${Qualifier}-image-publishing-role-${AWS::AccountId}-${AWS::Region}"
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Sid: AllowDeploymentAccountToAssume
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !If
                - HasTrustedAccounts
                - !Ref TrustedAccounts
                - !Ref "AWS::NoValue"
            Action: "sts:AssumeRole"
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                "aws:UserId": !Sub "${AWS::UserId}:*"
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/AdministratorAccess"
        - !If
          - HasManagedPolicyArns
          - !Ref ManagedPolicyArns
          - !Ref "AWS::NoValue"
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: "image-publishing-permissions"
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: "2012-10-17"
            Statement:
              - Sid: ECRAccess
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - "ecr:CompleteLayerUpload"
                  - "ecr:GetAuthorizationToken"
                  - "ecr:InitiateLayerUpload"
                  - "ecr:PutImage"
                  - "ecr:UploadLayerPart"
                  - "ecr:BatchCheckLayerAvailability"
                  - "ecr:DescribeRepositories"
                  - "ecr:DescribeImages"
                  - "ecr:ListTagsForResource"
                Resource:
                  - !GetAtt ContainerAssetRepository.Arn
                  - !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:ecr:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:repository/cdk-${Qualifier}-container-assets"
              - Sid: KMSAccess
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - "kms:DescribeKey"
                  - "kms:GenerateDataKey*"
                  - "kms:Encrypt"
                  - "kms:Decrypt"
                Resource:
                  - !If
                    - UseExistingKmsKey
                    - !Ref ExistingKmsKeyId
                    - !GetAtt FileAssetsBucketKey.Arn
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "cdk-${Qualifier}-image-publishing-role"
        - Key: aws-cdk:bootstrap-version
          Value: !Ref BootstrapVersion

  # Account Lookup Role
  AccountLookupRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub "cdk-${Qualifier}-lookup-role-${AWS::AccountId}-${AWS::Region}"
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Sid: AllowTrustedAccountsToAssume
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !If
                - HasTrustedAccounts
                - !Ref TrustedAccounts
                - !Ref "AWS::NoValue"
            Action: "sts:AssumeRole"
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                "aws:UserId": !Sub "${AWS::UserId}:*"
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/ReadOnlyAccess"
        - !If
          - HasManagedPolicyArns
          - !Ref ManagedPolicyArns
          - !Ref "AWS::NoValue"
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: "lookup-permissions"
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: "2012-10-17"
            Statement:
              - Sid: AllowLookupActions
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - "iam:GetUser"
                  - "iam:GetRole"
                  - "sts:GetCallerIdentity"
                  - "Organizations:DescribeAccount"
                  - "Organizations:DescribeOrganization"
                  - "Organizations:ListAccounts"
                  - "ec2:DescribeAccountAttributes"
                  - "ec2:DescribeSecurityGroups"
                  - "ec2:DescribeSubnets"
                  - "ec2:DescribeVpcs"
                  - "ec2:DescribeImages"
                  - "ec2:DescribeAddresses"
                  - "ec2:DescribeRouteTables"
                  - "ssm:GetParameter"
                Resource: "*"
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "cdk-${Qualifier}-lookup-role"
        - Key: aws-cdk:bootstrap-version
          Value: !Ref BootstrapVersion

  # Deployment Action Role
  DeploymentActionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub "cdk-${Qualifier}-deploy-action-role-${AWS::AccountId}-${AWS::Region}"
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Sid: AllowTrustedAccountsToAssume
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !If
                - HasTrustedAccounts
                - !Ref TrustedAccounts
                - !Ref "AWS::NoValue"
            Action: "sts:AssumeRole"
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                "aws:UserId": !Sub "${AWS::UserId}:*"
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/AdministratorAccess"
        - !If
          - HasManagedPolicyArns
          - !Ref ManagedPolicyArns
          - !Ref "AWS::NoValue"
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: "deployment-action-permissions"
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: "2012-10-17"
            Statement:
              - Sid: AllowFilePublishingAssume
                Effect: Allow
                Action: "sts:AssumeRole"
                Resource:
                  - !GetAtt FilePublishingRole.Arn
              - Sid: AllowImagePublishingAssume
                Effect: Allow
                Action: "sts:AssumeRole"
                Resource:
                  - !GetAtt ImagePublishingRole.Arn
              - Sid: AllowLookupAssume
                Effect: Allow
                Action: "sts:AssumeRole"
                Resource:
                  - !GetAtt AccountLookupRole.Arn
              - Sid: AllowCloudFormationExecution
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - "cloudformation:CreateChangeSet"
                  - "cloudformation:DeleteChangeSet"
                  - "cloudformation:DescribeChangeSet"
                  - "cloudformation:ExecuteChangeSet"
                  - "cloudformation:DescribeStacks"
                  - "cloudformation:CreateStack"
                  - "cloudformation:UpdateStack"
                  - "cloudformation:DeleteStack"
                  - "cloudformation:GetTemplate"
                  - "cloudformation:GetStackPolicy"
                  - "cloudformation:SetStackPolicy"
                  - "cloudformation:DescribeStackEvents"
                  - "cloudformation:DescribeStackResource"
                  - "cloudformation:DescribeStackResources"
                  - "cloudformation:ListStackResources"
                  - "cloudformation:TagResource"
                  - "cloudformation:UntagResource"
                  - "iam:PassRole"
                Resource: "*"
                Condition:
                  StringEquals:
                    "iam:PassedToService": "cloudformation.amazonaws.com"
              - Sid: AllowStackOperations
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - "cloudformation:DescribeStackEvents"
                  - "cloudformation:DescribeStackResource"
                  - "cloudformation:DescribeStackResources"
                  - "cloudformation:DescribeStacks"
                  - "cloudformation:GetTemplate"
                  - "cloudformation:ListStackResources"
                Resource: "*"
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "cdk-${Qualifier}-deploy-action-role"
        - Key: aws-cdk:bootstrap-version
          Value: !Ref BootstrapVersion

  # CloudFormation Execution Role
  CloudFormationExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub "cdk-${Qualifier}-cfn-exec-role-${AWS::AccountId}-${AWS::Region}"
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Sid: AllowCloudFormationService
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: cloudformation.amazonaws.com
            Action: "sts:AssumeRole"
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/AdministratorAccess"
        - !If
          - HasManagedPolicyArns
          - !Ref ManagedPolicyArns
          - !Ref "AWS::NoValue"
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: "cfn-exec-permissions"
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: "2012-10-17"
            Statement:
              - Sid: AllowCfnResourceCreation
                Effect: Allow
                Action: "*"
                Resource: "*"
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "cdk-${Qualifier}-cfn-exec-role"
        - Key: aws-cdk:bootstrap-version
          Value: !Ref BootstrapVersion

Outputs:
  FileAssetBucketName:
    Description: Name of the S3 bucket for file assets
    Value: !Ref FileAssetBucket

  FileAssetBucketArn:
    Description: ARN of the S3 bucket for file assets
    Value: !GetAtt FileAssetBucket.Arn

  ContainerAssetRepositoryName:
    Description: Name of the ECR repository for container assets
    Value: !Ref ContainerAssetRepository

  ContainerAssetRepositoryArn:
    Description: ARN of the ECR repository for container assets
    Value: !GetAtt ContainerAssetRepository.Arn

  FileAssetsBucketKeyArn:

  BootstrapVersion:
