final_template:
AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: Service Catalog ML Workshop Environment with Admin and End User Portfolios

Parameters:
  RootS3URL:
    Type: String
    Default: https://aws-service-catalog-reference-architectures.s3.amazonaws.com/blog_content/securing-third-party-data-and-ml-apps
    Description: Root S3 URL pointing to the location of nested CloudFormation templates
  EnvironmentPrefix:
    Type: String
    Default: user-1
    Description: Prefix for environment resources

Resources:
  ###############################################################################
  # PORTFOLIOS
  ###############################################################################
  AdminPortfolio:
    Type: AWS::ServiceCatalog::Portfolio
    Properties:
      DisplayName: !Sub ${EnvironmentPrefix}-admin-portfolio
      Description: Admin portfolio for the ML workshop containing VPC, IAM/KMS/S3, and AWS Data Exchange products
      ProviderName: MLWorkshop
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentPrefix

  EndUserPortfolio:
    Type: AWS::ServiceCatalog::Portfolio
    Properties:
      DisplayName: !Sub ${EnvironmentPrefix}-end-user-portfolio
      Description: End user portfolio for the ML workshop containing Infrastructure, Application, SageMaker, and Third-party ML products
      ProviderName: MLWorkshop
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentPrefix

  ###############################################################################
  # PRODUCTS - Admin Portfolio
  ###############################################################################
  VPCProduct:
    Type: AWS::ServiceCatalog::CloudFormationProduct
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub ${EnvironmentPrefix}-vpc-product
      Description: VPC with private subnets and endpoints for the ML workshop
      Owner: MLWorkshop
      ProvisioningArtifactParameters:
        - Name: v1
          Description: Initial version
          Info:
            LoadTemplateFromURL: !Sub ${RootS3URL}/templates/vpc.yaml
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentPrefix

  IAMKMSProduct:
    Type: AWS::ServiceCatalog::CloudFormationProduct
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub ${EnvironmentPrefix}-iam-kms-s3-product
      Description: IAM roles with KMS keys and S3 buckets for the ML workshop
      Owner: MLWorkshop
      ProvisioningArtifactParameters:
        - Name: v1
          Description: Initial version
          Info:
            LoadTemplateFromURL: !Sub ${RootS3URL}/templates/iam-kms-s3.yaml
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentPrefix

  DataExchangeProduct:
    Type: AWS::ServiceCatalog::CloudFormationProduct
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub ${EnvironmentPrefix}-data-exchange-product
      Description: AWS Data Exchange product for the ML workshop
      Owner: MLWorkshop
      ProvisioningArtifactParameters:
        - Name: v1
          Description: Initial version
          Info:
            LoadTemplateFromURL: !Sub ${RootS3URL}/templates/data-exchange.yaml
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentPrefix

  ###############################################################################
  # PRODUCTS - End User Portfolio
  ###############################################################################
  InfrastructureProduct:
    Type: AWS::ServiceCatalog::CloudFormationProduct
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub ${EnvironmentPrefix}-infrastructure-product
      Description: Infrastructure product for the ML workshop
      Owner: MLWorkshop
      ProvisioningArtifactParameters:
        - Name: v1
          Description: Initial version
          Info:
            LoadTemplateFromURL: !Sub ${RootS3URL}/templates/infrastructure.yaml
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentPrefix

  ApplicationProduct:
    Type: AWS::ServiceCatalog::CloudFormationProduct
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub ${EnvironmentPrefix}-application-product
      Description: Application product for the ML workshop
      Owner: MLWorkshop
      ProvisioningArtifactParameters:
        - Name: v1
          Description: Initial version
          Info:
            LoadTemplateFromURL: !Sub ${RootS3URL}/templates/application.yaml
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentPrefix

  SageMakerProduct:
    Type: AWS::ServiceCatalog::CloudFormationProduct
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub ${EnvironmentPrefix}-sagemaker-product
      Description: SageMaker notebook instance product for the ML workshop
      Owner: MLWorkshop
      ProvisioningArtifactParameters:
        - Name: v1
          Description: Initial version
          Info:
            LoadTemplateFromURL: !Sub ${RootS3URL}/templates/sagemaker.yaml
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentPrefix

  ThirdPartyMLProduct:
    Type: AWS::ServiceCatalog::CloudFormationProduct
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub ${EnvironmentPrefix}-third-party-ml-product
      Description: Third-party ML model product for the ML workshop
      Owner: MLWorkshop
      ProvisioningArtifactParameters:
        - Name: v1
          Description: Initial version
          Info:
            LoadTemplateFromURL: !Sub ${RootS3URL}/templates/third-party-ml.yaml
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentPrefix

  ###############################################################################
  # LAUNCH ROLES - Admin Portfolio Products
  ###############################################################################
  VPCLaunchRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub ${EnvironmentPrefix}-vpc-launch-role
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: servicecatalog.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: VPCProvisioningPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ec2:CreateVpc
                  - ec2:CreateSubnet
                  - ec2:CreateRouteTable
                  - ec2:CreateRoute
                  - ec2:AssociateRouteTable
                  - ec2:CreateSecurityGroup
                  - ec2:AuthorizeSecurityGroupIngress
                  - ec2:AuthorizeSecurityGroupEgress
                  - ec2:CreateVpcEndpoint
                  - ec2:CreateTags
                  - ec2:DescribeVpcs
                  - ec2:DescribeSubnets
                  - ec2:DescribeRouteTables
                  - ec2:DescribeSecurityGroups
                  - ec2:DescribeVpcEndpoints
                  - ec2:DescribeAvailabilityZones
                  - ec2:DescribeVpcEndpointServices
                  - ec2:CreateNetworkAcl
                  - ec2:CreateNetworkAclEntry
                  - ec2:AssociateNetworkAcl
                Resource: '*'
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - cloudformation:CreateStack
                  - cloudformation:UpdateStack
                  - cloudformation:DeleteStack
                  - cloudformation:DescribeStacks
                  - cloudformation:DescribeStackEvents
                  - cloudformation:DescribeStackResources
                  - cloudformation:GetTemplate
                  - cloudformation:ListStackResources
                Resource: '*'
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:GetObject
                Resource: !Sub arn:aws:s3:::${RootS3URL}/*
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentPrefix

  IAMKMSLaunchRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub ${EnvironmentPrefix}-iam-kms-launch-role
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: servicecatalog.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: IAMKMSProvisioningPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - iam:CreateRole
                  - iam:CreatePolicy
                  - iam:AttachRolePolicy
                  - iam:PutRolePolicy
                  - iam:PassRole
                  - iam:GetRole
                  - iam:GetPolicy
                  - iam:ListRoles
                  - iam:ListPolicies
                  - iam:TagRole
                  - iam:TagPolicy
                Resource: '*'
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - kms:CreateKey
                  - kms:CreateAlias
                  - kms:ScheduleKeyDeletion
                  - kms:DescribeKey
                  - kms:GetKeyPolicy
                  - kms:PutKeyPolicy
                  - kms:TagResource
                  - kms:EnableKeyRotation
                Resource: '*'
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:CreateBucket
                  - s3:PutBucketPolicy
                  - s3:PutBucketVersioning
                  - s3:PutBucketTagging
                  - s3:PutEncryptionConfiguration
                  - s3:GetBucketPolicy
                  - s3:GetBucketLocation
                  - s3:ListBucket
                  - s3:PutBucketPublicAccessBlock
                Resource: '*'
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - cloudformation:CreateStack
                  - cloudformation:UpdateStack
                  - cloudformation:DeleteStack
                  - cloudformation:DescribeStacks
                  - cloudformation:DescribeStackEvents
                  - cloudformation:DescribeStackResources
                  - cloudformation:GetTemplate
                  - cloudformation:ListStackResources
                Resource: '*'
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:GetObject
                Resource: !Sub arn:aws:s3:::${RootS3URL}/*
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentPrefix

  DataExchangeLaunchRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub ${EnvironmentPrefix}-data-exchange-launch-role
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: servicecatalog.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: DataExchangeProvisioningPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - dataexchange:CreateDataSet
                  - dataexchange:CreateRevision
                  - dataexchange:CreateAsset
                  - dataexchange:UpdateDataSet
                  - dataexchange:UpdateRevision
                  - dataexchange:GetDataSet
                  - dataexchange:GetRevision
                  - dataexchange:ListDataSets
                  - dataexchange:ListRevisionAssets
                  - dataexchange:TagResource
                  - dataexchange:StartJob
                  - dataexchange:GetJob
                Resource: '*'
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - cloudformation:CreateStack
                  - cloudformation:UpdateStack
                  - cloudformation:DeleteStack
                  - cloudformation:DescribeStacks
                  - cloudformation:DescribeStackEvents
                  - cloudformation:DescribeStackResources
                  - cloudformation:GetTemplate
                  - cloudformation:ListStackResources
                Resource: '*'
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:GetObject
                  - s3:GetObjectVersion
                  - s3:ListBucket
                Resource: '*'
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentPrefix

  ###############################################################################
  # LAUNCH ROLES - End User Portfolio Products
  ###############################################################################
  InfrastructureLaunchRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub ${EnvironmentPrefix}-infrastructure-launch-role
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow

            Action: sts:AssumeRole

            Version: '2012-10-17'

              - Effect: Allow

                  - s3:PutBucketPolicy
                  - s3:PutBucketVersioning
                  - s3:PutBucketTagging
                  - s3:PutEncryptionConfiguration
                  - s3:GetBucketPolicy
                  - s3:GetBucketLocation
                  - s3:ListBucket
                  - s3:PutBucketPublicAccessBlock
                  - s3:GetObject
                  - s3:PutObject
                  - s3:DeleteObject
                  - iam:PassRole
                  - iam:GetRole
                  - iam:CreateRole
                  - iam:CreatePolicy
                  - iam:AttachRolePolicy
                  - iam:PutRolePolicy
                  - iam:TagRole

                  - cloudformation:DescribeStacks
                  - cloudformation:DescribeStackEvents
                  - cloudformation:DescribeStackResources
                  - cloudformation:GetTemplate
                  - cloudformation:ListStackResources
                Resource: '*'
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:

                Resource: !Sub arn:aws:s3:::${RootS3URL}/*
      Tags:

final_template:
AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >-
  Dual-stack (IPv4 + IPv6) VPC network stack for staging or production
  environment with public/private subnets, IGW, egress-only IGW,
  optional NAT gateway, network ACLs, placement group, and DHCP options set.

Parameters:
  Environment:
    Type: String
    AllowedValues:
      - staging
      - production
    Default: staging
    Description: Target environment that determines CIDR ranges and domain name.

  DeployNATGateway:
    Type: String
    AllowedValues:
      - 'true'
      - 'false'
    Default: 'true'
    Description: >-
      Whether to deploy a NAT Gateway with Elastic IP for private-subnet
      outbound IPv4 traffic. Set to false if a bastion handles outbound
      connectivity.

  BastionVPNPort:
    Type: Number
    Default: 1194
    Description: UDP port for bastion VPN access (allowed inbound on public NACL).

Mappings:
  EnvironmentConfig:
    staging:
      VpcCidr: '10.0.0.0/20'
      PublicSubnet1Cidr: '10.0.0.0/24'
      PublicSubnet2Cidr: '10.0.1.0/24'
      PublicSubnet3Cidr: '10.0.2.0/24'
      PrivateAppSubnetCidr: '10.0.3.0/24'
      PrivateDataSubnetCidr: '10.0.4.0/24'
      DomainName: 'staging.internal'
    production:
      VpcCidr: '10.0.0.0/16'
      PublicSubnet1Cidr: '10.0.0.0/22'
      PublicSubnet2Cidr: '10.0.4.0/22'
      PublicSubnet3Cidr: '10.0.8.0/22'
      PrivateAppSubnetCidr: '10.0.12.0/22'
      PrivateDataSubnetCidr: '10.0.16.0/22'
      DomainName: 'prod.internal'

Conditions:
  DeployNAT: !Equals [!Ref DeployNATGateway, 'true']

Resources:
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # VPC – dual-stack IPv4 + IPv6
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  VPC:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Properties:
      CidrBlock:
        Fn::FindInMap:
          - EnvironmentConfig
          - Ref: Environment
          - VpcCidr
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      InstanceTenancy: default
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Join ['-', [!Ref Environment, 'vpc']]
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # IPv6 CIDR block – auto-assigned by AWS from their IPv6 pool
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  VPCCidrBlock:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCCidrBlock
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      AmazonProvidedIpv6CidrBlock: true

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Public subnets (3): 2 in AZ1 (presentation), 1 in AZ2 (compute)
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  PublicSubnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock:
        Fn::FindInMap:
          - EnvironmentConfig
          - Ref: Environment
          - PublicSubnet1Cidr
      AvailabilityZone:
        Fn::Select:
          - 0
          - Fn::GetAZs: ''
      AssignIpv6AddressOnCreation: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Join ['-', [!Ref Environment, 'public-subnet-1']]
        - Key: Tier
          Value: public

  PublicSubnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock:
        Fn::FindInMap:
          - EnvironmentConfig
          - Ref: Environment
          - PublicSubnet2Cidr
      AvailabilityZone:
        Fn::Select:
          - 0
          - Fn::GetAZs: ''
      AssignIpv6AddressOnCreation: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Join ['-', [!Ref Environment, 'public-subnet-2']]
        - Key: Tier
          Value: public

  PublicSubnet3:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock:
        Fn::FindInMap:
          - EnvironmentConfig
          - Ref: Environment
          - PublicSubnet3Cidr
      AvailabilityZone:
        Fn::Select:
          - 1
          - Fn::GetAZs: ''
      AssignIpv6AddressOnCreation: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Join ['-', [!Ref Environment, 'public-subnet-3']]
        - Key: Tier
          Value: public

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Private subnets (2): both in AZ1 (app tier & data tier)
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  PrivateAppSubnet:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock:
        Fn::FindInMap:
          - EnvironmentConfig
          - Ref: Environment
          - PrivateAppSubnetCidr
      AvailabilityZone:
        Fn::Select:
          - 0
          - Fn::GetAZs: ''
      AssignIpv6AddressOnCreation: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Join ['-', [!Ref Environment, 'private-app-subnet']]
        - Key: Tier
          Value: private

  PrivateDataSubnet:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock:
        Fn::FindInMap:
          - EnvironmentConfig
          - Ref: Environment
          - PrivateDataSubnetCidr
      AvailabilityZone:
        Fn::Select:
          - 0
          - Fn::GetAZs: ''
      AssignIpv6AddressOnCreation: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Join ['-', [!Ref Environment, 'private-data-subnet']]
        - Key: Tier
          Value: private

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Internet Gateway
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  InternetGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::InternetGateway
    Properties:
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Join ['-', [!Ref Environment, 'igw']]
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment

  VPCGatewayAttachment:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      InternetGatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway
      VpcId: !Ref VPC

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Egress-Only Internet Gateway (IPv6)
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  EgressOnlyInternetGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::EgressOnlyInternetGateway
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Join ['-', [!Ref Environment, 'eigw']]
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Public Route Table – routes both IPv4 & IPv6 default traffic to IGW
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  PublicRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Join ['-', [!Ref Environment, 'public-rt']]
        - Key: Tier
          Value: public

  PublicDefaultRouteIPv4:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Properties:
      DestinationCidrBlock: '0.0.0.0/0'
      GatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable

  PublicDefaultRouteIPv6:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Properties:
      DestinationIpv6CidrBlock: '::/0'
      GatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Private Route Table
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  PrivateRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Join ['-', [!Ref Environment, 'private-rt']]
        - Key: Tier
          Value: private

  # IPv6 default route via egress-only IGW (always present)
  PrivateDefaultRouteIPv6:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    DependsOn: VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      DestinationIpv6CidrBlock: '::/0'
      GatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Optional NAT Gateway (controlled by DeployNATGateway parameter)
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  NATElasticIP:
    Condition: DeployNAT
    Type: AWS::EC2::EIP
    Properties:
      Domain: vpc
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Join ['-', [!Ref Environment, 'nat-eip']]

  NATGateway:
    Condition: DeployNAT
    Type: AWS::EC2::NatGateway
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet1
      ConnectivityType: public
      AllocationId: !GetAtt NATElasticIP.AllocationId

  PrivateDefaultRouteIPv4:
    Condition: DeployNAT
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Properties:
      DestinationCidrBlock: '0.0.0.0/0'
      NatGatewayId: !Ref NATGateway
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Public subnet associations with the public route table
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  PublicSubnet1RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet1

  PublicSubnet2RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet2

  PublicSubnet3RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet3

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Private subnet associations with the private route table
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  PrivateAppSubnetRouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateAppSubnet

  PrivateDataSubnetRouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateDataSubnet

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Network ACL – Public subnets
  #   Inbound: HTTP, HTTPS, SSH, Bastion VPN, ephemeral return (all
  #   IPv4 & IPv6).  Outbound: all traffic.
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  PublicNetworkACL:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NetworkAcl
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Join ['-', [!Ref Environment, 'public-acl']]
        - Key: Tier
          Value: public

  # --- Inbound rules (IPv4) ---
  PublicACLInHTTP:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NetworkAclEntry
    Properties:
      NetworkAclId: !Ref PublicNetworkACL
      RuleNumber: 100
      Protocol: 6
      RuleAction: allow
      CidrBlock: '0.0.0.0/0'
      PortRange:
        From: 80
        To: 80
      Egress: false

  PublicACLInHTTPS:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NetworkAclEntry
    Properties:
      NetworkAclId: !Ref PublicNetworkACL
      RuleNumber: 110
      Protocol: 6
      RuleAction: allow
      CidrBlock: '0.0.0.0/0'
      PortRange:
        From: 443
        To: 443
      Egress: false

  PublicACLInSSH:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NetworkAclEntry
    Properties:
      NetworkAclId: !Ref PublicNetworkACL
      RuleNumber: 120
      Protocol: 6
      RuleAction: allow
      CidrBlock: '0.0.0.0/0'
      PortRange:
        From: 22
        To: 22
      Egress: false

  PublicACLInBastionVPN:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NetworkAclEntry
    Properties:
      NetworkAclId: !Ref PublicNetworkACL
      RuleNumber: 130
      Protocol: 17
      RuleAction: allow
      CidrBlock: '0.0.0.0/0'
      PortRange:
        From: !Ref BastionVPNPort
        To: !Ref BastionVPNPort
      Egress: false

  PublicACLInEphemeral:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NetworkAclEntry
    Properties:
      NetworkAclId: !Ref PublicNetworkACL
      RuleNumber: 140
      Protocol: 6
      RuleAction: allow
      CidrBlock: '0.0.0.0/0'
      PortRange:
        From: 1024
        To: 65535
      Egress: false

  # --- Inbound rules (IPv6) ---
  PublicACLInHTTPv6:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NetworkAclEntry
    Properties:
      NetworkAclId: !Ref PublicNetworkACL
      RuleNumber: 200
      Protocol: 6
      RuleAction: allow
      Ipv6CidrBlock: '::/0'
      PortRange:
        From: 80
        To: 80
      Egress: false

  PublicACLInHTTPSv6:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NetworkAclEntry
    Properties:
      NetworkAclId: !Ref PublicNetworkACL
      RuleNumber: 210
      Protocol: 6
      RuleAction: allow
      Ipv6CidrBlock: '::/0'
      PortRange:
        From: 443
        To: 443
      Egress: false

  PublicACLInSSHv6:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NetworkAclEntry
    Properties:
      NetworkAclId: !Ref PublicNetworkACL
      RuleNumber: 220
      Protocol: 6
      RuleAction: allow
      Ipv6CidrBlock: '::/0'
      PortRange:
        From: 22
        To: 22
      Egress: false

  PublicACLInBastionVPNv6:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NetworkAclEntry
    Properties:
      NetworkAclId: !Ref PublicNetworkACL
      RuleNumber: 230
      Protocol: 17
      RuleAction: allow
      Ipv6CidrBlock: '::/0'
      PortRange:
        From: !Ref BastionVPNPort
        To: !Ref BastionVPNPort
      Egress: false

  PublicACLInEphemeralv6:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NetworkAclEntry
    Properties:
      NetworkAclId: !Ref PublicNetworkACL
      RuleNumber: 240
      Protocol: 6
      RuleAction: allow
      Ipv6CidrBlock: '::/0'
      PortRange:
        From: 1024
        To: 65535
      Egress: false

  # --- Outbound rules (TCP + UDP + ICMP, IPv4 & IPv6) ---
  PublicACLOutTCP:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NetworkAclEntry
    Properties:
      NetworkAclId: !Ref PublicNetworkACL
      RuleNumber: 100
      Protocol: 6
      RuleAction: allow
      CidrBlock: '0.0.0.0/0'
      PortRange:
        From: 0
        To: 65535
      Egress: true

  PublicACLOutUDP:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NetworkAclEntry
    Properties:
      NetworkAclId: !Ref PublicNetworkACL
      RuleNumber: 110
      Protocol: 17
      RuleAction: allow
      CidrBlock: '0.0.0.0/0'
      PortRange:
        From: 0
        To: 65535
      Egress: true

  PublicACLOutTCPv6:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NetworkAclEntry
    Properties:
      NetworkAclId: !Ref PublicNetworkACL
      RuleNumber: 200
      Protocol: 6
      RuleAction: allow
      Ipv6CidrBlock: '::/0'
      PortRange:
        From: 0
        To: 65535
      Egress: true

  PublicACLOutUDPv6:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NetworkAclEntry
    Properties:
      NetworkAclId: !Ref PublicNetworkACL
      RuleNumber: 210
      Protocol: 17
      RuleAction: allow
      Ipv6CidrBlock: '::/0'
      PortRange:
        From: 0
        To: 65535
      Egress: true

  # Public subnet NACL associations
  PublicSubnet1ACLAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetNetworkAclAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet1
      NetworkAclId: !Ref PublicNetworkACL

  PublicSubnet2ACLAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetNetworkAclAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet2
      NetworkAclId: !Ref PublicNetworkACL

  PublicSubnet3ACLAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetNetworkAclAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet3
      NetworkAclId: !Ref PublicNetworkACL

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Network ACL – Private subnets (all inbound & outbound permitted)
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  PrivateNetworkACL:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NetworkAcl
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Join ['-', [!Ref Environment, 'private-acl']]
        - Key: Tier
          Value: private

  # --- Inbound (IPv4): TCP + UDP + ICMP ---
  PrivateACLInTCP:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NetworkAclEntry
    Properties:
      NetworkAclId: !Ref PrivateNetworkACL
      RuleNumber: 100
      Protocol: 6
      RuleAction: allow
      CidrBlock: '0.0.0.0/0'
      PortRange:
        From: 0
        To: 65535
      Egress: false

  PrivateACLInUDP:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NetworkAclEntry
    Properties:
      NetworkAclId: !Ref PrivateNetworkACL
      RuleNumber: 110
      Protocol: 17
      RuleAction: allow
      CidrBlock: '0.0.0.0/0'
      PortRange:
        From: 0
        To: 65535
      Egress: false

  PrivateACLInICMP:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NetworkAclEntry
    Properties:
      NetworkAclId: !Ref PrivateNetworkACL
      RuleNumber: 120
      Protocol: 1
      RuleAction: allow
      CidrBlock: '0.0.0.0/0'
      Icmp:
        Code: -1
        Type: -1
      Egress: false

  # --- Inbound (IPv6): TCP + UDP + ICMP ---
  PrivateACLInTCPv6:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NetworkAclEntry
    Properties:
      NetworkAclId: !Ref PrivateNetworkACL
      RuleNumber: 200
      Protocol: 6
      RuleAction: allow
      Ipv6CidrBlock: '::/0'
      PortRange:
        From: 0
        To: 65535
      Egress: false

  PrivateACLInUDPv6:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NetworkAclEntry
    Properties:
      NetworkAclId: !Ref PrivateNetworkACL
      RuleNumber: 210
      Protocol: 17
      RuleAction: allow
      Ipv6CidrBlock: '::/0'
      PortRange:
        From: 0
        To: 65535
      Egress: false

  PrivateACLInICMPv6:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NetworkAclEntry
    Properties:
      NetworkAclId: !Ref PrivateNetworkACL
      RuleNumber: 220
      Protocol: 1
      RuleAction: allow
      Ipv6CidrBlock: '::/0'
      Icmp:
        Code: -1
        Type: -1
      Egress: false

  # --- Outbound (IPv4): TCP + UDP + ICMP ---
  PrivateACLOutTCP:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NetworkAclEntry
    Properties:
      NetworkAclId: !Ref PrivateNetworkACL
      RuleNumber: 100
      Protocol: 6
      RuleAction: allow
      CidrBlock: '0.0.0.0/0'
      PortRange:
        From: 0
        To: 65535
      Egress: true

  PrivateACLOutUDP:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NetworkAclEntry
    Properties:
      NetworkAclId: !Ref PrivateNetworkACL
      RuleNumber: 110
      Protocol: 17
      RuleAction: allow
      CidrBlock: '0.0.0.0/0'
      PortRange:
        From: 0
        To: 65535
      Egress: true

  PrivateACLOutICMP:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NetworkAclEntry
    Properties:
      NetworkAclId: !Ref PrivateNetworkACL
      RuleNumber: 120
      Protocol: 1
      RuleAction: allow
      CidrBlock: '0.0.0.0/0'
      Icmp:
        Code: -1
        Type: -1
      Egress: true

  # --- Outbound (IPv6): TCP + UDP + ICMP ---
  PrivateACLOutTCPv6:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NetworkAclEntry
    Properties:
      NetworkAclId: !Ref PrivateNetworkACL
      RuleNumber: 200
      Protocol: 6
      RuleAction: allow
      Ipv6CidrBlock: '::/0'
      PortRange:
        From: 0
        To: 65535
      Egress: true

  PrivateACLOutUDPv6:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NetworkAclEntry
    Properties:
      NetworkAclId: !Ref PrivateNetworkACL
      RuleNumber: 210
      Protocol: 17
      RuleAction: allow
      Ipv6CidrBlock: '::/0'
      PortRange:
        From: 0
        To: 65535
      Egress: true

  PrivateACLOutICMPv6:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NetworkAclEntry
    Properties:
      NetworkAclId: !Ref PrivateNetworkACL
      RuleNumber: 220
      Protocol: 1
      RuleAction: allow
      Ipv6CidrBlock: '::/0'
      Icmp:
        Code: -1
        Type: -1
      Egress: true

  # Private subnet NACL associations
  PrivateAppSubnetACLAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetNetworkAclAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateAppSubnet
      NetworkAclId: !Ref PrivateNetworkACL

  PrivateDataSubnetACLAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetNetworkAclAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateDataSubnet
      NetworkAclId: !Ref PrivateNetworkACL

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # EC2 Placement Group – tightly coupled workloads
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  PlacementGroup:
    Type: AWS::EC2::PlacementGroup
    Properties:
      Strategy: cluster
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Join ['-', [!Ref Environment, 'placement-group']]
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # DHCP Options Set – custom domain + Amazon DNS
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  DHCPOptionsSet:
    Type: AWS::EC2::DHCPOptions
    Properties:
      DomainName:
        Fn::FindInMap:
          - EnvironmentConfig
          - Ref: Environment
          - DomainName
      DomainNameServers:
        - AmazonProvidedDNS
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Join ['-', [!Ref Environment, 'dhcp-options']]
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment

  VPCDHCPOptionsAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCDHCPOptionsAssociation
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      DhcpOptionsId: !Ref DHCPOptionsSet

Outputs:
  VPCID:
    Description: The VPC ID
    Value: !Ref VPC
    Export:
      Name: !Join ['-', [!Ref Environment, 'VPCID']]

  VPCCIDR:
    Description: The VPC IPv4 CIDR block
    Value: !GetAtt VPC.CidrBlock
    Export:
      Name: !Join ['-', [!Ref Environment, 'VPCCIDR']]

  PublicSubnet1ID:
    Description: Public subnet 1 (AZ1, presentation tier)
    Value: !Ref PublicSubnet1
    Export:
      Name: !Join ['-', [!Ref Environment, 'PublicSubnet1ID']]

  PublicSubnet2ID:
    Description: Public subnet 2 (AZ1, presentation tier)
    Value: !Ref PublicSubnet2
    Export:
      Name: !Join ['-', [!Ref Environment, 'PublicSubnet2ID']]

  PublicSubnet3ID:
    Description: Public subnet 3 (AZ2, compute tier)
    Value: !Ref PublicSubnet3

      Name: !Join ['-', [!Ref Environment, 'PublicSubnet3ID']]

  PrivateAppSubnetID:
    Description: Private application tier subnet (AZ1)

    Export:
      Name: !Join ['-', [!Ref Environment, 'PrivateAppSubnetID']]

  PrivateDataSubnetID:
    Description: Private data tier subnet (AZ1)

      Name: !Join ['-', [!Ref Environment, 'PrivateDataSubnetID']]

  PrivateRouteTableID:
    Description: Private route table ID
    Value: !Ref PrivateRouteTable
    Export:
      Name: !Join ['-', [!Ref Environment, 'PrivateRouteTableID']]

final_template:
AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: 'SageMaker Studio MLOps Engineer User Profile with Self-Contained VPC and Domain'

Parameters:
  DomainId:
    Type: String
    Description: Optional existing SageMaker Studio Domain ID. Leave blank to create a new domain with its own VPC.
    Default: ''
  SecurityGroupIds:
    Type: CommaDelimitedList
    Description: Existing security group IDs. Required when DomainId is provided.
    Default: ''
  SubnetIds:
    Type: CommaDelimitedList
    Description: Existing subnet IDs. Required when DomainId is provided.
    Default: ''
  UserProfileName:
    Type: String
    Description: Name for the SageMaker Studio user profile
    Default: mlops-engineer

Conditions:
  CreateVPC: !Equals [!Ref DomainId, '']

Resources:
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # VPC and Networking – created only when no existing DomainId is supplied
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  VPC:
    Condition: CreateVPC
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: 10.0.0.0/16
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-sagemaker-vpc'

  InternetGateway:
    Condition: CreateVPC
    Type: AWS::EC2::InternetGateway
    Properties:
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-igw'

  VPCGatewayAttachment:
    Condition: CreateVPC
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      InternetGatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  Subnet:
    Condition: CreateVPC
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: 10.0.1.0/24
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-sagemaker-subnet'

  RouteTable:
    Condition: CreateVPC
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-rt'

  RouteToInternet:
    Condition: CreateVPC
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    DependsOn: VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref RouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      GatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  SubnetRouteTableAssociation:
    Condition: CreateVPC
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref Subnet
      RouteTableId: !Ref RouteTable

  SecurityGroup:
    Condition: CreateVPC
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup
    Properties:
      GroupDescription: Security group for SageMaker Studio
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-sagemaker-sg'

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # SageMaker Studio Execution Role – IAM role with policy for MLOps persona
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  SageMakerExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: sagemaker.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Path: /
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: MLOpsEngineerPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: PassRole
                Effect: Allow
                Action: iam:PassRole
                Resource: '*'
                Condition:
                  StringEquals:
                    iam:PassedToService: sagemaker.amazonaws.com
              - Sid: SageMakerPipelines
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - sagemaker:CreatePipeline
                  - sagemaker:DeletePipeline
                  - sagemaker:DescribePipeline
                  - sagemaker:ListPipelines
                  - sagemaker:UpdatePipeline
                  - sagemaker:StartPipelineExecution
                  - sagemaker:StopPipelineExecution
                  - sagemaker:RetryPipelineExecution
                  - sagemaker:UpdatePipelineExecution
                  - sagemaker:DescribePipelineExecution
                  - sagemaker:ListPipelineExecutions
                  - sagemaker:ListPipelineExecutionSteps
                  - sagemaker:DescribePipelineExecutionStep
                Resource: '*'
              - Sid: ModelMonitoring
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - sagemaker:CreateMonitoringSchedule
                  - sagemaker:DeleteMonitoringSchedule
                  - sagemaker:DescribeMonitoringSchedule
                  - sagemaker:ListMonitoringSchedules
                  - sagemaker:StartMonitoringSchedule
                  - sagemaker:StopMonitoringSchedule
                  - sagemaker:UpdateMonitoringSchedule
                  - sagemaker:CreateProcessingJob
                  - sagemaker:DescribeProcessingJob
                  - sagemaker:ListProcessingJobs
                  - sagemaker:StopProcessingJob
                Resource: '*'
              - Sid: ModelsAndPackages
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - sagemaker:CreateModel
                  - sagemaker:DescribeModel
                  - sagemaker:ListModels
                  - sagemaker:DeleteModel
                  - sagemaker:CreateModelPackageGroup
                  - sagemaker:DescribeModelPackageGroup
                  - sagemaker:ListModelPackageGroups
                  - sagemaker:UpdateModelPackageGroup
                  - sagemaker:DeleteModelPackageGroup
                  - sagemaker:CreateModelPackage
                  - sagemaker:DescribeModelPackage
                  - sagemaker:ListModelPackages
                  - sagemaker:UpdateModelPackage
                  - sagemaker:DeleteModelPackage
                Resource: '*'
              - Sid: ExperimentsAndLineage
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - sagemaker:ListExperiments
                  - sagemaker:DescribeExperiment
                  - sagemaker:CreateExperiment
                  - sagemaker:DeleteExperiment
                  - sagemaker:ListTrials
                  - sagemaker:DescribeTrial
                  - sagemaker:CreateTrial
                  - sagemaker:DeleteTrial
                  - sagemaker:ListTrialComponents
                  - sagemaker:DescribeTrialComponent
                  - sagemaker:ListLineageGroups
                  - sagemaker:DescribeLineageGroup
                  - sagemaker:QueryLineage
                  - sagemaker:AddAssociation
                  - sagemaker:DeleteAssociation
                Resource: '*'
              - Sid: TrainingAndTuning
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - sagemaker:CreateTrainingJob
                  - sagemaker:DescribeTrainingJob
                  - sagemaker:ListTrainingJobs
                  - sagemaker:StopTrainingJob
                  - sagemaker:CreateTransformJob
                  - sagemaker:DescribeTransformJob
                  - sagemaker:ListTransformJobs
                  - sagemaker:StopTransformJob
                  - sagemaker:CreateHyperParameterTuningJob
                  - sagemaker:DescribeHyperParameterTuningJob
                  - sagemaker:ListHyperParameterTuningJobs
                  - sagemaker:StopHyperParameterTuningJob
                  - sagemaker:CreateAutoMLJob
                  - sagemaker:DescribeAutoMLJob
                  - sagemaker:ListAutoMLJobs
                  - sagemaker:StopAutoMLJob
                Resource: '*'
              - Sid: Endpoints
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - sagemaker:CreateEndpoint
                  - sagemaker:DescribeEndpoint
                  - sagemaker:ListEndpoints
                  - sagemaker:UpdateEndpoint
                  - sagemaker:DeleteEndpoint
                  - sagemaker:CreateEndpointConfig
                  - sagemaker:DescribeEndpointConfig
                  - sagemaker:ListEndpointConfigs
                  - sagemaker:UpdateEndpointConfig
                  - sagemaker:DeleteEndpointConfig
                  - sagemaker:InvokeEndpoint
                Resource: '*'
              - Sid: StudioApplications
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - sagemaker:CreateApp
                  - sagemaker:DescribeApp
                  - sagemaker:ListApps
                  - sagemaker:DeleteApp
                Resource: '*'
                Condition:
                  StringEquals:
                    sagemaker:UserProfileName: !Ref UserProfileName
              - Sid: StudioSpaces
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - sagemaker:CreateSpace
                  - sagemaker:DescribeSpace
                  - sagemaker:ListSpaces
                  - sagemaker:DeleteSpace
                  - sagemaker:UpdateSpace
                Resource: '*'
                Condition:
                  StringEquals:
                    sagemaker:UserProfileName: !Ref UserProfileName
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-mlops-execution-role'

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # SageMaker Studio Domain – created only when no existing DomainId is supplied
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  SageMakerDomain:
    Condition: CreateVPC
    Type: AWS::SageMaker::Domain
    Properties:
      DomainName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-mlops-domain'
      AuthMode: IAM
      DefaultUserSettings:
        ExecutionRole: !GetAtt SageMakerExecutionRole.Arn
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref Subnet
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      AppNetworkAccessType: PublicInternetOnly
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-domain'

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # SageMaker Studio User Profile – attached to either existing or new domain
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  UserProfile:
    Type: AWS::SageMaker::UserProfile
    Properties:
      DomainId: !If [CreateVPC, !Ref SageMakerDomain, !Ref DomainId]
      UserProfileName: !Ref UserProfileName
      UserSettings:
        ExecutionRole: !GetAtt SageMakerExecutionRole.Arn
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-${UserProfileName}'

Outputs:
  UserProfileArn:

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: 'Self-contained AppSync GraphQL API TodoAPIwithJs with JavaScript pipeline resolvers and DynamoDB backend'

Resources:
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # AppSync GraphQL API
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  GraphQLApi:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::GraphQLApi
    Properties:
      Name: TodoAPIwithJs
      AuthenticationType: API_KEY

  ApiKey:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::ApiKey
    Properties:
      ApiId: !GetAtt GraphQLApi.ApiId

  GraphQLSchema:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::GraphQLSchema
    Properties:
      ApiId: !GetAtt GraphQLApi.ApiId
      Definition: |
        type Todo {
          id: ID!
          owner: String!
          title: String!
          description: String
          completed: Boolean
          createdAt: String
          updatedAt: String
        }

        input CreateTodoInput {
          owner: String!
          title: String!
          description: String
          completed: Boolean
        }

        input UpdateTodoInput {
          id: ID!
          owner: String
          title: String
          description: String
          completed: Boolean
        }

        input DeleteTodoInput {
          id: ID!
        }

        type Mutation {
          createTodo(input: CreateTodoInput!): Todo
          updateTodo(input: UpdateTodoInput!): Todo
          deleteTodo(input: DeleteTodoInput!): Todo
        }

        type Query {
          getTodo(id: ID!): Todo
          listTodos: [Todo]
          todosByOwner(owner: String!): [Todo]
        }

        type Subscription {
          onCreateTodo: Todo @aws_subscribe(mutations: ["createTodo"])
          onUpdateTodo: Todo @aws_subscribe(mutations: ["updateTodo"])
          onDeleteTodo: Todo @aws_subscribe(mutations: ["deleteTodo"])
        }

        schema {
          query: Query
          mutation: Mutation
          subscription: Subscription
        }

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # DynamoDB table with GSI on owner
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  TodoTable:
    Type: AWS::DynamoDB::Table
    Properties:
      BillingMode: PAY_PER_REQUEST
      AttributeDefinitions:
        - AttributeName: id
          AttributeType: S
        - AttributeName: owner
          AttributeType: S
      KeySchema:
        - AttributeName: id
          KeyType: HASH
      GlobalSecondaryIndexes:
        - IndexName: owner-index
          KeySchema:
            - AttributeName: owner
              KeyType: HASH
          Projection:
            ProjectionType: ALL

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # IAM role for AppSync to access DynamoDB
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  DataSourceRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: appsync.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole

  DataSourcePolicy:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Policy
    Properties:
      PolicyName: appsync-dynamodb-access
      Roles:
        - !Ref DataSourceRole
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - dynamodb:PutItem
              - dynamodb:GetItem
              - dynamodb:UpdateItem
              - dynamodb:DeleteItem
              - dynamodb:Scan
              - dynamodb:Query
            Resource:
              - !GetAtt TodoTable.Arn
              - !Sub "${TodoTable.Arn}/index/*"

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # AppSync DynamoDB data source
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  DynamoDBDataSource:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::DataSource
    Properties:
      ApiId: !GetAtt GraphQLApi.ApiId
      Name: TodoDynamoDBDataSource
      Type: AMAZON_DYNAMODB
      DynamoDBConfig:
        TableName: !Ref TodoTable
        AwsRegion: !Ref AWS::Region
      ServiceRoleArn: !GetAtt DataSourceRole.Arn

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # JavaScript AppSync functions (pipeline steps)
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  CreateTodoFunction:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::FunctionConfiguration
    Properties:
      ApiId: !GetAtt GraphQLApi.ApiId
      DataSourceName: !GetAtt DynamoDBDataSource.Name
      Name: createTodoFunction
      Runtime:
        Name: APPSYNC_JS
        RuntimeVersion: 1.0.0
      Code: |
        import { util, dynamodb } from '@aws-appsync/utils';
        export function request(ctx) {
          const { input } = ctx.arguments;
          const id = util.autoId();
          const now = util.time.nowISO8601();
          const item = {
            id,
            owner: input.owner,
            title: input.title,
            description: input.description || null,
            completed: input.completed != null ? input.completed : false,
            createdAt: now,
            updatedAt: now
          };
          return dynamodb.put({ key: { id }, item });
        }
        export function response(ctx) {
          return ctx.result;
        }

  GetTodoFunction:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::FunctionConfiguration
    Properties:
      ApiId: !GetAtt GraphQLApi.ApiId
      DataSourceName: !GetAtt DynamoDBDataSource.Name
      Name: getTodoFunction
      Runtime:
        Name: APPSYNC_JS
        RuntimeVersion: 1.0.0
      Code: |
        import { dynamodb } from '@aws-appsync/utils';
        export function request(ctx) {
          const { id } = ctx.arguments;
          return dynamodb.get({ key: { id } });
        }
        export function response(ctx) {
          return ctx.result;
        }

  UpdateTodoFunction:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::FunctionConfiguration
    Properties:
      ApiId: !GetAtt GraphQLApi.ApiId
      DataSourceName: !GetAtt DynamoDBDataSource.Name
      Name: updateTodoFunction
      Runtime:
        Name: APPSYNC_JS
        RuntimeVersion: 1.0.0
      Code: |
        import { util, dynamodb } from '@aws-appsync/utils';
        export function request(ctx) {
          const { input } = ctx.arguments;
          const now = util.time.nowISO8601();
          const updateObj = {};
          if (input.owner !== undefined) updateObj.owner = input.owner;
          if (input.title !== undefined) updateObj.title = input.title;
          if (input.description !== undefined) updateObj.description = input.description;
          if (input.completed !== undefined) updateObj.completed = input.completed;
          updateObj.updatedAt = now;
          return dynamodb.update({ key: { id: input.id }, update: updateObj });
        }
        export function response(ctx) {
          return ctx.result;
        }

  DeleteTodoFunction:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::FunctionConfiguration
    Properties:
      ApiId: !GetAtt GraphQLApi.ApiId
      DataSourceName: !GetAtt DynamoDBDataSource.Name
      Name: deleteTodoFunction
      Runtime:
        Name: APPSYNC_JS
        RuntimeVersion: 1.0.0
      Code: |
        import { dynamodb } from '@aws-appsync/utils';
        export function request(ctx) {
          const { input } = ctx.arguments;
          return dynamodb.delete({ key: { id: input.id } });
        }
        export function response(ctx) {
          return ctx.result;
        }

  ListTodosFunction:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::FunctionConfiguration
    Properties:
      ApiId: !GetAtt GraphQLApi.ApiId
      DataSourceName: !GetAtt DynamoDBDataSource.Name
      Name: listTodosFunction
      Runtime:
        Name: APPSYNC_JS
        RuntimeVersion: 1.0.0
      Code: |
        import { dynamodb } from '@aws-appsync/utils';
        export function request(ctx) {
          return dynamodb.scan({});
        }
        export function response(ctx) {
          return ctx.result.items;
        }

  TodosByOwnerFunction:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::FunctionConfiguration
    Properties:
      ApiId: !GetAtt GraphQLApi.ApiId
      DataSourceName: !GetAtt DynamoDBDataSource.Name
      Name: todosByOwnerFunction
      Runtime:
        Name: APPSYNC_JS
        RuntimeVersion: 1.0.0
      Code: |
        import { util, dynamodb } from '@aws-appsync/utils';
        export function request(ctx) {
          const { owner } = ctx.arguments;
          return dynamodb.query({ index: 'owner-index', query: { owner } });
        }
        export function response(ctx) {
          return ctx.result.items;
        }

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Pipeline resolvers — each field gets a pipeline with one JS function
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  CreateTodoResolver:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::Resolver
    DependsOn: GraphQLSchema
    Properties:
      ApiId: !GetAtt GraphQLApi.ApiId
      TypeName: Mutation
      FieldName: createTodo
      Kind: PIPELINE
      PipelineConfig:
        Functions:
          - !GetAtt CreateTodoFunction.FunctionId
      Runtime:
        Name: APPSYNC_JS
        RuntimeVersion: 1.0.0
      Code: |
        export function request(ctx) {
          return {};
        }
        export function response(ctx) {
          return ctx.result;
        }

  GetTodoResolver:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::Resolver
    DependsOn: GraphQLSchema
    Properties:
      ApiId: !GetAtt GraphQLApi.ApiId
      TypeName: Query
      FieldName: getTodo
      Kind: PIPELINE
      PipelineConfig:
        Functions:
          - !GetAtt GetTodoFunction.FunctionId
      Runtime:
        Name: APPSYNC_JS
        RuntimeVersion: 1.0.0
      Code: |
        export function request(ctx) {
          return {};
        }
        export function response(ctx) {
          return ctx.result;
        }

  UpdateTodoResolver:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::Resolver
    DependsOn: GraphQLSchema
    Properties:
      ApiId: !GetAtt GraphQLApi.ApiId
      TypeName: Mutation
      FieldName: updateTodo
      Kind: PIPELINE
      PipelineConfig:
        Functions:
          - !GetAtt UpdateTodoFunction.FunctionId
      Runtime:
        Name: APPSYNC_JS
        RuntimeVersion: 1.0.0
      Code: |
        export function request(ctx) {
          return {};
        }
        export function response(ctx) {
          return ctx.result;
        }

  DeleteTodoResolver:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::Resolver
    DependsOn: GraphQLSchema
    Properties:
      ApiId: !GetAtt GraphQLApi.ApiId
      TypeName: Mutation
      FieldName: deleteTodo
      Kind: PIPELINE
      PipelineConfig:
        Functions:
          - !GetAtt DeleteTodoFunction.FunctionId
      Runtime:
        Name: APPSYNC_JS
        RuntimeVersion: 1.0.0
      Code: |
        export function request(ctx) {
          return {};
        }
        export function response(ctx) {
          return ctx.result;
        }

  ListTodosResolver:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::Resolver
    DependsOn: GraphQLSchema
    Properties:
      ApiId: !GetAtt GraphQLApi.ApiId
      TypeName: Query
      FieldName: listTodos
      Kind: PIPELINE
      PipelineConfig:
        Functions:
          - !GetAtt ListTodosFunction.FunctionId
      Runtime:
        Name: APPSYNC_JS
        RuntimeVersion: 1.0.0
      Code: |
        export function request(ctx) {
          return {};
        }
        export function response(ctx) {
          return ctx.result;
        }

  TodosByOwnerResolver:

    DependsOn: GraphQLSchema
    Properties:

      DatapointsToAlarm: 1
      Threshold: 10485760
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold
      Dimensions:

  RDSHighNetworkReceiveThroughputAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: RDS-HighNetworkReceiveThroughput

      Period: 300
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      DatapointsToAlarm: 1
      Threshold: 10485760
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold
      Dimensions:

  RDSHighQueriesAlarm:

      Period: 300
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      DatapointsToAlarm: 1
      Threshold: 100
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold

      Statistic: Average
      Period: 300
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      DatapointsToAlarm: 1
      Threshold: 50
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold
      Dimensions:

      AlarmDescription: >-

      Statistic: Average
      Period: 300
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      DatapointsToAlarm: 1
      Threshold: 0.1
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold
      Dimensions:
        - Name: DBInstanceIdentifier

  RDSHighWriteLatencyAlarm:

      AlarmName: RDS-HighWriteLatency

final_template:
AWSTemplateFormatVersion: "2010-09-09"
Description: "Comprehensive monitoring and data extraction pipeline for QuickSight admin console"

Resources:

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Single IAM Role assumable by glue, cloudformation, firehose, and
  # streams.metrics.cloudwatch services.
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  AdminSuiteRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: admin-suite-role
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service:
                - glue.amazonaws.com
                - cloudformation.amazonaws.com
                - firehose.amazonaws.com
                - streams.metrics.cloudwatch.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: admin-suite-policy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: "2012-10-17"
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - quicksight:*
                Resource: "*"
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - glue:*
                Resource: "*"
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - cloudwatch:*
                  - cloudwatch:PutMetricData
                  - cloudwatch:ListMetrics
                  - cloudwatch:GetMetricData
                  - cloudwatch:GetMetricStatistics
                  - cloudwatch:DescribeAlarms
                Resource: "*"
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - firehose:*
                Resource: "*"
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - iam:*
                Resource: "*"
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:PutObject
                  - s3:PutObjectAcl
                  - s3:GetObject
                  - s3:GetObjectVersion
                  - s3:ListBucket
                  - s3:GetBucketLocation
                  - s3:DeleteObject
                  - s3:AbortMultipartUpload
                  - s3:ListBucketMultipartUploads
                  - s3:ListMultipartUploadParts
                Resource:
                  - !GetAtt AdminSuiteBucket.Arn
                  - !Sub "${AdminSuiteBucket.Arn}/*"
                  - !Sub "arn:aws:s3:::${ScriptBucket}/*"
                  - !Sub "arn:aws:s3:::${ScriptBucket}"
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:GetBucketLocation
                  - s3:ListBucket
                Resource:
                  - !GetAtt AdminSuiteBucket.Arn
                  - !Sub "arn:aws:s3:::${ScriptBucket}"
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - kms:Decrypt
                  - kms:GenerateDataKey
                  - kms:GenerateDataKeyWithoutPlaintext
                  - kms:Encrypt
                  - kms:DescribeKey
                  - kms:ReEncrypt*
                Resource: !GetAtt AdminSuiteBucketKey.Arn

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Private S3 bucket for Glue scripts
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  ScriptBucket:
    Type: AWS::S3::Bucket
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      BucketName: !Sub "admin-suite-scripts-${AWS::AccountId}"
      PublicAccessBlockConfiguration:
        BlockPublicAcls: true
        BlockPublicPolicy: true
        IgnorePublicAcls: true
        RestrictPublicBuckets: true
      VersioningConfiguration:
        Status: Enabled
      BucketEncryption:
        ServerSideEncryptionConfiguration:
          - ServerSideEncryptionByDefault:
              KMSMasterKeyID: !Ref AdminSuiteBucketKey
              SSEAlgorithm: aws:kms
            BucketKeyEnabled: true

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Private S3 bucket (admin-suite-{accountId}) with public access blocked
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  AdminSuiteBucketKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    Properties:
      KeyUsage: ENCRYPT_DECRYPT
      KeySpec: SYMMETRIC_DEFAULT
      Description: "KMS key for admin suite S3 bucket encryption"
      Enabled: true
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      PendingWindowInDays: 7
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Sid: Enable IAM policies
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub "arn:aws:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root"
            Action: kms:*
            Resource: "*"

  AdminSuiteBucket:
    Type: AWS::S3::Bucket
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      BucketName: !Sub "admin-suite-${AWS::AccountId}"
      PublicAccessBlockConfiguration:
        BlockPublicAcls: true
        BlockPublicPolicy: true
        IgnorePublicAcls: true
        RestrictPublicBuckets: true
      VersioningConfiguration:
        Status: Enabled
      BucketEncryption:
        ServerSideEncryptionConfiguration:
          - ServerSideEncryptionByDefault:
              KMSMasterKeyID: !Ref AdminSuiteBucketKey
              SSEAlgorithm: aws:kms
            BucketKeyEnabled: true

  # ===========================================================================
  # GLUE PYTHON SHELL JOBS (Python 3.9, Glue 3.0)
  # ===========================================================================

  # 1. Asset Access Details
  GlueJobAssetsAccess:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Job
    Properties:
      Name: etl_job_admin_suite_assets_access
      Role: !GetAtt AdminSuiteRole.Arn
      Command:
        Name: pythonshell
        ScriptLocation: !Sub "s3://${ScriptBucket}/scripts/etl_job_admin_suite_assets_access.py"
        PythonVersion: "3"
      GlueVersion: "3.0"
      MaxCapacity: 0.0625
      ExecutionProperty:
        MaxConcurrentRuns: 1
      Timeout: 120
      DefaultArguments:
        "--region": !Ref AWS::Region
        "--account-id": !Ref AWS::AccountId
        "--output-bucket": !Sub "admin-suite-${AWS::AccountId}"

  # 2. Asset Metadata
  GlueJobAssetsMetadata:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Job
    Properties:
      Name: etl_job_admin_suite_assets_metadata
      Role: !GetAtt AdminSuiteRole.Arn
      Command:
        Name: pythonshell
        ScriptLocation: !Sub "s3://${ScriptBucket}/scripts/etl_job_admin_suite_assets_metadata.py"
        PythonVersion: "3"
      GlueVersion: "3.0"
      MaxCapacity: 0.0625
      ExecutionProperty:
        MaxConcurrentRuns: 1
      Timeout: 120
      DefaultArguments:
        "--region": !Ref AWS::Region
        "--account-id": !Ref AWS::AccountId
        "--output-bucket": !Sub "admin-suite-${AWS::AccountId}"

  # 3. Folder Structure Information
  GlueJobFolderAssets:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Job
    Properties:
      Name: etl_job_admin_suite_folder_assets
      Role: !GetAtt AdminSuiteRole.Arn
      Command:
        Name: pythonshell
        ScriptLocation: !Sub "s3://${ScriptBucket}/scripts/etl_job_admin_suite_folder_assets.py"
        PythonVersion: "3"
      GlueVersion: "3.0"
      MaxCapacity: 0.0625
      ExecutionProperty:
        MaxConcurrentRuns: 1
      Timeout: 120
      DefaultArguments:
        "--region": !Ref AWS::Region
        "--account-id": !Ref AWS::AccountId
        "--output-bucket": !Sub "admin-suite-${AWS::AccountId}"

  # 4. Q Topic Metadata
  GlueJobQMetadata:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Job
    Properties:
      Name: etl_job_admin_suite_q_metadata
      Role: !GetAtt AdminSuiteRole.Arn
      Command:
        Name: pythonshell
        ScriptLocation: !Sub "s3://${ScriptBucket}/scripts/etl_job_admin_suite_q_metadata.py"
        PythonVersion: "3"
      GlueVersion: "3.0"
      MaxCapacity: 0.0625
      ExecutionProperty:
        MaxConcurrentRuns: 1
      Timeout: 120
      DefaultArguments:
        "--region": !Ref AWS::Region
        "--account-id": !Ref AWS::AccountId
        "--output-bucket": !Sub "admin-suite-${AWS::AccountId}"

  # 5. Q Object Access Details
  GlueJobQAccess:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Job
    Properties:
      Name: etl_job_admin_suite_q_access
      Role: !GetAtt AdminSuiteRole.Arn
      Command:
        Name: pythonshell
        ScriptLocation: !Sub "s3://${ScriptBucket}/scripts/etl_job_admin_suite_q_access.py"
        PythonVersion: "3"
      GlueVersion: "3.0"
      MaxCapacity: 0.0625
      ExecutionProperty:
        MaxConcurrentRuns: 1
      Timeout: 120
      DefaultArguments:
        "--region": !Ref AWS::Region
        "--account-id": !Ref AWS::AccountId
        "--output-bucket": !Sub "admin-suite-${AWS::AccountId}"

  # ===========================================================================
  # GLUE ETL JOBS (WorkerType G.1X, 2 workers, Glue 5.0)
  # ===========================================================================

  # 6. Dataset Properties
  GlueJobDSProperties:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Job
    Properties:
      Name: etl_job_admin_suite_ds_properties
      Role: !GetAtt AdminSuiteRole.Arn
      Command:
        Name: glueetl
        ScriptLocation: !Sub "s3://${ScriptBucket}/scripts/etl_job_admin_suite_ds_properties.py"
        PythonVersion: "3"
      GlueVersion: "5.0"
      WorkerType: G.1X
      NumberOfWorkers: 2
      ExecutionProperty:
        MaxConcurrentRuns: 1
      Timeout: 120
      MaxRetries: 0
      DefaultArguments:
        "--region": !Ref AWS::Region
        "--account-id": !Ref AWS::AccountId
        "--output-bucket": !Sub "admin-suite-${AWS::AccountId}"

  # 7. Data Source Properties
  GlueJobDatasourceProperties:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Job
    Properties:
      Name: etl_job_admin_suite_datasource_properties
      Role: !GetAtt AdminSuiteRole.Arn
      Command:
        Name: glueetl
        ScriptLocation: !Sub "s3://${ScriptBucket}/scripts/etl_job_admin_suite_datasource_properties.py"
        PythonVersion: "3"
      GlueVersion: "5.0"
      WorkerType: G.1X
      NumberOfWorkers: 2
      ExecutionProperty:
        MaxConcurrentRuns: 1
      Timeout: 120
      MaxRetries: 0
      DefaultArguments:
        "--region": !Ref AWS::Region
        "--account-id": !Ref AWS::AccountId
        "--output-bucket": !Sub "admin-suite-${AWS::AccountId}"

  # ===========================================================================
  # GLUE TRIGGERS (scheduled every 3 hours)
  # ===========================================================================

  TriggerAssetsAccess:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Trigger
    Properties:
      Name: trigger-admin-suite-assets-access
      Type: SCHEDULED
      Schedule: "cron(0 */3 * * ? *)"
      Actions:
        - JobName: !Ref GlueJobAssetsAccess
      StartOnCreation: true

  TriggerAssetsMetadata:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Trigger
    Properties:
      Name: trigger-admin-suite-assets-metadata
      Type: SCHEDULED
      Schedule: "cron(5 */3 * * ? *)"
      Actions:
        - JobName: !Ref GlueJobAssetsMetadata
      StartOnCreation: true

  TriggerFolderAssets:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Trigger
    Properties:
      Name: trigger-admin-suite-folder-assets
      Type: SCHEDULED
      Schedule: "cron(10 */3 * * ? *)"
      Actions:
        - JobName: !Ref GlueJobFolderAssets
      StartOnCreation: true

  TriggerQMetadata:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Trigger
    Properties:
      Name: trigger-admin-suite-q-metadata
      Type: SCHEDULED
      Schedule: "cron(15 */3 * * ? *)"
      Actions:
        - JobName: !Ref GlueJobQMetadata
      StartOnCreation: true

  TriggerQAccess:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Trigger
    Properties:
      Name: trigger-admin-suite-q-access
      Type: SCHEDULED
      Schedule: "cron(20 */3 * * ? *)"
      Actions:
        - JobName: !Ref GlueJobQAccess
      StartOnCreation: true

  TriggerDSProperties:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Trigger
    Properties:
      Name: trigger-admin-suite-ds-properties
      Type: SCHEDULED
      Schedule: "cron(25 */3 * * ? *)"
      Actions:
        - JobName: !Ref GlueJobDSProperties
      StartOnCreation: true

  TriggerDatasourceProperties:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Trigger
    Properties:
      Name: trigger-admin-suite-datasource-properties
      Type: SCHEDULED
      Schedule: "cron(30 */3 * * ? *)"
      Actions:
        - JobName: !Ref GlueJobDatasourceProperties
      StartOnCreation: true

  # ===========================================================================
  # KINESIS FIREHOSE DELIVERY STREAMS (DirectPut)
  # ===========================================================================

  # 1. Ingestion Metrics Firehose
  FirehoseIngestionMetrics:
    Type: AWS::KinesisFirehose::DeliveryStream
    Properties:
      DeliveryStreamName: admin-suite-ingestion-metrics-firehose
      DeliveryStreamType: DirectPut
      S3DestinationConfiguration:
        BucketARN: !GetAtt AdminSuiteBucket.Arn
        Prefix: "quicksight/ingestion-metrics/"
        ErrorOutputPrefix: "quicksight/ingestion-metrics/errors/"
        BufferingHints:
          IntervalInSeconds: 60
          SizeInMBs: 5
        CompressionFormat: UNCOMPRESSED
        RoleARN: !GetAtt AdminSuiteRole.Arn

  # 2. Visual Metrics Firehose
  FirehoseVisualMetrics:
    Type: AWS::KinesisFirehose::DeliveryStream
    Properties:
      DeliveryStreamName: admin-suite-visual-metrics-firehose
      DeliveryStreamType: DirectPut
      S3DestinationConfiguration:
        BucketARN: !GetAtt AdminSuiteBucket.Arn
        Prefix: "quicksight/visual-metrics/"
        ErrorOutputPrefix: "quicksight/visual-metrics/errors/"
        BufferingHints:
          IntervalInSeconds: 60
          SizeInMBs: 5
        CompressionFormat: UNCOMPRESSED
        RoleARN: !GetAtt AdminSuiteRole.Arn

  # 3. SPICE Metrics Firehose
  FirehoseSPICEMetrics:
    Type: AWS::KinesisFirehose::DeliveryStream
    Properties:
      DeliveryStreamName: admin-suite-spice-metrics-firehose
      DeliveryStreamType: DirectPut
      S3DestinationConfiguration:
        BucketARN: !GetAtt AdminSuiteBucket.Arn
        Prefix: "quicksight/spice-metrics/"
        ErrorOutputPrefix: "quicksight/spice-metrics/errors/"
        BufferingHints:
          IntervalInSeconds: 60
          SizeInMBs: 5
        CompressionFormat: UNCOMPRESSED
        RoleARN: !GetAtt AdminSuiteRole.Arn

  # 4. Index Metrics Firehose
  FirehoseIndexMetrics:
    Type: AWS::KinesisFirehose::DeliveryStream
    Properties:
      DeliveryStreamName: admin-suite-index-metrics-firehose
      DeliveryStreamType: DirectPut
      S3DestinationConfiguration:
        BucketARN: !GetAtt AdminSuiteBucket.Arn
        Prefix: "quicksight/index-metrics/"
        ErrorOutputPrefix: "quicksight/index-metrics/errors/"
        BufferingHints:
          IntervalInSeconds: 60
          SizeInMBs: 5
        CompressionFormat: UNCOMPRESSED
        RoleARN: !GetAtt AdminSuiteRole.Arn

  # 5. Action Metrics Firehose
  FirehoseActionMetrics:
    Type: AWS::KinesisFirehose::DeliveryStream
    Properties:
      DeliveryStreamName: admin-suite-action-metrics-firehose
      DeliveryStreamType: DirectPut
      S3DestinationConfiguration:
        BucketARN: !GetAtt AdminSuiteBucket.Arn
        Prefix: "quicksight/action-metrics/"
        ErrorOutputPrefix: "quicksight/action-metrics/errors/"
        BufferingHints:
          IntervalInSeconds: 60
          SizeInMBs: 5
        CompressionFormat: UNCOMPRESSED
        RoleARN: !GetAtt AdminSuiteRole.Arn

  # ===========================================================================
  # CLOUDWATCH METRIC STREAMS (JSON output, feeding into respective Firehose)
  # ===========================================================================

  # 1. IngestionRowCount, IngestionLatency, IngestionInvocationCount, IngestionErrorCount
  MetricStreamIngestion:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::MetricStream
    Properties:
      Name: admin-suite-ingestion-metrics-stream
      FirehoseArn: !Ref FirehoseIngestionMetrics
      RoleArn: !GetAtt AdminSuiteRole.Arn
      OutputFormat: json
      IncludeFilters:
        - Namespace: AWS/QuickSight
          MetricNames:
            - IngestionRowCount
            - IngestionLatency
            - IngestionInvocationCount
            - IngestionErrorCount

  # 2. VisualLoadTime, DashboardViewLoadTime, DashboardViewCount, VisualLoadErrorCount
  MetricStreamVisual:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::MetricStream
    Properties:
      Name: admin-suite-visual-metrics-stream
      FirehoseArn: !Ref FirehoseVisualMetrics
      RoleArn: !GetAtt AdminSuiteRole.Arn
      OutputFormat: json
      IncludeFilters:
        - Namespace: AWS/QuickSight
          MetricNames:
            - VisualLoadTime
            - DashboardViewLoadTime
            - DashboardViewCount
            - VisualLoadErrorCount

  # 3. SPICECapacityLimitInMB, SPICECapacityConsumedInMB
  MetricStreamSPICE:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::MetricStream
    Properties:
      Name: admin-suite-spice-metrics-stream
      FirehoseArn: !Ref FirehoseSPICEMetrics
      RoleArn: !GetAtt AdminSuiteRole.Arn
      OutputFormat: json
      IncludeFilters:
        - Namespace: AWS/QuickSight
          MetricNames:
            - SPICECapacityLimitInMB
            - SPICECapacityConsumedInMB

  # 4. QuickIndexDocumentCount, QuickIndexExtractedTextSize
  MetricStreamIndex:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::MetricStream
    Properties:
      Name: admin-suite-index-metrics-stream
      FirehoseArn: !Ref FirehoseIndexMetrics
      RoleArn: !GetAtt AdminSuiteRole.Arn
      OutputFormat: json
      IncludeFilters:
        - Namespace: AWS/QuickSight
          MetricNames:
            - QuickIndexDocumentCount
            - QuickIndexExtractedTextSize

  # 5. ActionInvocationError, ActionInvocationCount
  MetricStreamAction:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::MetricStream
    Properties:
      Name: admin-suite-action-metrics-stream
      FirehoseArn: !Ref FirehoseActionMetrics
      RoleArn: !GetAtt AdminSuiteRole.Arn
      OutputFormat: json
      IncludeFilters:
        - Namespace: AWS/QuickSight
          MetricNames:
            - ActionInvocationError
            - ActionInvocationCount

Outputs:
  AdminSuiteBucketName:
    Description: "Name of the admin suite S3 bucket"
    Value: !Ref AdminSuiteBucket
